definition: A part of a document about the authors that provides biographical information and may discuss how the authors' professional experiences are relevant to the work described in the document.

label: author information textual entity
definition: A textual entity expression information about an author of a document. This information may include biographical information and may discuss how the authors' professional experiences are relevant to the work described in the document.

label: author summary section
definition: A part of a document, distinct from the abstract, that describes the significance and broader context of the document content. The author summary is often written in a non-technical manner and is aimed at both scientists and non-scientist readers.

label: author summary textual entity
definition: A textual entity, distinct from the abstract, that describes the significance and broader context of the document content. The author summary is often written in a non-technical manner and is aimed at both scientists and non-scientist readers, e.g as described in the article submission guidelines for PLoS Genetics (http://journals.plos.org/plosgenetics/s/submission-guidelines).

label: availability section
definition: A part of a document about a resource described in the document, e.g. software, that describes where and/or how that resource can be obtained.

label: availability textual entity
definition: A textual entity expressing the location of a resource, e.g. software, or the manner in which a resource can be obtained.

label: case report section
definition: A part of a document about the medical history of a specific patient as it relates to the topic of the document.

label: case report textual entity
definition: A textual entity that expresses a detailed account of a portion of the medical history for a specific patient.

label: conclusion section
definition: A part of a document used to summarize the findings discussed in the document. The conclusion section is typically found near the end of a document.

label: conflict of interest section
definition: A part of a document used to declare any competing interests regarding the authors and/or funding organization for the work described in the document.

label: conflict of interest textual entity
definition: A textual entity that expresses a situation involving one or more of the authors, or the funding source of a document whereby the authors or funding source stand to potentially gain (typically financially) from the results reported in the document.

label: consent section
definition: A part of a document about the consent process that was used to enroll patients in a study.

label: consent textual entity
definition: A textual entity that documents the consenting process used to enroll patients in a study.

label: ethical approval section
definition: A part of a document about the governance body responsible for approving the work discussed in a document on an ethical basis.

label: ethical approval textual entity
definition: A textual entity that documents the ethical approval of some study design.

label: figures section
definition: A part of a document that contains one or more figures.

label: funding source declaration section
definition: A part of a document used to detail information regarding the source of funding used in support of the generation of the document content.

label: funding source declaration textual entity
definition: A textual entity documenting the source of funding that supported some study.

label: future directions section
definition: A part of a document detailing extensions of the described work that may be implemented at some future point in time.

label: future directions textual entity
definition: A textual entity expressing ideas regarding future work relevant to work described in a document that could be done.

label: genome announcement section
definition: A document part announcing the publication of a novel draft genome sequence.

label: genome announcement textual entity
definition: A textual entity that describes the generation and public release of a novel, draft genome sequence.

label: keyword textual entity
definition: A textual entity listing keywords indicating the major theme(s) of a document.

label: keywords section
definition: A part of a document where keywords selected by the author to categorize the major theme(s) of a document are listed.

label: study limitations section
definition: A part of a document about biases or short comings related to the study design and execution.

label: study limitations textual entity
definition: A textual entity addressing a shortcoming or bias of a study design or execution.

label: materials section
definition: A part of a document about the materials required to reproduce the content of the document.

label: notes section
definition: A part of a document containing typically short notes about the document itself and/or the authors. Often the notes section contains subsections related to funding, competing interests, ethical approval, etc.

label: patients section
definition: A part of a document about the patients that participated in a study.

label: patients textual entity
definition: A textual entity expressing information regarding the patients used in a study.

label: pre-publication history section
definition: A part of the document about the publication history of a document. This section typically details dates of document submission to a journal and dates of any re-submissions as well as reviewer comments and responses to reviewers by the authors.

label: pre-publication history textual entity
definition: A textual entity that expresses the pre-publication history (submission dates, reviewer comments, etc) for a document, often including a hyperlink to a web page detailing the information.

label: related work section
definition: A part of a document about work in other publications that is relevant to the content of the document.

label: related work textual entity
definition: A textual entity that discusses work from other publications and expresses their relevancy to the content of a document.

label: requirements section
definition: A part of a document about a resource described in the document, e.g. software, that describes the requirements necessary to use the resource, e.g. operating systems, hardware, etc. in the case of a software resource.

label: requirements textual entity
definition: A textual entity that expresses the requirements necessary to use a resource, e.g. software.

label: statistical analysis textual entity
definition: A textual entity documenting statistical analysis tools and techniques employed.

label: statistical analysis section
definition: A part of the document used to describe the statistical methodologies employed in the work presented in the document.

label: tables section
definition: A part of a document that contains one or more tables.

label: postal code
definition: An identifier that denotes some postal delivery route, some aggregate of postal delivery routes or a geographical region and was created for the purpose of sorting and delivering mail.

label: Postal delivery route
definition: A plan specification that if realized, is realized by the delivery of mail to some facility or mailbox within some geographical region.

label: zone improvement plan code
definition: A postal code that is used in the United States for the purpose of sorting and delivering mail, and that denotes some postal delivery route or some aggregate of postal delivery routes.

label: database extract, transform, and load process
definition: A planned process which takes as input a database and fills another database by extracting concretizations of information entities from the first, transforming them, and loading the transformed concretizations into the second.

label: title section
definition: the section of the document where the title appears

label: has ontology root term
definition: Ontology annotation property. Relates an ontology to a term that is a designated root term of the ontology. Display tools like OLS can use terms annotated with this property as the starting point for rendering the ontology class hierarchy. There can be more than one root.

label: descriptive data section
definition: A document part that lists and defines data variables, describes data characteristics (e.g. missing data information) and any assumptions and simplifications made.

label: additional results section
definition: A results section that reports analyses other than main results of the study (e.g. subgroups analyses, adjusted analyses, sensitivity analyses, etc.)

label: research participants section
definition: A document part that describes human subject(s) that participated in a study (e.g. inclusion & exclusion criteria, recruitment methods, reasons for non-participation, grouping and randomisation, methods of follow-up, etc.).

label: measurement methods section
definition: A methods section that describes details of data assessment methods (data measurement).

label: research settings section
definition: A document part that describes the physical/social/cultural conditions around a research trial.

label: study bias section
definition: A study limitations section that describes systematic error introduced into sampling or testing by selecting or encouraging one outcome or answer over others.

label: graphical abstract
definition: An abstract that is pictorial summary of the main findings described in the document.

label: ORCID identifier
definition: A centrally registered identifier that is issued by ORCID (https://orcid.org/) and used to persistantly identify oneself as a human researcher or contributor.

label: data collection
definition: A data entity that consists of multiple data entities.

label: may be identical to
definition: A annotation relationship between two terms in an ontology that may refer to the same (natural) type but where more evidence is required before terms are merged.

label: scheduled for obsoletion on or after
definition: Used when the class or object is scheduled for obsoletion/deprecation on or after a particular date.

label: identifier
definition: An information content entity that is the outcome of a dubbing process and is used to refer to one instance of entity shared by a group of people to refer to that individual entity.

label: grapheme
definition: An information content entity that is a fundamental unit in a written language.

label: identifier creating process
definition: A planned process that provides a reference to an individual entity shared by a group of subscribers to refer to that individual entity.

label: personal name
definition: An identifier referring to an individual entity that is ascribed personhood by the user of the identifier.

label: given name
definition: A personal name that specifies and differentiates between members of a group of individuals, especially in a family, all of whose members usually share the same family name (surname). A given name is purposefully given, usually by a child's parents at or near birth, in contrast to an inherited one such as a family name

label: family name
definition: An identifier that is typically a part of a person's name which has been passed, according to law or custom, from one or both parents to their children.

label: code set
definition: An information content entity that is a collection of other information content entities that has been created to identify or annotate things in a specified domain, and where the intention of its creators is that the collection has a one-to-one correspondence with those things.

label: term replaced by
definition: Use on obsolete terms, relating the term to another term that can be used as a substitute

label: base ontology module
definition: An ontology module that comprises only of asserted axioms local to the ontology, excludes import directives, and excludes axioms or declarations from external ontologies.

label: editors ontology module
definition: An ontology module that is intended to be directly edited, typically managed in source control, and typically not intended for direct consumption by end-users.

label: main release ontology module
definition: An ontology module that is intended to be the primary release product and the one consumed by the majority of tools.

label: bridge ontology module
definition: An ontology module that consists entirely of axioms that connect or bridge two distinct ontology modules. For example, the Uberon-to-ZFA bridge module.

label: import ontology module
definition: A subset ontology module that is intended to be imported from another ontology.

label: subset ontology module
definition: An ontology module that is extracted from a main ontology module and includes only a subset of entities or axioms.

label: curation subset ontology module
definition: A subset ontology that is intended as a whitelist for curators using the ontology. Such a subset will exclude classes that curators should not use for curation.

label: analysis subset ontology module
definition: An ontology module that is intended for usage in analysis or discovery applications.

label: single layer subset ontology module
definition: A subset ontology that is largely comprised of a single layer or strata in an ontology class hierarchy. The purpose is typically for rolling up for visualization. The classes in the layer need not be disjoint.

label: exclusion subset ontology module
definition: A subset of an ontology that is intended to be excluded for some purpose. For example, a blacklist of classes.

label: external import ontology module
definition: An imported ontology module that is derived from an external ontology. Derivation methods include the OWLAPI SLME approach.

label: species subset ontology module
definition: A subset ontology that is crafted to either include or exclude a taxonomic grouping of species.

label: reasoned ontology module
definition: An ontology module that contains axioms generated by a reasoner. The generated axioms are typically direct SubClassOf axioms, but other possibilities are available.

label: generated ontology module
definition: An ontology module that is automatically generated, for example via a SPARQL query or via template and a CSV.

label: template generated ontology module
definition: An ontology module that is automatically generated from a template specification and fillers for slots in that template.

label: obo basic subset ontology module
definition: A subset ontology that is designed for basic applications to continue to make certain simplifying assumptions; many of these simplifying assumptions were based on the initial version of the Gene Ontology, and have become enshrined in many popular and useful tools such as term enrichment tools. Examples of such assumptions include: traversing the ontology graph ignoring relationship types using a naive algorithm will not lead to cycles (i.e. the ontology is a DAG); every referenced term is declared in the ontology (i.e. there are no dangling clauses). An ontology is OBO Basic if and only if it has the following characteristics: DAG Unidirectional No Dangling Clauses Fully Asserted Fully Labeled No equivalence axioms Singly labeled edges No qualifier lists No disjointness axioms No owl-axioms header No imports

label: ontology module subsetted by OWL profile
agent-based matching process
definition: A matching process in which an autonomous agent plans and executes a multi-step workflow — typically involving tool use, retrieval, intermediate reasoning, and self-evaluation — to determine matches between entities. The agent decides at runtime what information to gather, which techniques to apply, and when to stop.

label: background knowledge-based matching process
definition: A matching process that exploits background knowledge from external resources, commonly referred to as background knowledge resources. This approach is also known as indirect matching, BK-based matching or context-based matching.

label: blank normalisation
definition: A normalization technique replacing all blank characters, such as space, tabulation, carriage return (or sequences of these) into a single blank character.

label: blocking
definition: A mapping activity that, given two sets of input entities, produces a reduced set of candidate entity pairs likely to match — favouring recall over precision — to be passed on to a downstream matching process.

label: bounded path matching
definition: A structural matching process based on the comparison of the matched super- and subclass paths (up to a bounded depth) of two candidate entities.

label: case normalization
definition: A normalization technique converting each alphabetic character in a string to their lower case counterpart.

label: composite matching process
definition: A matching process based on multiple, possibly intertwined, matching approaches.

label: diacritics suppression
definition: A normalization technique replacing diactritic signs (e.g. accents, hats) with their most frequent replacements.

label: digit suppression
definition: A normalization technique removing all numbers in a string.

label: embedding-based blocking
definition: A blocking process in which entities are encoded independently as vector embeddings and candidate pairs are produced by nearest-neighbour search or similarity-threshold filtering in the embedding space.

label: embedding-based matching process
definition: A machine learning-based matching process in which matches are identified by comparing learned vector representations (embeddings) of entities under a vector similarity measure.

label: graph representation learning-based matching process
definition: An embedding-based matching process in which matches are identified by comparing learned vector representations that encode the structural and semantic features of entities and their surrounding graph context.

label: instance-based matching process
definition: A matching process based on individual representations (or instances).

label: LLM-based matching process
definition: A machine learning-based matching process in which a large language model determines matches between entities, typically through single-step or few-shot prompting, or through fine-tuning the model to judge mapping candidates or generate mappings directly.

label: lemmatization
definition: The process of reducing the different forms of a word to one single form.

label: lexical matching process
definition: A matching process based on a lexical comparison between one or more syntactic features of the subject with one or more syntactic features of the object.

label: lexical similarity threshold-based matching process
definition: A lexical matching process based on a minimum threshold of a score from a comparison based on a lexical similarity algorithm.

label: link stripping
definition: A normalization technique replacing specific links between words, such as apostrophes, dashes, underscore, etc into dashes or blanks.

label: logical reasoning matching process
definition: A matching process based on the inferences made by a logical reasoner.

label: machine learning-based matching process
definition: A matching process in which matches between entities are predicted by machine learning models trained on labelled data or learned representations.

label: manual mapping curation
definition: A matching process that is performed by a human agent and is based on human judgement and domain knowledge.

label: mapping
definition: A triple <s,p,o> comprising a subject entity s, an object entity o and a mapping predicate p.

label: mapping activity
definition: A process that relates to the creation, confirmation, rejection or curation of a mapping.

label: mapping chaining-based matching process
definition: A matching process based on the traversing of multiple mappings.

label: mapping inversion-based matching process
definition: A matching process based on the inverting or flipping of the subject with the object of a mapping in accordance with the semantics of the mapping predicate.

label: mapping review
definition: A process that is concerned with determining if a mapping “candidate” (otherwise determined) is reasonable/correct.

label: matching process
definition: An process that results in a mapping between a subject and an object entity.

label: matching process post-processing
definition: A process applied to a set of mappings, usually with the intention of changing it.

label: matching process pre-processing
definition: A preliminary processing of inputs prior to performing matching.

label: normalization
definition: A family of preprocessing techniques for reducing strings to be compared to a common format.

label: punctuation elimination
definition: A normalization technique removing all punctation characters from a string.

label: regex removal
definition: A preprocessing method transforming a string by matching a regular expression and then removing that match.

label: regex replacement
definition: A preprocessing method transforming a string by matching a regular expression and then replacing that match with a specified substitution string.

label: semantic similarity threshold-based matching process
definition: A matching process based on a minimum threshold of a score from a comparison based on a semantic similarity algorithm.

label: similarity measure
definition: A technique for determining a score that characterises the similarity between two entities.

label: stemming
definition: The process of reducing a word to its word stem.

label: stop-word removal
definition: A preprocessing method transforming a string by removing a list of stop words.

label: string-based similarity measure
definition: A similarity measure based on the comparison of strings.

label: string equality
definition: A string-based similarity measure which involves determining if two strings associated with mapping entities are equal.

label: structural matching process
definition: Structural matching does not involve looking at "values" of properties.

label: transformer-based matching process
definition: An embedding-based matching process that uses transformer models to produce contextual vector representations of entity features for similarity comparison.

label: unspecified matching process
definition: A matching process based on an unspecified comparison.

label: cross-species broad match
definition: A match where the subject is considered analogous to the subject in a different taxonomic grouping, but the object refers to a broader concept.

label: cross-species close match
definition: A match where the subject and the object belong in different taxonomic groupings, but refer to concepts similar enough that they can be used interchangeably.

label: cross-species exact match
definition: A match where the subject is considered analogous to the object in a different taxonomic grouping.

label: cross-species narrow match
definition: A match where the subject is considered analogous to the subject in a different taxonomic grouping, but the object refers to a narrower concept.

label: isomorphic match
definition: A match where the subject is isomorphic to the object, i.e. considered of identical or similar form, shape, or structure.

label: non-isomorphic match
definition: A match where the subject cannot be considered isomorphic to the object, i.e. considered of identical or similar form, shape, or structure. The object corresponds to exactly one subject in the subject_source.

label: Accept
definition: Activity that identifies the acceptance of a resource (e.g., an article in a conference)

label: Activity
definition: An activity is something that occurs over a period of time and acts upon or with entities; it may include consuming, processing, transforming, modifying, relocating, using, or generating entities.

label: ActivityInfluence
definition: ActivityInfluence provides additional descriptions of an Activity's binary influence upon any other kind of resource. Instances of ActivityInfluence use the prov:activity property to cite the influencing Activity.

label: Agent
definition: An agent is something that bears some form of responsibility for an activity taking place, for the existence of an entity, or for another agent's activity.

label: AgentInfluence
definition: AgentInfluence provides additional descriptions of an Agent's binary influence upon any other kind of resource. Instances of AgentInfluence use the prov:agent property to cite the influencing Agent.

label: Association
definition: An activity association is an assignment of responsibility to an agent for an activity, indicating that the agent had a role in the activity. It further allows for a plan to be specified, which is the plan intended by the agent to achieve some goals in the context of this activity.

label: Attribution
definition: Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent. When an entity e is attributed to agent ag, entity e was generated by some unspecified activity that in turn was associated to agent ag. Thus, this relation is useful when the activity is not known, or irrelevant.

label: Bundle
definition: A bundle is a named set of provenance descriptions, and is itself an Entity, so allowing provenance of provenance to be expressed.

label: Collection
definition: A collection is an entity that provides a structure to some constituents, which are themselves entities. These constituents are said to be member of the collections.

label: Communication
definition: An instance of prov:Communication provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:wasInformedBy relation from an informed prov:Activity to the prov:Activity that informed it. For example, :you_jumping_off_bridge prov:wasInformedBy :everyone_else_jumping_off_bridge; prov:qualifiedCommunication [ a prov:Communication; prov:activity :everyone_else_jumping_off_bridge; :foo :bar ].

label: Contribute
definition: Activity that identifies any contribution of an agent to a resource.

label: Contributor
definition: Role with the function of having responsibility for making contributions to a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Modify or Create Activities

label: Copyright
definition: Activity that identifies the Copyrighting activity associated to a resource.

label: Create
definition: Activity that identifies the creation of a resource

label: Creator
definition: Role with the function of creating a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Create Activity

label: Delegation
definition: Delegation is the assignment of authority and responsibility to an agent (by itself or by another agent) to carry out a specific activity as a delegate or representative, while the agent it acts on behalf of retains some responsibility for the outcome of the delegated work. For example, a student acted on behalf of his supervisor, who acted on behalf of the department chair, who acted on behalf of the university; all those agents are responsible in some way for the activity that took place but we do not say explicitly who bears responsibility and to what degree.

label: Derivation
definition: A derivation is a transformation of an entity into another, an update of an entity resulting in a new one, or the construction of a new entity based on a pre-existing entity.

label: Dictionary
definition: A dictionary is an entity that provides a structure to some constituents, which are themselves entities. These constituents are said to be member of the dictionary.

label: ProvenanceService
definition: Type for a generic provenance query service. Mainly for use in RDF provenance query service descriptions, to facilitate discovery in linked data environments.

label: EmptyCollection
definition: An empty collection is a collection without members.

label: Empty Dictionary
definition: An empty dictionary (i.e. has no members).

label: End
definition: End is when an activity is deemed to have been ended by an entity, known as trigger. The activity no longer exists after its end. Any usage, generation, or invalidation involving an activity precedes the activity's end. An end may refer to a trigger entity that terminated the activity, or to an activity, known as ender that generated the trigger.

label: Entity
definition: An entity is a physical, digital, conceptual, or other kind of thing with some fixed aspects; entities may be real or imaginary.

label: EntityInfluence
definition: EntityInfluence provides additional descriptions of an Entity's binary influence upon any other kind of resource. Instances of EntityInfluence use the prov:entity property to cite the influencing Entity.

label: Generation
definition: Generation is the completion of production of a new entity by an activity. This entity did not exist before generation and becomes available for usage after this generation.

label: Influence
definition: Influence is the capacity of an entity, activity, or agent to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of usage, start, end, generation, invalidation, communication, derivation, attribution, association, or delegation.

label: Insertion
definition: Insertion is a derivation that transforms a dictionary into another, by insertion of one or more key-entity pairs.

label: InstantaneousEvent
definition: The PROV data model is implicitly based on a notion of instantaneous events (or just events), that mark transitions in the world. Events include generation, usage, or invalidation of entities, as well as starting or ending of activities. This notion of event is not first-class in the data model, but it is useful for explaining its other concepts and its semantics.

label: Invalidation
definition: An instance of prov:Invalidation provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:wasInvalidatedBy relation from an invalidated prov:Entity to the prov:Activity that invalidated it. For example, :uncracked_egg prov:wasInvalidatedBy :baking; prov:qualifiedInvalidation [ a prov:Invalidation; prov:activity :baking; :foo :bar ].

label: Key-Entity Pair
definition: A key-entity pair. Part of a prov:Dictionary through prov:hadDictionaryMember. The key is any RDF Literal, the value is a prov:Entity.

label: Location
definition: A location can be an identifiable geographic place (ISO 19112), but it can also be a non-geographic place such as a directory, row, or column. As such, there are numerous ways in which location can be expressed, such as by a coordinate, address, landmark, and so forth.

label: Modify
definition: Activity that identifies the modification of a resource.

label: Organization
definition: An organization is a social or legal institution such as a company, society, etc.

label: Person
definition: Person agents are people.

label: Plan
definition: There exist no prescriptive requirement on the nature of plans, their representation, the actions or steps they consist of, or their intended goals. Since plans may evolve over time, it may become necessary to track their provenance, so plans themselves are entities. Representing the plan explicitly in the provenance can be useful for various tasks: for example, to validate the execution as represented in the provenance record, to manage expectation failures, or to provide explanations.

label: PrimarySource
definition: A primary source for a topic refers to something produced by some agent with direct experience and knowledge about the topic, at the time of the topic's study, without benefit from hindsight. Because of the directness of primary sources, they 'speak for themselves' in ways that cannot be captured through the filter of secondary sources. As such, it is important for secondary sources to reference those primary sources from which they were derived, so that their reliability can be investigated. A primary source relation is a particular case of derivation of secondary materials from their primary sources. It is recognized that the determination of primary sources can be up to interpretation, and should be done according to conventions accepted within the application's domain.

label: Publish
definition: Activity that identifies the publication of a resource

label: Publisher
definition: Role with the function of publishing a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Publish Activity

label: Quotation
definition: A quotation is the repeat of (some or all of) an entity, such as text or image, by someone who may or may not be its original author. Quotation is a particular case of derivation.

label: Removal
definition: Removal is a derivation that transforms a dictionary into another, by removing one or more key-entity pairs.

label: Replace
definition: Activity that identifies the replacement of a resource.

label: Revision
definition: A revision is a derivation for which the resulting entity is a revised version of some original. The implication here is that the resulting entity contains substantial content from the original. Revision is a particular case of derivation.

label: RightsAssignment
definition: Activity that identifies the rights assignment of a resource.

label: RightsHolder
definition: Role with the function of owning or managing rights over a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a RightsAssignment Activity

label: Role
definition: A role is the function of an entity or agent with respect to an activity, in the context of a usage, generation, invalidation, association, start, and end.

label: ServiceDescription
definition: Type for a generic provenance query service. Mainly for use in RDF provenance query service descriptions, to facilitate discovery in linked data environments.

label: SoftwareAgent
definition: A software agent is running software.

label: Start
definition: Start is when an activity is deemed to have been started by an entity, known as trigger. The activity did not exist before its start. Any usage, generation, or invalidation involving an activity follows the activity's start. A start may refer to a trigger entity that set off the activity, or to an activity, known as starter, that generated the trigger.

label: Submit
definition: Activity that identifies the issuance (e.g., publication) of a resource.

label: Usage
definition: Usage is the beginning of utilizing an entity by an activity. Before usage, the activity had not begun to utilize this entity and could not have been affected by the entity.

label: actedOnBehalfOf
definition: An object property to express the accountability of an agent towards another agent. The subordinate agent acted on behalf of the responsible agent in an actual activity.

label: alternateOf
definition: Two alternate entities present aspects of the same thing. These aspects may be the same or different, and the alternate entities may or may not overlap in time.

label: asInBundle
definition: prov:asInBundle is used to specify which bundle the general entity of a prov:mentionOf property is described. When :x prov:mentionOf :y and :y is described in Bundle :b, the triple :x prov:asInBundle :b is also asserted to cite the Bundle in which :y was described.

label: atLocation
definition: The Location of any resource.

label: atTime
definition: The time at which an InstantaneousEvent occurred, in the form of xsd:dateTime.

Classify prov-o terms into three categories, including 'starting-point', 'qualifed', and 'extended'. This classification is used by the prov-o html document to gently introduce prov-o terms to its users.

Classify prov-o terms into six components according to prov-dm, including 'agents-responsibility', 'alternate', 'annotations', 'collections', 'derivations', and 'entities-activities'. This classification is used so that readers of prov-o specification can find its correspondence with the prov-dm specification.
A reference to the principal section of the PROV-CONSTRAINTS document that describes this concept.
A definition quoted from PROV-DM or PROV-CONSTRAINTS that describes the concept expressed with this OWL term.

label: derivedByInsertionFrom
definition: The dictionary was derived from the other by insertion. prov:qualifiedInsertion shows details of the insertion, in particular the inserted key-entity pairs.

label: derivedByRemovalFrom
definition: The dictionary was derived from the other by removal. prov:qualifiedRemoval shows details of the removal, in particular the removed key-entity pairs.

label: describesService
definition: relates a generic provenance query service resource (type prov:ServiceDescription) to a specific query service description (e.g. a prov:DirectQueryService or a sd:Service).

label: dictionary
definition: The property used by a prov:Insertion and prov:Removal to cite the prov:Dictionary that was prov:derivedByInsertionFrom or prov:derivedByRemovalFrom another dictionary.
A reference to the principal section of the PROV-DM document that describes this concept.
A note by the OWL development team about how this term expresses the PROV-DM concept, or how it should be used in context of semantic web or linked data.
When the prov-o term does not have a definition drawn from prov-dm, and the prov-o editor provides one.

label: endedAtTime
definition: The time at which an activity ended. See also prov:startedAtTime.

label: generatedAtTime
definition: The time at which an entity was completely created and is available for use.

label: hadActivity
definition: The _optional_ Activity of an Influence, which used, generated, invalidated, or was the responsibility of some Entity. This property is _not_ used by ActivityInfluence (use prov:activity instead).

label: hadDictionaryMember
definition: Describes the key-entity pair that was member of a prov:Dictionary. A dictionary can have multiple members.

label: hadGeneration
definition: The _optional_ Generation involved in an Entity's Derivation.

label: hadPlan
definition: The _optional_ Plan adopted by an Agent in Association with some Activity. Plan specifications are out of the scope of this specification.

label: hadPrimarySource
definition: [definition of prov:PrimarySource] A primary source for a topic refers to something produced by some agent with direct experience and knowledge about the topic, at the time of the topic's study, without benefit from hindsight. Because of the directness of primary sources, they 'speak for themselves' in ways that cannot be captured through the filter of secondary sources. As such, it is important for secondary sources to reference those primary sources from which they were derived, so that their reliability can be investigated. A primary source relation is a particular case of derivation of secondary materials from their primary sources. It is recognized that the determination of primary sources can be up to interpretation, and should be done according to conventions accepted within the application's domain.

label: hadRole
definition: The _optional_ Role that an Entity assumed in the context of an Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon; prov:qualified [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :spoon; prov:hadRole roles:mixing_implement ].

label: hadUsage
definition: The _optional_ Usage involved in an Entity's Derivation.

label: has_anchor
definition: Indicates anchor URI for a potentially dynamic resource instance.

label: has_provenance
definition: Indicates a provenance-URI for a resource; the resource identified by this property presents a provenance record about its subject or anchor resource.

label: hasProvenanceService
definition: Indicates a provenance query service that can access provenance related to its subject or anchor resource.

label: influencer
definition: Subproperties of prov:influencer are used to cite the object of an unqualified PROV-O triple whose predicate is a subproperty of prov:wasInfluencedBy (e.g. prov:used, prov:wasGeneratedBy). prov:influencer is used much like rdf:object is used.

label: insertedKeyEntityPair
definition: An object property to refer to the prov:KeyEntityPair inserted into a prov:Dictionary.

label: invalidatedAtTime
definition: The time at which an entity was invalidated (i.e., no longer usable).

PROV-O does not define all property inverses. The directionalities defined in PROV-O should be given preference over those not defined. However, if users wish to name the inverse of a PROV-O property, the local name given by prov:inverse should be used.

label: mentionOf
definition: prov:mentionOf is used to specialize an entity as described in another bundle. It is to be used in conjuction with prov:asInBundle. prov:asInBundle is used to cite the Bundle in which the generalization was mentioned.
A reference to the principal section of the PROV-DM document that describes this concept.

The position that this OWL term should be listed within documentation. The scope of the documentation (e.g., among all terms, among terms within a prov:category, among properties applying to a particular class, etc.) is unspecified.

label: pairKey
definition: The value of a KeyEntityPair.

label: pairKey
definition: The key of a KeyEntityPair, which is an element of a prov:Dictionary.

label: provenance pingback
definition: Relates a resource to a provenance pingback service that may receive additional provenance links about the resource.

label: provenanceUriTemplate
definition: Relates a provenance service to a URI template string for constructing provenance-URIs.

label: qualifiedAssociation
definition: If this Activity prov:wasAssociatedWith Agent :ag, then it can qualify the Association using prov:qualifiedAssociation [ a prov:Association; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedAttribution
definition: If this Entity prov:wasAttributedTo Agent :ag, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedAttribution [ a prov:Attribution; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedCommunication
definition: If this Activity prov:wasInformedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedCommunication [ a prov:Communication; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedDelegation
definition: If this Agent prov:actedOnBehalfOf Agent :ag, then it can qualify how with prov:qualifiedResponsibility [ a prov:Responsibility; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedDerivation
definition: If this Entity prov:wasDerivedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was derived using prov:qualifiedDerivation [ a prov:Derivation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedEnd
definition: If this Activity prov:wasEndedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was ended using prov:qualifiedEnd [ a prov:End; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ].

This annotation property links a subproperty of prov:wasInfluencedBy with the subclass of prov:Influence and the qualifying property that are used to qualify it. Example annotation: prov:wasGeneratedBy prov:qualifiedForm prov:qualifiedGeneration, prov:Generation . Then this unqualified assertion: :entity1 prov:wasGeneratedBy :activity1 . can be qualified by adding: :entity1 prov:qualifiedGeneration :entity1Gen . :entity1Gen a prov:Generation, prov:Influence; prov:activity :activity1; :customValue 1337 . Note how the value of the unqualified influence (prov:wasGeneratedBy :activity1) is mirrored as the value of the prov:activity (or prov:entity, or prov:agent) property on the influence class.

label: qualifiedGeneration
definition: If this Activity prov:generated Entity :e, then it can qualify how it performed the Generation using prov:qualifiedGeneration [ a prov:Generation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedInfluence
definition: Because prov:qualifiedInfluence is a broad relation, the more specific relations (qualifiedCommunication, qualifiedDelegation, qualifiedEnd, etc.) should be used when applicable.

label: qualifiedInsertion
definition: The dictionary was derived from the other by insertion. prov:qualifiedInsertion shows details of the insertion, in particular the inserted key-entity pairs.

label: qualifiedInvalidation
definition: If this Entity prov:wasInvalidatedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was invalidated using prov:qualifiedInvalidation [ a prov:Invalidation; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedPrimarySource
definition: If this Entity prov:hadPrimarySource Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedPrimarySource [ a prov:PrimarySource; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedQuotation
definition: If this Entity prov:wasQuotedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedQuotation [ a prov:Quotation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedRemoval
definition: The dictionary was derived from the other by removal. prov:qualifiedRemoval shows details of the removal, in particular the removed keys.

label: qualifiedRevision
definition: If this Entity prov:wasRevisionOf Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was revised using prov:qualifiedRevision [ a prov:Revision; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedStart
definition: If this Activity prov:wasStartedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was started using prov:qualifiedStart [ a prov:Start; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ].

label: qualifiedUsage
definition: If this Activity prov:used Entity :e, then it can qualify how it used it using prov:qualifiedUsage [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

label: removedKey
definition: The key removed in a Removal.

label: specializationOf
definition: An entity that is a specialization of another shares all aspects of the latter, and additionally presents more specific aspects of the same thing as the latter. In particular, the lifetime of the entity being specialized contains that of any specialization. Examples of aspects include a time period, an abstraction, and a context associated with the entity.

label: startedAtTime
definition: The time at which an activity started. See also prov:endedAtTime.
Classes and properties used to qualify relationships are annotated with prov:unqualifiedForm to indicate the property used to assert an unqualified provenance relation.

label: used
definition: A prov:Entity that was used by this prov:Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon, :egg, :oven .

label: value
definition: Provides a value that is a direct representation of an entity.

label: wasAssociatedWith
definition: An prov:Agent that had some (unspecified) responsibility for the occurrence of this prov:Activity.

label: wasAttributedTo
definition: Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent.

label: wasDerivedFrom
definition: A derivation is a transformation of an entity into another, an update of an entity resulting in a new one, or the construction of a new entity based on a pre-existing entity.

label: wasEndedBy
definition: End is when an activity is deemed to have ended. An end may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that terminated the activity.

label: wasGeneratedBy
definition: [definition of prov:Generation] Generation is the completion of production of a new entity by an activity. This entity did not exist before generation and becomes available for usage after this generation.

label: wasInfluencedBy
definition: Because prov:wasInfluencedBy is a broad relation, its more specific subproperties (e.g. prov:wasInformedBy, prov:actedOnBehalfOf, prov:wasEndedBy, etc.) should be used when applicable.

label: wasInformedBy
definition: An activity a2 is dependent on or informed by another activity a1, by way of some unspecified entity that is generated by a1 and used by a2.

label: wasInvalidatedBy
definition: [definition of prov:Invalidation] An instance of prov:Invalidation provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:wasInvalidatedBy relation from an invalidated prov:Entity to the prov:Activity that invalidated it. For example, :uncracked_egg prov:wasInvalidatedBy :baking; prov:qualifiedInvalidation [ a prov:Invalidation; prov:activity :baking; :foo :bar ].

label: wasQuotedFrom
definition: An entity is derived from an original entity by copying, or 'quoting', some or all of it.

label: wasRevisionOf
definition: A revision is a derivation that revises an entity into a revised version.

label: wasStartedBy
definition: Start is when an activity is deemed to have started. A start may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that initiated the activity.

label: Annotation
definition: The class for Web Annotations.

label: Choice
definition: A subClass of as:OrderedCollection that conveys to a consuming application that it should select one of the resources in the as:items list to use, rather than all of them. This is typically used to provide a choice of resources to render to the user, based on further supplied properties. If the consuming application cannot determine the user's preference, then it should use the first in the list.

label: CssSelector
definition: A CssSelector describes a Segment of interest in a representation that conforms to the Document Object Model through the use of the CSS selector specification.

label: CssStyle
definition: A resource which describes styles for resources participating in the Annotation using CSS.

label: DataPositionSelector
definition: DataPositionSelector describes a range of data by recording the start and end positions of the selection in the stream. Position 0 would be immediately before the first byte, position 1 would be immediately before the second byte, and so on. The start byte is thus included in the list, but the end byte is not.

label: Direction
definition: A class to encapsulate the different text directions that a textual resource might take. It is not used directly in the Annotation Model, only its three instances.

label: FragmentSelector
definition: The FragmentSelector class is used to record the segment of a representation using the IRI fragment specification defined by the representation's media type.

label: HttpRequestState
definition: The HttpRequestState class is used to record the HTTP request headers that a client SHOULD use to request the correct representation from the resource.

label: Motivation
definition: The Motivation class is used to record the user's intent or motivation for the creation of the Annotation, or the inclusion of the body or target, that it is associated with.

label: PreferContainedDescriptions
definition: An IRI to signal the client prefers to receive full descriptions of the Annotations from a container, not just their IRIs.

label: PreferContainedIRIs
definition: An IRI to signal that the client prefers to receive only the IRIs of the Annotations from a container, not their full descriptions.

label: RangeSelector
definition: A Range Selector can be used to identify the beginning and the end of the selection by using other Selectors. The selection consists of everything from the beginning of the starting selector through to the beginning of the ending selector, but not including it.

label: ResourceSelection
definition: Instances of the ResourceSelection class identify part (described by an oa:Selector) of another resource (referenced with oa:hasSource), possibly from a particular representation of a resource (described by an oa:State). Please note that ResourceSelection is not used directly in the Web Annotation model, but is provided as a separate class for further application profiles to use, separate from oa:SpecificResource which has many Annotation specific features.

label: Selector
definition: A resource which describes the segment of interest in a representation of a Source resource, indicated with oa:hasSelector from the Specific Resource. This class is not used directly in the Annotation model, only its subclasses.

label: SpecificResource
definition: Instances of the SpecificResource class identify part of another resource (referenced with oa:hasSource), a particular representation of a resource, a resource with styling hints for renders, or any combination of these, as used within an Annotation.

label: State
definition: A State describes the intended state of a resource as applied to the particular Annotation, and thus provides the information needed to retrieve the correct representation of that resource.

label: Style
definition: A Style describes the intended styling of a resource as applied to the particular Annotation, and thus provides the information to ensure that rendering is consistent across implementations.

label: SvgSelector
definition: An SvgSelector defines an area through the use of the Scalable Vector Graphics [SVG] standard. This allows the user to select a non-rectangular area of the content, such as a circle or polygon by describing the region using SVG. The SVG may be either embedded within the Annotation or referenced as an External Resource.

label: TextPositionSelector
definition: The TextPositionSelector describes a range of text by recording the start and end positions of the selection in the stream. Position 0 would be immediately before the first character, position 1 would be immediately before the second character, and so on.

label: TextQuoteSelector
definition: The TextQuoteSelector describes a range of text by copying it, and including some of the text immediately before (a prefix) and after (a suffix) it to distinguish between multiple copies of the same sequence of characters.

label: TimeState
definition: A TimeState records the time at which the resource's state is appropriate for the Annotation, typically the time that the Annotation was created and/or a link to a persistent copy of the current version.

label: XPathSelector
definition: An XPathSelector is used to select elements and content within a resource that supports the Document Object Model via a specified XPath value.

label: annotationService
definition: The object of the relationship is the end point of a service that conforms to the annotation-protocol, and it may be associated with any resource. The expectation of asserting the relationship is that the object is the preferred service for maintaining annotations about the subject resource, according to the publisher of the relationship. This relationship is intended to be used both within Linked Data descriptions and as the rel type of a Link, via HTTP Link Headers rfc5988 for binary resources and in HTML <link> elements. For more information about these, please see the Annotation Protocol specification annotation-protocol.

label: assessing
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to provide an assessment about the Target resource.

label: bodyValue
definition: The object of the predicate is a plain text string to be used as the content of the body of the Annotation. The value MUST be an xsd:string and that data type MUST NOT be expressed in the serialization. Note that language MUST NOT be associated with the value either as a language tag, as that is only available for rdf:langString .

label: bookmarking
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to create a bookmark to the Target or part thereof.

label: cachedSource
definition: A object of the relationship is a copy of the Source resource's representation, appropriate for the Annotation.

label: canonical
definition: A object of the relationship is the canonical IRI that can always be used to deduplicate the Annotation, regardless of the current IRI used to access the representation.

label: classifying
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to that classify the Target as something.

label: commenting
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to comment about the Target.

label: describing
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to describe the Target, as opposed to a comment about them.

label: editing
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to request a change or edit to the Target resource.

label: end
definition: The end property is used to convey the 0-based index of the end position of a range of content.

label: exact
definition: The object of the predicate is a copy of the text which is being selected, after normalization.

label: hasBody
definition: The object of the relationship is a resource that is a body of the Annotation.

label: hasEndSelector
definition: The relationship between a RangeSelector and the Selector that describes the end position of the range.

label: hasPurpose
definition: The purpose served by the resource in the Annotation.

label: hasScope
definition: The scope or context in which the resource is used within the Annotation.

label: hasSelector
definition: The object of the relationship is a Selector that describes the segment or region of interest within the source resource. Please note that the domain ( oa:ResourceSelection ) is not used directly in the Web Annotation model.

label: hasSource
definition: The resource that the ResourceSelection, or its subclass SpecificResource, is refined from, or more specific than. Please note that the domain ( oa:ResourceSelection ) is not used directly in the Web Annotation model.

label: hasStartSelector
definition: The relationship between a RangeSelector and the Selector that describes the start position of the range.

label: hasState
definition: The relationship between the ResourceSelection, or its subclass SpecificResource, and a State resource. Please note that the domain ( oa:ResourceSelection ) is not used directly in the Web Annotation model.

label: hasTarget
definition: The relationship between an Annotation and its Target.

label: highlighting
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to highlight the Target resource or segment of it.

label: identifying
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to assign an identity to the Target or identify what is being depicted or described in the Target.

label: linking
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to link to a resource related to the Target.

label: ltrDirection
definition: The direction of text that is read from left to right.

label: moderating
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to assign some value or quality to the Target.

label: motivatedBy
definition: The relationship between an Annotation and a Motivation that describes the reason for the Annotation's creation.

label: prefix
definition: The object of the property is a snippet of content that occurs immediately before the content which is being selected by the Selector.

label: processingLanguage
definition: The object of the property is the language that should be used for textual processing algorithms when dealing with the content of the resource, including hyphenation, line breaking, which font to use for rendering and so forth. The value must follow the recommendations of BCP47.

label: questioning
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to ask a question about the Target.

label: refinedBy
definition: The relationship between a Selector and another Selector or a State and a Selector or State that should be applied to the results of the first to refine the processing of the source resource.

label: renderedVia
definition: A system that was used by the application that created the Annotation to render the resource.

label: replying
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to reply to a previous statement, either an Annotation or another resource.

label: rtlDirection
definition: The direction of text that is read from right to left.

label: sourceDate
definition: The timestamp at which the Source resource should be interpreted as being applicable to the Annotation.

label: sourceDateEnd
definition: The end timestamp of the interval over which the Source resource should be interpreted as being applicable to the Annotation.

label: sourceDateStart
definition: The start timestamp of the interval over which the Source resource should be interpreted as being applicable to the Annotation.

label: start
definition: The start position in a 0-based index at which a range of content is selected from the data in the source resource.

label: styleClass
definition: The name of the class used in the CSS description referenced from the Annotation that should be applied to the Specific Resource.

label: styledBy
definition: A reference to a Stylesheet that should be used to apply styles to the Annotation rendering.

label: suffix
definition: The snippet of text that occurs immediately after the text which is being selected.

label: tagging
definition: The motivation for when the user intends to associate a tag with the Target.

label: textDirection
definition: The direction of the text of the subject resource. There MUST only be one text direction associated with any given resource.

label: via
definition: A object of the relationship is a resource from which the source resource was retrieved by the providing system.

label: Category
definition: Represents a group of quality dimensions in which a common type of information is used as quality indicator.

label: Dimension
definition: Represents criteria relevant for assessing quality. Each quality dimension must have one or more metric to measure it. A dimension is linked with a category using the dqv:inCategory property.

label: Metric
definition: Represents a standard to measure a quality dimension. An observation (instance of dqv:QualityMeasurement) assigns a value in a given unit to a Metric.

label: Quality Annotation
definition: Represents quality annotations, including ratings, quality certificates or feedback that can be associated to datasets or distributions. Quality annotations must have one oa:motivatedBy statement with an instance of oa:Motivation (and skos:Concept) that reflects a quality assessment purpose. We define this instance as dqv:qualityAssessment.

label: Quality Certificate
definition: An annotation that associates a resource (especially, a dataset or a distribution) to another resource (for example, a document) that certifies the resource's quality according to a set of quality assessment rules.

label: Quality Measurement
definition: Represents the evaluation of a given dataset (or dataset distribution) against a specific quality metric.

label: Quality Measurement Dataset
definition: Represents a dataset of quality measurements, evaluations of one or more datasets (or dataset distributions) against specific quality metrics.

label: Quality Metadata
definition: Represents quality metadata, it is defined to group quality certificates, policies, measurements and annotations under a named graph.

label: Quality Policy
definition: Represents a policy or agreement that is chiefly governed by data quality concerns.

label: User Quality feedback
definition: Represents feedback that users have on the quality of datasets or distributions. Besides dqv:qualityAssessment, which is the motivation required by all quality annotations, one of the predefined instances of oa:Motivation should be indicated as motivation to distinguish among the different kinds of feedback, e.g., classifications, questions.

label: computed on
definition: Refers to the resource (e.g., a dataset, a linkset, a graph, a set of triples) on which the quality measurement is performed. In the DQV context, this property is generally expected to be used in statements in which objects are instances of dcat:Dataset or dcat:Distribution.

label: expected data type
definition: Represents the expected data type for metric's observed value (e.g. xsd:boolean, xsd:double etc...)

label: has quality annotation
definition: Refers to a quality annotation. Quality annotation can be applied to any kind of resource, e.g., a dataset, a linkset, a graph, a set of triples. However, in the DQV context, this property is generally expected to be used in statements in which subjects are instances of dcat:Dataset or dcat:Distribution.

label: has quality measurement
definition: Refers to the performed quality measurements. Quality measurements can be performed to any kind of resource (e.g., a dataset, a linkset, a graph, a set of triples). However, in the DQV context, this property is generally expected to be used in statements in which subjects are instances of dcat:Dataset or dcat:Distribution.

label: has quality metadata
definition: Refers to a grouping of quality information such as certificates, policies, measurements and annotations as a named graph. Quality information represented in such a grouping can pertain to any kind of resource (e.g., a dataset, a linkset, a graph, a set of triples). However, in the DQV context, this property is generally expected to be used in statements in which subjects are instances of dcat:Dataset or dcat:Distribution.

label: in category
definition: Represents the category a dimension is grouped in.

label: in dimension
definition: Represents the dimensions a quality metric, certificate and annotation allow a measurement of.

label: is measurement of
definition: Indicates the metric being observed.

label: Precision
definition: Precision is a quality dimension, which refers to the recorded level of details. It represents the exactness of a measurement or description. It is equivalent the notion of Precision from ISO 25012.

label: Quality assessment
definition: Motivation that must be specified for quality annotations.

label: value
definition: Refers to values computed by metric.

label: Rating Feedback
definition: Predefined criteria used to express a user opinion about a dataset or distribution using a discrete range of values.

label: Usage
definition: A helpful description of actions that can be performed on a given dataset or distribution.

label: UsageTool
definition: A synopsis describing the way a tool can use a dataset or distribution.

label: User Feedback
definition: User feedback on the dataset. Expresses whether the dataset was useful or not, for example.

label: has distributor
definition: The distributor is the organization that makes the dataset available for downloading and use.

label: has dataset feedback
definition: User feedback associated with Dataset or distribution

label: has rating
definition: Rating Feedback has rating opinion

label: has dataset/distribution usage
definition: Dataset/distribution usage guidance or instructions.

label: has usage tool
definition: Describes the tool that provides the Usage

label: refers to dataset
definition: Dataset associated with Usage.

label: affilation self citation
definition: A citation in which at least one author from each of the citing and the cited entities is affiliated with the same academic institution.

label: author network self citation
definition: A citation in which at least one author of the citing entity has direct or indirect co-authorship links with one of the authors of the cited entity.

label: author self citation
definition: A citation in which the citing and the cited entities have at least one author in common.

label: citation
definition: A citation is a conceptual directional link from a citing entity to a cited entity, created by a human performative act of making a citation, typically instantiated by the inclusion of a bibliographic reference (`biro:BibliographicReference`) in the reference list of the citing entity, or by the inclusion within the citing entity of a link, in the form of an HTTP Uniform Resource Locator (URL), to a resource on the World Wide Web.

label: distant citation
definition: A citation in which the citing and the cited entities have nothing significant in common with one another (for example authors, journal, institutional affiliation, or funding agency) over and beyond their subject matter.

label: funder self citation
definition: A citation in which the works reported in the citing and the cited entities were funded by the same funding agency.

label: journal cartel citation
definition: A citation from one journal to another journal which forms one of a very large number of citations from the citing journal to recent articles in the cited journal, possibly undertaken as part of a citation cartel for the purpose of gaming the impact factor of the cited journal.

label: journal self citation
definition: A citation in which the citing and the cited entities are published in the same journal.

label: self citation
definition: A citation in which the citing and the cited entities have something significant in common with one another, over and beyond their subject matter, for example authors, journal, institutional affiliation, or funding agency.

label: agrees with
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity agrees with statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: cites
definition: A relation according to which a citing entity cites a cited entity, either directly and explicitly (as in the reference list of a journal article), indirectly (e.g. by citing a more recent paper by the same group on the same topic), or implicitly (e.g. as in artistic quotations or parodies, or in cases of plagiarism).

label: cites as authority
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as one that provides an authoritative description or definition of the subject under discussion.

label: cites as data source
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as source of data.

label: cites as evidence
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as source of factual evidence for statements it contains.

label: cites as metadata document
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as being the container of metadata describing the citing entity.

label: cites as potential solution
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as providing or containing a possible solution to the issues being discussed.

label: cites as recommended reading
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as an item of recommended reading.

label: cites as related
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as one that is related.

label: cites as source document
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as being the entity from which the citing entity is derived, or about which the citing entity contains metadata.

label: cites for information
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity cites the cited entity as a source of information on the subject under discussion.

label: compiles
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity is used to create or compile the cited entity.

label: confirms
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity confirms facts, ideas or statements presented in the cited entity.

label: contains assertion from
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity contains a statement of fact or a logical assertion (or a collection of such facts and/or assertions) originally present in the cited entity.

label: corrects
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity corrects statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: credits
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity acknowledges contributions made by the cited entity.

label: critiques
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity critiques statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: derides
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity express derision for the cited entity, or for ideas or conclusions contained within it.

label: describes
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity describes the cited entity.

label: disagrees with
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity disagrees with statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: discusses
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity discusses statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: disputes
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity disputes statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: documents
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity documents information about the cited entity.

label: extends
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity extends facts, ideas or understandings presented in the cited entity.

label: gives background to
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity provides background information for the citing entity.

label: gives support to
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity provides intellectual or factual support for the citing entity.

label: has citation characterization
definition: A relation between a citation and its characterization, made by using a CiTO citation characterization property.

label: has citation creation date
definition: The date on which the citation was created. This has the same numerical value as the publication date of the citing bibliographic resource, but is a property of the citation itself. When combined with the citation time span, it permits that citation to be located in history.

label: has citation time span
definition: The temporal characteristic of a citation, namely the interval between the publication date of the cited entity and the publication date of the citing entity. Note that when one or both of the publication dates is given as just 'year', then the citation time span is rounded to the nearest year, and when one or both of the publication dates is given as just 'year and month', then the citation time span is rounded to the nearest month, with the inherent inaccuracies that such rounding involves.

label: has cited entity
definition: A relation between a citation and the cited entity.

label: has citing entity
definition: A relation between a citation and the citing entity.

label: has co-authorship citation level
definition: The minimal distance that one of the authors of the citing entity has with regards to one of the authors of the cited entity, according to their co-authorship network.

label: has reply from
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity evokes a reply from the citing entity.

label: includes excerpt from
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity includes one or more excerpts from the cited entity.

label: includes quotation from
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity includes one or more quotations from the cited entity.

label: is agreed with by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity contains statements, ideas or conclusions with which the citing entity agrees.

label: is citation characterization of
definition: A relation between the characterization of a citation, made by using a CiTO citation characterization property, and that citation.

label: is cited as authority by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited as providing an authoritative description or definition of the subject under discussion in the citing entity.

label: is cited as data source by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited as a data source by the citing entity.

label: is cited as evidence by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited for providing factual evidence to the citing entity.

label: is cited as metadata document by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited as being the container of metadata relating to the citing entity.

label: is cited as potential solution by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited as providing or containing a possible solution to the issues being discussed in the citing entity.

label: is cited as recommended reading by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited by the citing entity as an item of recommended reading.

label: is cited as related by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited as being related to the citing entity.

label: is cited as source document by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited as being the entity from which the citing entity is derived, or about which the citing entity contains metadata.

label: is cited by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited by the citing entity.

label: is cited entity of
definition: A relation between a cited entity and a citation.

label: is cited for information by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited as a source of information on the subject under discussion in the citing entity.

label: is citing entity of
definition: A relation between a citing entity and a citation.

label: is compiled by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is the result of a compile or creation event using the citing entity.

label: is confirmed by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents facts, ideas or statements that are confirmed by the citing entity.

label: is corrected by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are corrected by the citing entity.

label: is credited by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity makes contributions that are acknowledged by the citing entity.

label: is critiqued by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are critiqued by the citing entity.

label: is derided by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity contains ideas or conclusions for which the citing entity express derision.

label: is described by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is described by the citing entity.

label: is disagreed with by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are disagreed with by the citing entity.

label: is discussed by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are discussed by the citing entity.

label: is disputed by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are disputed by the citing entity.

label: is documented by
definition: Information about the cited entity is documented by the citing entity.

label: is extended by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents facts, ideas or understandings that are extended by the citing entity.

label: is linked to by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is the target for an HTTP Uniform Resource Locator (URL) link within the citing entity.

label: is parodied by
definition: The characteristic style or content of the cited entity is imitated by the citing entity for comic effect, usually without explicit citation.

label: is plagiarized by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is plagiarized by the author of the citing entity, who includes within the citing entity textual or other elements from the cited entity without formal acknowledgement of their source. The cited entity is thus not explicitly cited from within the citing entity, according to the norms of scholarly practice, but is cited implicitly.

label: is qualified by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are qualified or have conditions placed upon them by the citing entity.

label: is refuted by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are refuted by the citing entity.

label: is retracted by
