definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is formally retracted by the citing entity.

label: is reviewed by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas or conclusions that are reviewed by the citing entity.

label: is ridiculed by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity or aspects of its contents are ridiculed by the citing entity.

label: is speculated on by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity is cited because the citing article contains speculations on its content or ideas.

label: is supported by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity receives intellectual or factual support from the citing entity.

label: is updated by
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents statements, ideas, hypotheses or understanding that are updated by the citing entity.

label: likes
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity shows appreciation of or interest in the cited entity.

label: links to
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity provides a link, in the form of an HTTP Uniform Resource Locator (URL), to the cited entity.

label: obtains background from
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity obtains background information from the cited entity.

label: obtains support from
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity obtains intellectual or factual support from the cited entity.

label: parodies
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity imitates the characteristic style or content of the cited entity for comic effect, usually without explicit citation.

label: plagiarizes
definition: A property indicating that the author of the citing entity plagiarizes the cited entity, by including textual or other elements from the cited entity without formal acknowledgement of their source. The citing entity thus contains no explicit citation of the cited entity, according to the norms of scholarly practice, but cites it implicitly.

label: provides assertion for
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity contains and is the original source of a statement of fact or a logical assertion (or a collection of such facts and/or assertions) that is to be found in the citing entity. This inverse object property is designed to be used to relate a cited entity to a separate abstract, summary or nanopublication based upon it.

label: provides conclusions for
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents conclusions that are used in work described in the citing entity.

label: provides data for
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity presents data that are used in work described in the citing entity.

label: provides excerpt for
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity contains information, usually of a textual nature, that is excerpted by (used as an excerpt within) the citing entity.

label: provides method for
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity details a method that is used in work described by the citing entity.

label: provides quotation for
definition: A relation according to which the cited entity contains information, usually of a textual nature, that is quoted by (used as a quotation within) the citing entity.

label: qualifies
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity qualifies or places conditions or restrictions upon statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: refutes
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity refutes statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: replies to
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity replies to statements, ideas or criticisms presented in the cited entity.

label: retracts
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity constitutes a formal retraction of the cited entity.

label: reviews
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity reviews statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: ridicules
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity ridicules the cited entity or aspects of its contents.

label: shares author institution with
definition: A relation according to which each entity has at least one author that shares a common institutional affiliation with an author of the other entity.

label: shares author with
definition: A relation according to which each entity has at least one author in common with the other entity.

label: shares funding agency with
definition: A relation according to which two entities result from activities that have been funded by the same funding agency.

label: shares journal with
definition: A relation according to which the citing and cited bibliographic resources are published in the same journal.

label: shares publication venue with
definition: A relation according to which the citing and cited bibliographic resources are published in same publication venue.

label: speculates on
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity speculates on something within or related to the cited entity, without firm evidence.

label: supports
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity provides intellectual or factual support for statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: updates
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity updates statements, ideas, hypotheses or understanding presented in the cited entity.

label: uses conclusions from
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity describes work that uses conclusions presented in the cited entity.

label: uses data from
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity describes work that uses data presented in the cited entity.

label: uses method in
definition: A relation according to which the citing entity describes work that uses a method detailed in the cited entity.

label: Academic Article
definition: A scholarly academic article, typically published in a journal.

label: Article
definition: A written composition in prose, usually nonfiction, on a specific topic, forming an independent part of a book or other publication, as a newspaper or magazine.

label: audio document
definition: An audio document; aka record.

label: audio-visual document
definition: An audio-visual document; film, video, and so forth.

label: Bill
definition: Draft legislation presented for discussion to a legal body.

label: Book
definition: A written or printed work of fiction or nonfiction, usually on sheets of paper fastened or bound together within covers.

label: Book Section
definition: A section of a book.

label: Brief
definition: A written argument submitted to a court.

label: Chapter
definition: A chapter of a book.

label: Code
definition: A collection of statutes.

label: Collected Document
definition: A document that simultaneously contains other documents.

label: Collection
definition: A collection of Documents or Collections

label: Conference
definition: A meeting for consultation or discussion.

label: Court Reporter
definition: A collection of legal cases.

label: Document
definition: A document (noun) is a bounded physical representation of body of information designed with the capacity (and usually intent) to communicate. A document may manifest symbolic, diagrammatic or sensory-representational information.

label: document part
definition: a distinct part of a larger document or collected document.

label: Document Status
definition: The status of the publication of a document.

label: Edited Book
definition: An edited book.

label: EMail
definition: A written communication addressed to a person or organization and transmitted electronically.

label: Excerpt
definition: A passage selected from a larger work.

label: Film
definition: aka movie.

label: Hearing
definition: An instance or a session in which testimony and arguments are presented, esp. before an official, as a judge in a lawsuit.

label: Image
definition: A document that presents visual or diagrammatic information.

label: Interview
definition: A formalized discussion between two or more people.

label: Issue
definition: something that is printed or published and distributed, esp. a given number of a periodical

label: Journal
definition: A periodical of scholarly journal Articles.

label: Legal Case Document
definition: A document accompanying a legal case.

label: Decision
definition: A document containing an authoritative determination (as a decree or judgment) made after consideration of facts or law.

label: Legal Document
definition: A legal document; for example, a court decision, a brief, and so forth.

label: Legislation
definition: A legal document proposing or enacting a law or a group of laws.

label: Letter
definition: A written or printed communication addressed to a person or organization and usually transmitted by mail.

label: Magazine
definition: A periodical of magazine Articles. A magazine is a publication that is issued periodically, usually bound in a paper cover, and typically contains essays, stories, poems, etc., by many writers, and often photographs and drawings, frequently specializing in a particular subject or area, as hobbies, news, or sports.

label: Manual
definition: A small reference book, especially one giving instructions.

label: Manuscript
definition: An unpublished Document, which may also be submitted to a publisher for publication.

label: Map
definition: A graphical depiction of geographic features.

label: Multivolume Book
definition: A loose, thematic, collection of Documents, often Books.

label: Newspaper
definition: A periodical of documents, usually issued daily or weekly, containing current news, editorials, feature articles, and usually advertising.

label: Note
definition: Notes or annotations about a resource.

label: Patent
definition: A document describing the exclusive right granted by a government to an inventor to manufacture, use, or sell an invention for a certain number of years.

label: Performance
definition: A public performance.

label: Periodical
definition: A group of related documents issued at regular intervals.

label: Personal Communication
definition: A communication between an agent and one or more specific recipients.

label: Personal Communication Document
definition: A personal communication manifested in some document.

label: Proceedings
definition: A compilation of documents published from an event, such as a conference.

label: Quote
definition: An excerpted collection of words.

label: Reference Source
definition: A document that presents authoritative reference information, such as a dictionary or encylopedia .

label: Report
definition: A document describing an account or statement describing in detail an event, situation, or the like, usually as the result of observation, inquiry, etc..

label: Series
definition: A loose, thematic, collection of Documents, often Books.

label: Slide
definition: A slide in a slideshow

label: Slideshow
definition: A presentation of a series of slides, usually presented in front of an audience with written text and images.

label: Specification
definition: A document describing a specification.

label: Standard
definition: A document describing a standard: a specification organized through a standards body.

label: Statute
definition: A bill enacted into law.

label: Thesis
definition: A document created to summarize research findings associated with the completion of an academic degree.

label: Thesis degree
definition: The academic degree of a Thesis

label: Webpage
definition: A web page is an online document available (at least initially) on the world wide web. A web page is written first and foremost to appear on the web, as distinct from other online resources such as books, manuscripts or audio documents which use the web primarily as a distribution mechanism alongside other more traditional methods such as print.

label: Website
definition: A group of Webpages accessible on the Web.

label: Workshop
definition: A seminar, discussion group, or the like, that emphasizes zxchange of ideas and the demonstration and application of techniques, skills, etc.

label: abstract
definition: A summary of the resource.
A legal decision that affirms a ruling.

label: annotates
definition: Critical or explanatory note for a Document.

label: date argued
definition: The date on which a legal case is argued before a court. Date is of format xsd:date

label: list of authors
definition: An ordered list of authors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order authors by importance.

label: chapter
definition: An chapter number

label: cited by
definition: Relates a document to another document that cites the first document.

label: cites
definition: Relates a document to another document that is cited by the first document as reference, comment, review, quotation or for another purpose.

label: content
definition: This property is for a plain-text rendering of the content of a Document. While the plain-text content of an entire document could be described by this property.

label: list of contributors
definition: An ordered list of contributors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order contributors by importance.

label: court
definition: A court associated with a legal document; for example, that which issues a decision.

label: degree
definition: The thesis degree.

label: M.A.
definition: masters degree in arts

label: M.S.
definition: masters degree in science

label: PhD degree
definition: PhD degree

label: director
definition: A Film director.

label: distributor
definition: Distributor of a document or a collection of documents.

label: edition
definition: The name defining a special edition of a document. Normally its a literal value composed of a version number and words.

label: editor
definition: A person having managerial and sometimes policy-making responsibility for the editorial part of a publishing firm or of a newspaper, magazine, or other publication.

label: list of editors
definition: An ordered list of editors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order editors by importance.

label: interviewee
definition: An agent that is interviewed by another agent.

label: interviewer
definition: An agent that interview another agent.

label: issue
definition: An issue number

label: issuer
definition: An entity responsible for issuing often informally published documents such as press releases, reports, etc.

label: locator
definition: A description (often numeric) that locates an item within a containing document or collection.

label: number of pages
definition: The number of pages contained in a document

label: number of volumes
definition: The number of volumes contained in a collection of documents (usually a series, periodical, etc.).

label: number
definition: A generic item or document number. Not to be confused with issue number.

label: organizer
definition: The organizer of an event; includes conference organizers, but also government agencies or other bodies that are responsible for conducting hearings.

label: owner
definition: Owner of a document or a collection of documents.

label: page end
definition: Ending page number within a continuous page range.

label: page start
definition: Starting page number within a continuous page range.

label: pages
definition: A string of non-contiguous page spans that locate a Document within a Collection. Example: 23-25, 34, 54-56. For continuous page ranges, use the pageStart and pageEnd properties.

label: prefix name
definition: The prefix of a name

label: presented at
definition: Relates a document to an event; for example, a paper to a conference.

label: presents
definition: Relates an event to associated documents; for example, conference to a paper.

label: producer
definition: Producer of a document or a collection of documents.

label: recipient
definition: An agent that receives a communication document.
The resource in which another resource is reproduced.
A legal decision that reverses a ruling.

label: review of
definition: Relates a review document to a reviewed thing (resource, item, etc.).

label: section
definition: A section number

label: short title
definition: The abbreviation of a title.

label: status
definition: The publication status of (typically academic) content.

label: accepted
definition: Accepted for publication after peer reviewing.

label: draft
definition: Document drafted

label: forthcoming
definition: Document to be published

label: legal
definition: Legal document

label: non peer reviewed
definition: A document that is not peer reviewed

label: peer reviewed
definition: The process by which articles are chosen to be included in a refereed journal. An editorial board consisting of experts in the same field as the author review the article and decide if it is authoritative enough for publication.

label: published
definition: Published document

label: rejected
definition: Rejected for publication after peer reviewing.

label: unpublished
definition: Unpublished document
A legal decision on appeal that takes action on a case (affirming it, reversing it, etc.).

label: suffix name
definition: The suffix of a name

label: transcript of
definition: Relates a document to some transcribed original.

label: translation of
definition: Relates a translated document to the original document.

label: translator
definition: A person who translates written document from one language to another.

label: uri
definition: Universal Resource Identifier of a document

label: volume
definition: A volume number

label: Agent
definition: A resource that acts or has the power to act.

label: Agent Class
definition: A group of agents.

label: Bibliographic Resource
definition: A book, article, or other documentary resource.

label: DCMI Box
definition: The set of regions in space defined by their geographic coordinates according to the DCMI Box Encoding Scheme.

label: DCMI Type Vocabulary
definition: The set of classes specified by the DCMI Type Vocabulary, used to categorize the nature or genre of the resource.

label: DDC
definition: The set of conceptual resources specified by the Dewey Decimal Classification.

label: File Format
definition: A digital resource format.

label: Frequency
definition: A rate at which something recurs.

label: IMT
definition: The set of media types specified by the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority.

label: ISO 3166
definition: The set of codes listed in ISO 3166-1 for the representation of names of countries.

label: ISO 639-2
definition: The three-letter alphabetic codes listed in ISO639-2 for the representation of names of languages.

label: ISO 639-3
definition: The set of three-letter codes listed in ISO 639-3 for the representation of names of languages.

label: Jurisdiction
definition: The extent or range of judicial, law enforcement, or other authority.

label: LCC
definition: The set of conceptual resources specified by the Library of Congress Classification.

label: LCSH
definition: The set of labeled concepts specified by the Library of Congress Subject Headings.

label: License Document
definition: A legal document giving official permission to do something with a resource.

label: Linguistic System
definition: A system of signs, symbols, sounds, gestures, or rules used in communication.

label: Location
definition: A spatial region or named place.

label: Location, Period, or Jurisdiction
definition: A location, period of time, or jurisdiction.

label: MeSH
definition: The set of labeled concepts specified by the Medical Subject Headings.

label: Media Type
definition: A file format or physical medium.

label: Media Type or Extent
definition: A media type or extent.

label: Method of Accrual
definition: A method by which resources are added to a collection.

label: Method of Instruction
definition: A process that is used to engender knowledge, attitudes, and skills.

label: NLM
definition: The set of conceptual resources specified by the National Library of Medicine Classification.

label: DCMI Period
definition: The set of time intervals defined by their limits according to the DCMI Period Encoding Scheme.

label: Period of Time
definition: An interval of time that is named or defined by its start and end dates.

label: Physical Medium
definition: A physical material or carrier.

label: Physical Resource
definition: A material thing.

label: DCMI Point
definition: The set of points in space defined by their geographic coordinates according to the DCMI Point Encoding Scheme.

label: Policy
definition: A plan or course of action by an authority, intended to influence and determine decisions, actions, and other matters.

label: Provenance Statement
definition: Any changes in ownership and custody of a resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

label: RFC 1766
definition: The set of tags, constructed according to RFC 1766, for the identification of languages.

label: RFC 3066
definition: The set of tags constructed according to RFC 3066 for the identification of languages.

label: RFC 4646
definition: The set of tags constructed according to RFC 4646 for the identification of languages.

label: RFC 5646
definition: The set of tags constructed according to RFC 5646 for the identification of languages.

label: Rights Statement
definition: A statement about the intellectual property rights (IPR) held in or over a resource, a legal document giving official permission to do something with a resource, or a statement about access rights.

label: Size or Duration
definition: A dimension or extent, or a time taken to play or execute.

label: Standard
definition: A reference point against which other things can be evaluated or compared.

label: TGN
definition: The set of places specified by the Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names.

label: UDC
definition: The set of conceptual resources specified by the Universal Decimal Classification.

label: URI
definition: The set of identifiers constructed according to the generic syntax for Uniform Resource Identifiers as specified by the Internet Engineering Task Force.

label: W3C-DTF
definition: The set of dates and times constructed according to the W3C Date and Time Formats Specification.

label: Abstract
definition: A summary of the resource.

label: Access Rights
definition: Information about who access the resource or an indication of its security status.

label: Accrual Method
definition: The method by which items are added to a collection.

label: Accrual Periodicity
definition: The frequency with which items are added to a collection.

label: Accrual Policy
definition: The policy governing the addition of items to a collection.

label: Alternative Title
definition: An alternative name for the resource.

label: Audience
definition: A class of agents for whom the resource is intended or useful.

label: Date Available
definition: Date that the resource became or will become available.

label: Bibliographic Citation
definition: A bibliographic reference for the resource.

label: Conforms To
definition: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.

label: Contributor
definition: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.

label: Coverage
definition: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, spatial applicability of the resource, or jurisdiction under which the resource is relevant.

label: Date Created
definition: Date of creation of the resource.

label: Creator
definition: An entity responsible for making the resource.

label: Date
definition: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

label: Date Accepted
definition: Date of acceptance of the resource.

label: Date Copyrighted
definition: Date of copyright of the resource.

label: Date Submitted
definition: Date of submission of the resource.

label: Description
definition: An account of the resource.

label: Audience Education Level
definition: A class of agents, defined in terms of progression through an educational or training context, for which the described resource is intended.

label: Extent
definition: The size or duration of the resource.

label: Format
definition: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

label: Has Format
definition: A related resource that is substantially the same as the pre-existing described resource, but in another format.

label: Has Part
definition: A related resource that is included either physically or logically in the described resource.

label: Has Version
definition: A related resource that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described resource.

label: Identifier
definition: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

label: Instructional Method
definition: A process, used to engender knowledge, attitudes and skills, that the described resource is designed to support.

label: Is Format Of
definition: A pre-existing related resource that is substantially the same as the described resource, but in another format.

label: Is Part Of
definition: A related resource in which the described resource is physically or logically included.

label: Is Referenced By
definition: A related resource that references, cites, or otherwise points to the described resource.

label: Is Replaced By
definition: A related resource that supplants, displaces, or supersedes the described resource.

label: Is Required By
definition: A related resource that requires the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

label: Is Version Of
definition: A related resource of which the described resource is a version, edition, or adaptation.

label: Date Issued
definition: Date of formal issuance of the resource.

label: Language
definition: A language of the resource.

label: License
definition: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

label: Mediator
definition: An entity that mediates access to the resource.

label: Medium
definition: The material or physical carrier of the resource.

label: Date Modified
definition: Date on which the resource was changed.

label: Provenance
definition: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

label: Publisher
definition: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

label: References
definition: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.

label: Relation
definition: A related resource.

label: Replaces
definition: A related resource that is supplanted, displaced, or superseded by the described resource.

label: Requires
definition: A related resource that is required by the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

label: Rights
definition: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

label: Rights Holder
definition: A person or organization owning or managing rights over the resource.

label: Source
definition: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

label: Spatial Coverage
definition: Spatial characteristics of the resource.

label: Subject
definition: A topic of the resource.

label: Table Of Contents
definition: A list of subunits of the resource.

label: Temporal Coverage
definition: Temporal characteristics of the resource.

label: Title
definition: A name given to the resource.

label: Type
definition: The nature or genre of the resource.

label: Date Valid
definition: Date (often a range) of validity of a resource.

label: Collection
definition: An aggregation of resources.

label: Dataset
definition: Data encoded in a defined structure.

label: Event
definition: A non-persistent, time-based occurrence.

label: Image
definition: A visual representation other than text.

label: Interactive Resource
definition: A resource requiring interaction from the user to be understood, executed, or experienced.

label: Moving Image
definition: A series of visual representations imparting an impression of motion when shown in succession.

label: Physical Object
definition: An inanimate, three-dimensional object or substance.

label: Service
definition: A system that provides one or more functions.

label: Software
definition: A computer program in source or compiled form.

label: Sound
definition: A resource primarily intended to be heard.

label: Still Image
definition: A static visual representation.

label: Text
definition: A resource consisting primarily of words for reading.

label: Administrative Area
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept either in concept scheme eli:AdministrativeAreaTable or in concept scheme https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/at-dataset/-/resource/dataset/atu (Administrative Territorial Unit table published of the EU Publications Office).

label: Administrative area table
definition: A set of values for administrative areas. ELI does not include a set of values for this table.

label: Agent
definition: Individual people or groups of people, like an institution with a legal recognition, who have the potential to perform intentional actions for which they can be held responsible.

label: Complex Work
definition: Works that have other works as members. The members of a Complex Work may constitute alternatives to or derivatives of other members of the same Complex Work. Typically the members of the complex work represent the successive temporal versions of an act, while the complex work represents the act independantly of one of its version.

label: Expression
definition: The intellectual realisation of a Work in the form of identifiable immaterial objects, such as, but not limited to, text. The substance of Expression is signs. An Expression cannot exist without a physical carrier but do not depend on a specific physical carrier and can exist on one or more carriers simultaneously.

label: Format
definition: The physical embodiment of a legal expression, either on paper or in any electronic format. For example, any electronic or physical format of the legal expression (XML, TIFF, PDF, etc.) ; e.g. PDF version of act 3 of 2005. (adapted from Akoma Ntoso). Note that the notion of Format in ELI is more precise than a FRBR Manifestation in the sense that a Format in ELI can carry a legal value (see the property eli:legal_value).

label: Format type
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme eli:MediaTypeTable.

label: Format type table
definition: A set of types for a Format. ELI includes a list of values for this table. This should contain user-oriented types to dinstinguish e.g. authentic PDF from scanned PDF from generated-on-the-fly PDF; or e.g. XML in a standard (AkomaNtoso) format vs. XML in a proprietary format.

label: In force
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme eli:InForceTable

label: in force
definition: Indicates that a legal resource is in force.

label: not in force
definition: Indicates that a legal resource is currently not in force.

label: partially in force
definition: Indicates that parts of the legal resource are in force, and parts are not.

label: In force table
definition: A set of values for the legal force of a resource. ELI includes a set of values for this table.

label: Language
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/language

label: Legal Expression
definition: The intellectual realisation of a legal resource in the form of a "sequence of signs" (typically alpha-numeric characters in a legal context). For example, any version of the legal resource whose content is specified and different from others for any reason: language, versions, etc.; Note that ELI ontology accommodates different point of view on what should be considered a new legal resource, or a new legal expression of the same resource. Typically, a consolidated version can be viewed, in the context of ELI, either as separate legal resource (linked to original version and previous consolidated version using corresponding ELI relations), or as a different legal expression of the same legal resource.

label: Legal Resource
definition: A work in a legislative corpus. This applies to acts that have been legally enacted (whether or not they are still in force). For example, the abstract concept of the legal resource; e.g. "act 3 of 2005" (adapted from Akoma Ntoso) A legal resource can represent a legal act or any component of a legal act, like an article. Legal resources can be linked together using properties defined in the model. Note that ELI ontology accommodates different point of view on what should be considered a new legal resource, or a new legal expression of the same resource. Typically, a consolidated version can be viewed, in the context of ELI, either as separate legal resource (linked to original version and previous consolidated version using corresponding ELI relations), or as a different legal expression of the same legal resource.

label: Legal Resource Subdivision
definition: A component of a legal act, at an arbitrary level of precision, like a chapter, an article, an alinea, a paragraph or an list item. A subdivision can be linked with its parent and children subdivision using the properties eli:has_part / eli:is_part_of.

label: Legal value
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme eli:LegalValueTable

label: authoritative
definition: The publisher gives some special status to the publication of the document. ("The Queens Printer" version of a UK Act of Parliament). This status is specific to UK where no text can be considered « definitive ».

label: definitive
definition: Document for which the text is conclusively what the law says. (The digitally signed version of an Official Journal.)

label: official
definition: Document is published by an organisation with the public task of making the information available (A consolidated version of a EU directive published by EU Publications Office.)

label: unofficial
definition: Document has no particular or special standing.

label: Legal value table
definition: A set of values for the legal value of a resource. ELI ontology includes a set of values for this table.

label: Manifestation
definition: The physical embodiment of an Expression, either on paper or in any electronic format. The substance of Manifestation is not only signs, but also the manner in which they are presented to be consumed by users, including the kind of media adopted.

label: Organization
definition: Institutions or groups of people that have obtained a legal recognition as a group and can act collectively as agents.

label: Person
definition: A real person who live or has lived.

label: Resource type
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme eli:ResourceTypeTable

label: Resource type table
definition: A set of types for a legal resource. ELI does not include a set of values for this table.

label: Subdivision type
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme eli:SubdivisionTypeTable

label: Subdivision type table
definition: A set of types for a legal resource subdivision. ELI does not include a set of values for this table.

label: Version
definition: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme eli:VersionTable

label: Version table
definition: A set of values for the version of a legal resource. ELI does not include a set of values for this table.

label: Work
definition: Any distinct intellectual creation (i.e., the intellectual content), in the context of ELI. The substance of Work is ideas.

label: Work Subdivision
definition: A component of a work, at an arbitrary level of precision. A subdivision can be linked with its parent and children subdivision using eli:has_part / eli:is_part_of.

label: Formally defined as the set of skos:Concept in concept scheme eli:WorkTypeTable
Work Type Table
definition: A set of values for the type of a work. ELI does not include a set of values for this table.

label: amended by
definition: Inverse of "amends". Indicates a work that introduced legal changes in this resource. For modifications that don’t have a legal impact, use eli:corrected_by.

label: amends
definition: Indicates that this work introduces legal changes in another resource. For modifications that don’t have a legal impact, use eli:corrects.

label: applied by
definition: Inverse of "applies". Note that this property is expressed on a legal resource, not on one of its language-specific legal expression.

label: applies
definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of a legislation) somehow conforms with another legislation. This is an informative link, and it has no legal value. For legally-binding links of transposition, use the property transposes. This can be used for example : - when a pre-existing law already conforms to a recent european directive (in that case it does not "transposes" it strictly speaking); - when non-EU member states make sure their legislation is conformant with EU law without strictly speaking transposing it; - when a legislation from a local authority conforms with a national legislation; Note that this should point to a LegalResource, not to a language-specific expression.

label: based on
definition: Inverse of "basis_for". Indicates that thiswork is empowered by another one, typically a constitution, a treaty or an enabling act.

label: basis for
definition: Indicates that this work or expression empowers another . Typically primary legislation is the basis for secondary legislation.

label: changed by
definition: Inverse of « changes ». Indicates that this work or expression is being legally changed by another. This encompasses the notions of amendment, replacement, repeal, or other types of change.

label: changes
definition: Indicates that this work or expression legally changes another. This encompasses the notions of amendment, replacement, repeal, or other types of change. This may be a direct change (textual or non-textual amendment) or a consequential or indirect change. Note, the property is to be used to express the existence of a change relationship between two acts rather than the existence of a consolidated version of the text that shows the result of the change. For consolidation relationships, use the "consolidates" and "consolidated_by" properties.

label: cited by
definition: Inverse of "cites". Note that the intended meaning of this link is to indicate that "something is cited by a legislation" and not that "this legislation is cited by something".

label: cited by case law
definition: Indicates that this LegalResource or LegalExpression is being cited in a case law, identified by a suitable URI. If the case law cannot be identified by a suitable URI, the property "eli:cited_by_case_law_reference" can be used with a textual reference to the case law. The actual citation link is expressed from the case law to the legislation, but legal portals may use the link from a legislation to a case law to e.g. refer to representative case laws about a legislation.

label: cited by case law reference
definition: Indicates that this LegalResource or LegalExpression is being cited in a case law that cannot be identified by a suitable URI and that is indicated by textual reference. An ECLI (European Case Law Identifier) can be used here. When the case law can be identified by a suitable URI, the property eli:cited_by_case_law should be used instead.

label: cites
definition: Citation in the text of the legislation. This may be at the legal resource or legal expression level, as required by the implementation context. This includes verbatim citation and citations in referrals.

label: commenced by
definition: Inverse of "commences". Indicates that this legal resource was set in force by another legal resource. Situations where a resource enters into force because of more than one resource are explicitely allowed.

label: commences
definition: Indicates that this legal resource sets another legal resource into force. Note the the date of entry into force of the other resource should be modified accordingly. Note also that it is not possible to indicate when the entry into force should happen.

label: consolidated by
definition: Inverse of "consolidates". Indicates that this legal resource or expression is taken into account in a consolidated text (which is usually the product of an editorial process that revises the legislation).

label: consolidates
definition: Indicates that this consolidated legal resource or expression (which is usually the product of an editorial process that revises the legislation) takes into account another one. This property should be used multiple times to refer to both the original version or the previous consolidated version, and to the legislations making the change.

label: corrected by
definition: Inverse of "corrects". Indicates a resource that introduces textual modifications (like correction of spelling mistakes) with no legal change in this work, expression or manifestation; typically corrigenda in EU legislation. For modifications that have a legal impact, use eli:amended_by.

label: corrects
definition: Indicates that this work introduces textual modifications (like correction of spelling mistakes) with no legal change in another resource, expression or manifestation; typically corrigenda in EU legislation. For modifications that have a legal impact, use eli:amends.

label: countersigned by
definition: A person or organization that countersigned the legislation. Depending on the legal context, a countersignature can indicate that the signed authority undertakes to assume responsibility for texts emanating from a person who is inviolable and irresponsible, (for example a King, Grand Duc or President), or that the authority is in charge of the implementation of the text.

label: date of applicability
definition: The date at which the legislation becomes applicable. This is distinct from the date of entry into force : a text may come in force today, and state it will become applicable in 3 months. The group notes that applicability dates can lead to complex situations, e.g. a text with different applicability dates for different jurisdictions; specific extensions to the model should be used for such situations.

label: date of the document
definition: Date of adoption or signature (of the form yyyy-mm-dd)

label: date no longer in force
definition: The last date any part of the legislation is in force, if the date is known (can be seen as the end date of a dc:valid range for this resource).

label: date of publication
definition: Date of publication of the official version of the legislation, in hard copy or online, depending on what the official publication is, and when it was published. Publication dates at the level of legal expressions can be separately asserted, using standard Dublin Core properties.

label: description
definition: An account of the resource (definition from Dubin Core), e.g a summary.

label: embodies
definition: Relates a manifestation to the expression that it embodies. Inverse of "is_embodied_by".

label: ensures implementation of
definition: Indicates that this LegalResource ensures the implementation of another LegalResource. This implies a legal meaning (contrary to eli:applies). This can cover links from national legislation to EU legislation, or links from regional to national legislation. It can also cover links from EU implementing acts to EU legislative acts. In the case of implementation of EU legislation at national level, this covers links to EU regulations, decisions, etc. However the transpositions of EU Directives must be captured with eli:transposes. Links between national primary and secondary legislation must be captured by eli:based_on / eli:basis_for.

label: first date of entry into force
definition: The first date any part of the legal resource or legal expression came into force (can be seen as the start date of a dc:valid range for this resource)

label: format
definition: The format of the manifestation, expressed as a custom URI. This field is intended to capture the format of the resource from an application or user perspective, as opposed to the "media_type" property that expresses its format from a technical point of view. This property allows to describe different XML schemas (Akoma N'toso vs. proprietary), describe different types of PDFs (scanned PDF, generated-on-the-fly PDF, signed PDF, archival PDF) or describe the paper (printed) version of the legislation. ELI includes a set of possible values for the most common use-cases and possible URIs values CAN also be taken from http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types , or can de defined by the Member States.

label: has annex
definition: Indicates an annex to this this work or expression .

label: has another publication
definition: Inverse of "is_another_publication_of".

label: has derivative
definition: Inverse of is_derivative_of

label: has member
definition: Indicates that this work conceptually includes another one. For the notion of physical inclusion, use eli:has_part.

label: has part
definition: inverse of "is_part_of"

label: has translation
definition: Inverse of "is_translation_of". Indicates that this expression has been translated into another derived expression. See the definition of "is_translation_of".

label: local id
definition: The unique identifier used in a local reference system to maintain backwards compatibility. For examples the CELEX at EU level, or the NOR in France.

label: implementation ensured by
definition: Indicates that the implementation of this LegalResource is ensured by another LegalResource. This implies a legal meaning (contrary to eli:applies). See the definition of eli:ensures_implementation_of.

label: implemented by
definition: This property is deprecated. Use "applied_by" instead.

label: implements
definition: This property is deprecated. Use "applies" instead.

label: in force
definition: A value indicating the legal force of a legal resource or a legal expression. A set of values is defined by ELI in the corresponding concept scheme. These values are : - in force - partially in force - not in force

label: is about
definition: A subject for this work. The use of Eurovoc (http://eurovoc.europa.eu) is encouraged to select values for this property. Member states are encouraged to align local values to Eurovoc.

label: is annex of
definition: Indicates this work or expression is an annex of another one.

label: is another publication of
definition: Indicates that this resource is a new publication, in a different official journal, of another resource already published elsewhere, and cannot be considered to be the same resource (owl:sameAs cannot be used to avoid potential duplication of certain metadata, like the date of publication, or the publisher). Note that this is different from the exceptionnal cases of "republication", where the same resource is actually republished in the same official journal a few days after its initial publication, in case of errors.

label: is derivative of
definition: A Work or Expression from which this one derives

label: is embodied by
definition: Relates an expression to a manifestation of that expression. Inverse of "embodies".

label: is exemplified by
definition: Link to a concrete file URL. Relates a manifestation to a single exemplar or instance of that manifestation.

label: is member of
definition: Indicates that this work is conceptually included in another one. In the case of a legislation, its successive temporal versions are conceptually members of a single « abstract » resource. For the notion of physical inclusion, use eli:is_part_of.

label: is part of
definition: Indicates a work in which this one is physically included. Covers the case of text included in an Official Journal, or an article included in a text. For the notion of conceptual/temporal inclusion, use eli:is_member_of.

label: is realized by
definition: Relates a work to an expression of this work in the form of a "sequence of signs" (typically alpha-numeric characters in a legal context). Inverse of "realizes".

label: is referred to by
definition: Indicates a work or expression that refers to this entity.

label: is translation of
definition: Indicates that this expression has been translated from another original expression; this can be used to distinguish original from derived expressions. Note that asserting this link does not have any implication on the legal value of the original and translated expressions : depending on the context, a translation can be as legally binding as the original version, or can be published for informative purposes only (e.g. a country translating some legal acts in English). The expressions linked with this property can be realisations of the same LegalResource, or different LegalResources. Multilingual legislations that do not need to distinguish between original and derived expressions of the same LegalResource (e.g. european legislation) will not use this property.

label: jurisdiction
definition: The jurisdiction from which the legal resource originates. The place identifier can be taken from the Administrative Territorial Unit table published of the EU Publications Office at https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/at-dataset/-/resource/dataset/atu. Member States don't have to recreate their own list of values.

label: language
definition: The language of an expression. EU Publications Office provides a list of languages at https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/at-dataset/-/resource/dataset/language. This list is large enough so that member states should not have to declare local values. Note that, if needed, a language can also be stated on a legal resource using the DublinCore "language" property.

label: legal value
definition: The legal value associated with a specific format of a resource. A set of values is defined by ELI in the corresponding concept scheme. These values are : - unofficial : no particular or special standing; - official : published by an organisation with the public task of making the information available (e.g. a consolidated version of a EU directive) ; - authoritative : the publisher gives some special status to the publication (e.g. "the Queens Printer" version of an Act of Parliament, or the OJ version of a EU Directive); - definitive : the text is conclusively what the law says, (e.g. the digitally signed version of an OJ).

label: licence
definition: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource (Definition from Dublin Core)

label: media type
definition: The file format of the manifestation. This field is intended to capture the technical file format and will serve as a basis for content negotiation for the server to return the appropriate file based on the client preference. Although not mandatory, this property is highly encouraged. Possible URIs values MUST be taken from http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types (e.g. http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/application/xml). See also the "format" property.

label: number
definition: An identifier or other disambiguating feature for a work or expression. This can be the number of a legislation, the number of an article, or the issue number of an official journal.

label: passed by
definition: The person or organization that originally passed or made the law : typically parliament (for primary legislation) or government (for secondary legislation). This indicates the "legal author" of the law, as opposed to its physical author. This property can be used multiple times to indicate both the agent that authored the text, and/or the agent that signed the text, thus turning it into an actual legislation. The relationship between current and any former law making body should be represented in the description of the agent itself. Member states are encouraged to make their own list of Agents. EU Publications Office provides a list of corporate bodies at https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/at-dataset/-/resource/dataset/corporate-body.

label: published in
definition: Reference to the Official Journal or other publication manifestation in which this format is published. This property should be used when the value cannot be identified by a suitable URI; if a URI is available, the property "published_in_format" should be used.

label: published in format
definition: Reference to the Official Journal or other publication manifestation in which this format is published. This property should be used when the value can be identified by a suitable URI; in the absence of such a URI, the property "published_in" should be used with a string value.

label: publisher
definition: An entity responsible for making the resource available (definition from Dublin Core). This property should be used when the value cannot be identified by a suitable URI; if a URI is available, the property "publisher_agent" should be used.

label: publisher agent
definition: An entity responsible for making the resource available (definition from Dublin Core). This property should be used when the value can be identified by a suitable URI; in the absence of such a URI, the property "publisher" should be used with a string value.

label: publishes
definition: Inverse of "published_in_format". Note this property does not link a publisher with a resource, but rather a specific Format of a resource with a specific Format of another resource, indicating that the subject Format publishes the object Format.

label: realizes
definition: Relates an expression to a work realised through that expression. Inverse of "is_realized_by".

label: refers to
definition: Any entity that this work or expression refers to ; typically references are made to other Works, but it can be also to legislative processes, persons, etc. Note that specific subproperties exist in ELI-DL to describe future legal impacts (\"foresees_xxxx\" links) and links between amendments and draft legislation. Example : an opinion refers to the specific version of the draft legislation on which it is based.

label: related to
definition: Indicates a somehow related other document, not necessarily a legal resource. Note that citation links should use the cites property.

label: relevant for
definition: Refers to a place or an area associated with the resource. This covers the notions of jurisdiction, sovereignty, applicability or administrative area. The place identifier can be taken from the Administrative Territorial Unit table published of the EU Publications Office at https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/at-dataset/-/resource/dataset/atu. Member States don't have to recreate their own list of values. The group notes the limitations of what can be said with a single property; member states can refine this notion by declaring specific sub properties.

label: repealed by
definition: Inverse of "repeals". Indicates that this legal resource or legal expression is being completely canceled, abrogated or replaced by another legal resource. If a resource is partially repealed by another, this link can be used at the corresponding subdivision level being completely repealed.

label: repeals
definition: Indicates that this legal resource or legal expression completely cancels, abrogates or replaces another. If a resource partially repeals another, this link can be used at the corresponding subdivision level being completely repealed.

label: responsibility of
definition: An individual, organisation or organisational unit that has some kind of responsibility for the legislation. Typically the ministry who is/was in charge of elaborating the legislation, or the adressee for potential questions about the legislation once it is published. This property should be used when the value cannot be identified by a suitable URI; if a URI is available, the property "responsibility_of_agent" should be used.

label: responsibility of agent
definition: An individual, organisation or organisational unit that has some kind of responsibility for the legislation. Typically the ministry who is/was in charge of elaborating the legislation, or the adressee for potential questions about the legislation once it is published. This property should be used when the value can be identified by a suitable URI; in the absence of such a URI, the property "responsibility_of" should be used with a string value.

label: rights
definition: Information about rights held in and over the resource (definition from Dublin Core). For example, that property can be used to provide a link to a page that describes the licensing terms.

label: rights holder
definition: A person or organisation owning or managing rights over the resource (definition from Dublin Core). This property should be used when the value cannot be identified by a suitable URI; if a URI is available, the property "rightsholder_agent" should be used.

label: rightsholder agent
definition: A person or organisation owning or managing rights over the resource (definition from Dublin Core). This property should be used when the value can be identified by a suitable URI; in the absence of such a URI, the property "rightsholder" should be used with a string value.

label: specific property of
definition: Indicates that a property is, in a generic sense, a more specific property of another one. This does not entail the same logical reasoning as rdfs:subPropertyOf. This is used to indicate the alignement to Dublin Core properties, without redeclaring the Dublin Core property in Protégé, and without commiting to choose that a DubinCore property is either a datatype or an object property.

label: title
definition: The title, or name, of an expression. Note that, if needed, a title can also be stated on a legal resource using the Dublin Core "title" property.

label: alternative title
definition: An alternative title of the expression (if any). Note that, if needed, an alternative title can also be stated on a work using the Dublin Core "alternative" property.

label: short title
definition: Established short title of the expression (if any)

label: transposed by
definition: Inverse of "transposes". Note that this property is expressed on a legal resource, not on one of its language-specific legal expression.

label: transposes
definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of legislation) fulfills the objectives set by another legislation, by passing appropriate implementation measures. Typically, some legislations of European Union's member states or regions transpose European Directives. This indicates a legally binding link between the 2 legislations, at act or article level, from the original version of a national implementing measure to the legal resource Directive as published in the EU Official Journal. Can be used for transposition tables, once EU Publication Office has introduced ELI support down to the article level. The implementation of EU legislation at national level, involving links to EU regulations, decisions, etc. must be captured with eli:ensures_implementation_of. Note that this should point to the legal resource of the Directive itself, not to one of its language-specific legal expression.

label: type of document
definition: The type of a legal resource (e.g. "Directive", "Règlement grand ducal", "law", "règlement ministériel", "draft proposition", "Parliamentary act", etc.). Member states are encouraged to make their own list of values in the corresponding concept scheme. EU Publications Office provides a list of values for EU resource types at https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/at-dataset/-/resource/dataset/resource-type

label: type of subdivision
definition: The type of a document subdivision (e.g. "Article", "Paragraph", "Section", etc.). A subdivision can have only one type. ELI does not specify a list of possible values. Member states are encouraged to make their own list of values in the corresponding concept scheme. EU Publication Office provies a list of values for EU resource types at https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/at-dataset/-/resource/dataset/subdivision

label: uri schema
definition: Schema describing the URI of an ELI instance. ELI uses URI template specifications (IETF RFC 6570). Schemes should be associated with member states and will be published in a registry.

label: version
definition: A skos concept scheme, could be locally defined? Group proposal is to start with an initial ELI scheme, that might include concepts of "Official Journal" "made" "consolidated" "proposed" "prospective"

label: version date
definition: The point-in-time at which the provided description of the legislation is valid.

label: work type
definition: The type of a work, taken from a controlled vocabulary. Member States need to define their own work type values.

label: Action
definition: An operation on an Asset.

label: Agreement
definition: A Policy that grants the assignee a Rule over an Asset from an assigner.

label: All
definition: Specifies that the scope of the relationship is all of the collective individuals within a context.

label: All Second-level Connections
definition: Specifies that the scope of the relationship is all of the second-level connections to the Party.

label: All First-Level Connections
definition: Specifies that the scope of the relationship is all of the first-level connections of the Party.

label: All Group Connections
definition: Specifies that the scope of the relationship is all of the group connections of the Party.

label: Assertion
definition: A Policy that asserts a Rule over an Asset from parties.

label: Asset
definition: A resource or a collection of resources that are the subject of a Rule.

label: Asset Collection
definition: An Asset that is collection of individual resources

label: Asset Scope
definition: Scopes for Asset Scope expressions.

label: Conflict Strategy Preference
definition: Used to establish strategies to resolve conflicts that arise from the merging of Policies or conflicts between Permissions and Prohibitions in the same Policy.

label: Constraint
definition: A boolean expression that refines the semantics of an Action and Party/Asset Collection or declare the conditions applicable to a Rule.

label: Duty
definition: The obligation to perform an Action

label: Group
definition: Specifies that the scope of the relationship is the defined group with multiple individual members.

label: Individual
definition: Specifies that the scope of the relationship is the single Party individual.

label: Left Operand
definition: Left operand for a constraint expression.

label: Logical Constraint
definition: A logical expression that refines the semantics of an Action and Party/Asset Collection or declare the conditions applicable to a Rule.

label: Offer
definition: A Policy that proposes a Rule over an Asset from an assigner.

label: Operator
definition: Operator for constraint expression.

label: Party
definition: An entity or a collection of entities that undertake Roles in a Rule.

label: Party Collection
definition: A Party that is a group of individual entities

label: Party Scope
definition: Scopes for Party Scope expressions.

label: Permission
definition: The ability to perform an Action over an Asset.

label: Policy
definition: A non-empty group of Permissions and/or Prohibitions.

label: Privacy Policy
definition: A Policy that expresses a Rule over an Asset containing personal information.

label: Prohibition
definition: The inability to perform an Action over an Asset.

label: Request
definition: A Policy that proposes a Rule over an Asset from an assignee.

label: Right Operand
definition: Right operand for constraint expression.

label: Rule
definition: An abstract concept that represents the common characteristics of Permissions, Prohibitions, and Duties.

label: Set
definition: A Policy that expresses a Rule over an Asset.

label: Ticket
definition: A Policy that grants the holder a Rule over an Asset from an assigner.

label: Undefined Term
definition: Is used to indicate how to support Actions that are not part of any vocabulary or profile in the policy expression system.

label: Absolute Asset Position
definition: A point in space or time defined with absolute coordinates for the positioning of the target Asset.

label: Absolute Asset Size
definition: Measure(s) of one or two axes for 2D-objects or measure(s) of one to tree axes for 3D-objects of the target Asset.

label: Absolute Spatial Asset Position
definition: The absolute spatial positions of four corners of a rectangle on a 2D-canvas or the eight corners of a cuboid in a 3D-space for the target Asset to fit.

label: Absolute Temporal Asset Position
definition: The absolute temporal positions in a media stream the target Asset has to fit.

label: Accept Tracking
definition: To accept that the use of the Asset may be tracked.

label: Has Action
definition: The operation relating to the Asset for which the Rule is being subjected.

label: Ad-hoc sharing
definition: The act of sharing the asset to parties in close proximity to the owner.

label: Aggregate
definition: To use the Asset or parts of it as part of a composite collection.

label: And
definition: The relation is satisfied when all of the Constraints are satisfied.

label: And Sequence
definition: The relation is satisfied when each of the Constraints are satisfied in the order specified.

label: Annotate
definition: To add explanatory notations/commentaries to the Asset without modifying the Asset in any other way.

label: Anonymize
definition: To anonymize all or parts of the Asset.

label: Append
definition: The act of adding to the end of an asset.

label: Append To
definition: The act of appending data to the Asset without modifying the Asset in any other way.

label: Archive
definition: To store the Asset (in a non-transient form).

label: Assignee
definition: The Party is the recipient of the Rule.

label: Assignee Of
definition: Identifies an ODRL Policy for which the identified Party undertakes the assignee functional role.

label: Assigner
definition: The Party is the issuer of the Rule.

label: Assigner Of
definition: Identifies an ODRL Policy for which the identified Party undertakes the assigner functional role.

label: Attach policy
definition: The act of keeping the policy notice with the asset.

label: Attach source
definition: The act of attaching the source of the asset and its derivatives.

label: Attribute
definition: To attribute the use of the Asset.

label: Attributed Party
definition: The Party to be attributed.

label: Attributing Party
definition: The Party who undertakes the attribution.

label: Commercialize
definition: The act of using the asset in a business environment.

label: Compensate
definition: To compensate by transfer of some amount of value, if defined, for using or selling the Asset.

label: Compensated Party
definition: The Party is the recipient of the compensation.

label: Compensating Party
definition: The Party that is the provider of the compensation.

label: Concurrent Use
definition: To create multiple copies of the Asset that are being concurrently used.

label: Handle Policy Conflicts
definition: The conflict-resolution strategy for a Policy.

label: Consented Party
definition: The Party who obtains the consent.

label: Consenting Party
definition: The Party to obtain consent from.

label: Consequence
definition: Relates a Duty to another Duty, the latter being a consequence of not fulfilling the former.

label: Has Constraint
definition: Constraint applied to a Rule

label: Contracted Party
definition: The Party who is being contracted.

label: Contracting Party
definition: The Party who is offering the contract.

label: Copy
definition: The act of making an exact reproduction of the asset.

label: ODRL Core Profile
definition: Identifier for the ODRL Core Profile

label: Count
definition: Numeric count of executions of the action of the Rule.

label: Datatype
definition: The datatype of the value of the rightOperand or rightOperandReference of a Constraint.

label: Datetime
definition: The date (and optional time and timezone) of exercising the action of the Rule. Right operand value MUST be an xsd:date or xsd:dateTime as defined by [[xmlschema11-2]].

label: Delay Period
definition: A time delay period prior to exercising the action of the Rule. The point in time triggering this period MAY be defined by another temporal Constraint combined by a Logical Constraint (utilising the odrl:andSequence operand). Right operand value MUST be an xsd:duration as defined by [[xmlschema11-2]].

label: Delete
definition: To permanently remove all copies of the Asset after it has been used.

label: Delivery Channel
definition: The delivery channel used for exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Derive
definition: To create a new derivative Asset from this Asset and to edit or modify the derivative.

label: Device
definition: An identified device used for exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Digitize
definition: To produce a digital copy of (or otherwise digitize) the Asset from its analogue form.

label: Display
definition: To create a static and transient rendition of an Asset.

label: Distribute
definition: To supply the Asset to third-parties.

label: Has Duty
definition: Relates an individual Duty to a Permission.

label: Elapsed Time
definition: A continuous elapsed time period which may be used for exercising of the action of the Rule. Right operand value MUST be an xsd:duration as defined by [[xmlschema11-2]].

label: Ensure Exclusivity
definition: To ensure that the Rule on the Asset is exclusive.

label: Equal to
definition: Indicating that a given value equals the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Event
definition: An identified event setting a context for exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Execute
definition: To run the computer program Asset.

label: Export
definition: The act of transforming the asset into a new form.

label: Extract
definition: To extract parts of the Asset and to use it as a new Asset.

label: Extract character
definition: The act of extracting (replicating) unchanged characters from the asset.

label: Extract page
definition: The act of extracting (replicating) unchanged pages from the asset.

label: Extract word
definition: The act of extracting (replicating) unchanged words from the asset.

label: Failure
definition: Failure is an abstract property that defines the violation (or unmet) relationship between Rules.

label: File Format
definition: A transformed file format of the target Asset.

label: Function
definition: Function is an abstract property whose sub-properties define the functional roles which may be fulfilled by a party in relation to a Rule.

label: Give
definition: To transfer the ownership of the Asset to a third party without compensation and while deleting the original asset.

label: Grant Use
definition: To grant the use of the Asset to third parties.

label: Greater than
definition: Indicating that a given value is greater than the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Greater than or equal to
definition: Indicating that a given value is greater than or equal to the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Has part
definition: A set-based operator indicating that a given value contains the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Target Policy
definition: Identifies an ODRL Policy for which the identified Asset is the target Asset to all the Rules.

label: Ignore Undefined Actions
definition: The Action is to be ignored and is not part of the policy – and the policy remains valid.

label: Implies
definition: An Action asserts that another Action is not prohibited to enable its operational semantics.

label: Include
definition: To include other related assets in the Asset.

label: Included In
definition: An Action transitively asserts that another Action that encompasses its operational semantics.

label: Index
definition: To record the Asset in an index.

label: Industry Context
definition: A defined industry sector setting a context for exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Inform
definition: To inform that an action has been performed on or in relation to the Asset.

label: Informed Party
definition: The Party to be informed of all uses.

label: Informing Party
definition: The Party who provides the inform use data.

label: Inheritance Allowed
definition: Indicates if the Policy entity can be inherited.

label: Inherits From
definition: Relates a (child) policy to another (parent) policy from which terms are inherited.

label: Inherit Relation
definition: Indentifies the type of inheritance.

label: Install
definition: To load the computer program Asset onto a storage device which allows operating or running the Asset.

label: Void Policy
definition: The policy is void.

label: Is a
definition: A set-based operator indicating that a given value is an instance of the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Is all of
definition: A set-based operator indicating that a given value is all of the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Is any of
definition: A set-based operator indicating that a given value is any of the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Is none of
definition: A set-based operator indicating that a given value is none of the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Is part of
definition: A set-based operator indicating that a given value is contained by the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Language
definition: A natural language used by the target Asset.

label: Lease
definition: The act of making available the asset to a third-party for a fixed period of time with exchange of value.

label: Has Left Operand
definition: The left operand in a constraint expression.

label: Lend
definition: The act of making available the asset to a third-party for a fixed period of time without exchange of value.

label: License
definition: The act of granting the right to use the asset to a third-party.

label: Less than
definition: Indicating that a given value is less than the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Less than or equal to
definition: Indicating that a given value is less than or equal to the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Media Context
definition: Category of a media asset setting a context for exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Metered Time
definition: An accumulated amount of one to many metered time periods which were used for exercising the action of the Rule. Right operand value MUST be an xsd:duration as defined by [[xmlschema11-2]].

label: Modify
definition: To change existing content of the Asset. A new asset is not created by this action.

label: Move
definition: To move the Asset from one digital location to another including deleting the original copy.

label: Not equal to
definition: Indicating that a given value is not equal to the right operand of the Constraint.

label: Next Policy
definition: To grant the specified Policy to a third party for their use of the Asset.

label: Obligation
definition: Relates an individual Duty to a Policy.

label: Obtain Consent
definition: To obtain verifiable consent to perform the requested action in relation to the Asset.

label: Operand
definition: Operand is an abstract property for a logical relationship.

label: Has Operator
definition: The operator function applied to operands of a Constraint

label: Or
definition: The relation is satisfied when at least one of the Constraints is satisfied.

label: Output
definition: The output property specifies the Asset which is created from the output of the Action.

label: Part Of
definition: Identifies an Asset/PartyCollection that the Asset/Party is a member of.

label: Pay
definition: The act of paying a financial amount to a party for use of the asset.

label: Payment Amount
definition: The amount of a financial payment. Right operand value MUST be an xsd:decimal.

label: Payee Party
definition: The Party is the recipient of the payment.

label: Asset Percentage
definition: A percentage amount of the target Asset relevant for exercising the action of the Rule. Right operand value MUST be an xsd:decimal from 0 to 100.

label: Prefer Permissions
definition: Permissions take preference over prohibitions.

label: Has Permission
definition: Relates an individual Permission to a Policy.

label: Play
definition: To create a sequential and transient rendition of an Asset.

label: Policy Rule Usage
definition: Indicates the actual datetime the action of the Rule was exercised.

label: Present
definition: To publicly perform the Asset.

label: Preview
definition: The act of providing a short preview of the asset.

label: Print
definition: To create a tangible and permanent rendition of an Asset.

label: Product Context
definition: Category of product or service setting a context for exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Profile
definition: The identifier(s) of an ODRL Profile that the Policy conforms to.

label: Prefer Prohibitions
definition: Prohibitions take preference over permissions.

label: Has Prohibition
definition: Relates an individual Prohibition to a Policy.

label: proximity
definition: An value indicating the closeness or nearness.

label: Purpose
definition: A defined purpose for exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Read
definition: To obtain data from the Asset.

label: Recipient
definition: The party receiving the result/outcome of exercising the action of the Rule.

label: Refinement
definition: Constraint used to refine the semantics of an Action, or Party/Asset Collection

label: Relation
definition: Relation is an abstract property which creates an explicit link between an Action and an Asset.

label: Relative Asset Position
definition: A point in space or time defined with coordinates relative to full measures the positioning of the target Asset.

label: Relative Asset Size
definition: Measure(s) of one or two axes for 2D-objects or measure(s) of one to tree axes for 3D-objects - expressed as percentages of full values - of the target Asset.

label: Relative Spatial Asset Position
definition: The relative spatial positions - expressed as percentages of full values - of four corners of a rectangle on a 2D-canvas or the eight corners of a cuboid in a 3D-space of the target Asset.

label: Relative Temporal Asset Position
definition: A point in space or time defined with coordinates relative to full measures the positioning of the target Asset.

label: Remedy
definition: Relates an individual remedy Duty to a Prohibition.

label: Reproduce
definition: To make duplicate copies the Asset in any material form.

label: Rendition Resolution
definition: Resolution of the rendition of the target Asset.

label: Review Policy
definition: To review the Policy applicable to the Asset.

label: Has Right Operand
definition: The value of the right operand in a constraint expression.

label: Has Right Operand Reference
definition: A reference to a web resource providing the value for the right operand of a Constraint.

label: Scope
definition: The identifier of a scope that provides context to the extent of the entity.

label: Secondary Use
definition: The act of using the asset for a purpose other than the purpose it was intended for.

label: Sell
