definition: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

label: LocationFeatureSpecification
definition: Specifies a location feature by providing a structured value representing a feature of an accommodation as a property-value pair of varying degrees of formality.

label: LockerDelivery
definition: A DeliveryMethod in which an item is made available via locker.

label: Locksmith
definition: A locksmith.

label: LodgingBusiness
definition: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

label: LodgingReservation
definition: A reservation for lodging at a hotel, motel, inn, etc.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

label: LoginAction
definition: The action of logging into a device or application.

label: Longitudinal
definition: Unlike cross-sectional studies, longitudinal studies track the same people, and therefore the differences observed in those people are less likely to be the result of cultural differences across generations. Longitudinal studies are also used in medicine to uncover predictors of certain diseases.

label: LoseAction
definition: The act of being defeated in a competitive activity.

label: LowCalorieDiet
definition: A diet focused on reduced calorie intake.

label: LowFatDiet
definition: A diet focused on reduced fat and cholesterol intake.

label: LowLactoseDiet
definition: A diet appropriate for people with lactose intolerance.

label: LowSaltDiet
definition: A diet focused on reduced sodium intake.

label: Lung
definition: Lung and respiratory system clinical examination.

label: LymphaticVessel
definition: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries lymph fluid unidirectionally toward the heart.

label: MRI
definition: Magnetic resonance imaging.

label: MSRP
definition: Represents the manufacturer suggested retail price ("MSRP") of an offered product.

label: MadeToOrder
definition: Indicates that the item is made to order (custom made).

label: Male
definition: The male gender.

label: Manuscript
definition: A book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed.

label: Map
definition: A map.

label: MapCategoryType
definition: An enumeration of several kinds of Map.

label: MarryAction
definition: The act of marrying a person.

label: Mass
definition: Properties that take Mass as values are of the form '<Number> <Mass unit of measure>'. E.g., '7 kg'.

label: MathSolver
definition: A math solver which is capable of solving a subset of mathematical problems.

label: MaximumDoseSchedule
definition: The maximum dosing schedule considered safe for a drug or supplement as recommended by an authority or by the drug/supplement's manufacturer. Capture the recommending authority in the recognizingAuthority property of MedicalEntity.

label: MaximumRetailPrice
definition: The maximum retail price (MRP) of a product sold in India.

label: MayTreatHealthAspect
definition: Related topics may be treated by a Topic.

label: MeasurementMethodEnum
definition: Enumeration(s) for use with [[measurementMethod]].

label: MeasurementTypeEnumeration
definition: Enumeration of common measurement types (or dimensions), for example "chest" for a person, "inseam" for pants, "gauge" for screws, or "wheel" for bicycles.

label: MediaEnumeration
definition: MediaEnumeration enumerations are lists of codes, labels etc. useful for describing media objects. They may be reflections of externally developed lists, or created at schema.org, or a combination.

label: MediaGallery
definition: Web page type: Media gallery page. A mixed-media page that can contain media such as images, videos, and other multimedia.

label: MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration
definition: Codes for use with the [[mediaAuthenticityCategory]] property, indicating the authenticity of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared). In general these codes are not mutually exclusive, although some combinations (such as 'original' versus 'transformed', 'edited' and 'staged') would be contradictory if applied in the same [[MediaReview]]. Note that the application of these codes is with regard to a piece of media shared or published in a particular context.

label: MediaObject
definition: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset i.e. DataDownload. Note that a creative work may have many media objects associated with it on the same web page. For example, a page about a single song (MusicRecording) may have a music video (VideoObject), and a high and low bandwidth audio stream (2 AudioObject's).

label: MediaReview
definition: A [[MediaReview]] is a more specialized form of Review dedicated to the evaluation of media content online, typically in the context of fact-checking and misinformation. For more general reviews of media in the broader sense, use [[UserReview]], [[CriticReview]] or other [[Review]] types. This definition is a work in progress. While the [[MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration]] list reflects significant community review amongst fact-checkers and others working to combat misinformation, the specific structures for representing media objects, their versions and publication context, are still evolving. Similarly, best practices for the relationship between [[MediaReview]] and [[ClaimReview]] markup have not yet been finalized.

label: MediaReviewItem
definition: Represents an item or group of closely related items treated as a unit for the sake of evaluation in a [[MediaReview]]. Authorship etc. apply to the items rather than to the curation/grouping or reviewing party.

label: MediaSubscription
definition: A subscription which allows a user to access media including audio, video, books, etc.

label: MedicalAudience
definition: Target audiences for medical web pages.

label: MedicalAudienceType
definition: Target audiences types for medical web pages. Enumerated type.

label: MedicalBusiness
definition: A particular physical or virtual business of an organization for medical purposes. Examples of MedicalBusiness include different businesses run by health professionals.

label: MedicalCause
definition: The causative agent(s) that are responsible for the pathophysiologic process that eventually results in a medical condition, symptom or sign. In this schema, unless otherwise specified this is meant to be the proximate cause of the medical condition, symptom or sign. The proximate cause is defined as the causative agent that most directly results in the medical condition, symptom or sign. For example, the HIV virus could be considered a cause of AIDS. Or in a diagnostic context, if a patient fell and sustained a hip fracture and two days later sustained a pulmonary embolism which eventuated in a cardiac arrest, the cause of the cardiac arrest (the proximate cause) would be the pulmonary embolism and not the fall. Medical causes can include cardiovascular, chemical, dermatologic, endocrine, environmental, gastroenterologic, genetic, hematologic, gynecologic, iatrogenic, infectious, musculoskeletal, neurologic, nutritional, obstetric, oncologic, otolaryngologic, pharmacologic, psychiatric, pulmonary, renal, rheumatologic, toxic, traumatic, or urologic causes; medical conditions can be causes as well.

label: MedicalClinic
definition: A facility, often associated with a hospital or medical school, that is devoted to the specific diagnosis and/or healthcare. Previously limited to outpatients but with evolution it may be open to inpatients as well.

label: MedicalCode
definition: A code for a medical entity.

label: MedicalCondition
definition: Any condition of the human body that affects the normal functioning of a person, whether physically or mentally. Includes diseases, injuries, disabilities, disorders, syndromes, etc.

label: MedicalConditionStage
definition: A stage of a medical condition, such as 'Stage IIIa'.

label: MedicalContraindication
definition: A condition or factor that serves as a reason to withhold a certain medical therapy. Contraindications can be absolute (there are no reasonable circumstances for undertaking a course of action) or relative (the patient is at higher risk of complications, but these risks may be outweighed by other considerations or mitigated by other measures).

label: MedicalDevice
definition: Any object used in a medical capacity, such as to diagnose or treat a patient.

label: MedicalDevicePurpose
definition: Categories of medical devices, organized by the purpose or intended use of the device.

label: MedicalEntity
definition: The most generic type of entity related to health and the practice of medicine.

label: MedicalEnumeration
definition: Enumerations related to health and the practice of medicine: A concept that is used to attribute a quality to another concept, as a qualifier, a collection of items or a listing of all of the elements of a set in medicine practice.

label: MedicalEvidenceLevel
definition: Level of evidence for a medical guideline. Enumerated type.

label: MedicalGuideline
definition: Any recommendation made by a standard society (e.g. ACC/AHA) or consensus statement that denotes how to diagnose and treat a particular condition. Note: this type should be used to tag the actual guideline recommendation; if the guideline recommendation occurs in a larger scholarly article, use MedicalScholarlyArticle to tag the overall article, not this type. Note also: the organization making the recommendation should be captured in the recognizingAuthority base property of MedicalEntity.

label: MedicalGuidelineContraindication
definition: A guideline contraindication that designates a process as harmful and where quality of the data supporting the contraindication is sound.

label: MedicalGuidelineRecommendation
definition: A guideline recommendation that is regarded as efficacious and where quality of the data supporting the recommendation is sound.

label: MedicalImagingTechnique
definition: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes. Enumerated type.

label: MedicalIndication
definition: A condition or factor that indicates use of a medical therapy, including signs, symptoms, risk factors, anatomical states, etc.

label: MedicalIntangible
definition: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things in the medical space.

label: MedicalObservationalStudy
definition: An observational study is a type of medical study that attempts to infer the possible effect of a treatment through observation of a cohort of subjects over a period of time. In an observational study, the assignment of subjects into treatment groups versus control groups is outside the control of the investigator. This is in contrast with controlled studies, such as the randomized controlled trials represented by MedicalTrial, where each subject is randomly assigned to a treatment group or a control group before the start of the treatment.

label: MedicalObservationalStudyDesign
definition: Design models for observational medical studies. Enumerated type.

label: MedicalOrganization
definition: A medical organization (physical or not), such as hospital, institution or clinic.

label: MedicalProcedure
definition: A process of care used in either a diagnostic, therapeutic, preventive or palliative capacity that relies on invasive (surgical), non-invasive, or other techniques.

label: MedicalProcedureType
definition: An enumeration that describes different types of medical procedures.

label: MedicalResearcher
definition: Medical researchers.

label: MedicalRiskCalculator
definition: A complex mathematical calculation requiring an online calculator, used to assess prognosis. Note: use the url property of Thing to record any URLs for online calculators.

label: MedicalRiskEstimator
definition: Any rule set or interactive tool for estimating the risk of developing a complication or condition.

label: MedicalRiskFactor
definition: A risk factor is anything that increases a person's likelihood of developing or contracting a disease, medical condition, or complication.

label: MedicalRiskScore
definition: A simple system that adds up the number of risk factors to yield a score that is associated with prognosis, e.g. CHAD score, TIMI risk score.

label: MedicalScholarlyArticle
definition: A scholarly article in the medical domain.

label: MedicalSign
definition: Any physical manifestation of a person's medical condition discoverable by objective diagnostic tests or physical examination.

label: MedicalSignOrSymptom
definition: Any feature associated or not with a medical condition. In medicine a symptom is generally subjective while a sign is objective.

label: MedicalSpecialty
definition: Any specific branch of medical science or practice. Medical specialities include clinical specialties that pertain to particular organ systems and their respective disease states, as well as allied health specialties. Enumerated type.

label: MedicalStudy
definition: A medical study is an umbrella type covering all kinds of research studies relating to human medicine or health, including observational studies and interventional trials and registries, randomized, controlled or not. When the specific type of study is known, use one of the extensions of this type, such as MedicalTrial or MedicalObservationalStudy. Also, note that this type should be used to mark up data that describes the study itself; to tag an article that publishes the results of a study, use MedicalScholarlyArticle. Note: use the code property of MedicalEntity to store study IDs, e.g. clinicaltrials.gov ID.

label: MedicalStudyStatus
definition: The status of a medical study. Enumerated type.

label: MedicalSymptom
definition: Any complaint sensed and expressed by the patient (therefore defined as subjective) like stomachache, lower-back pain, or fatigue.

label: MedicalTest
definition: Any medical test, typically performed for diagnostic purposes.

label: MedicalTestPanel
definition: Any collection of tests commonly ordered together.

label: MedicalTherapy
definition: Any medical intervention designed to prevent, treat, and cure human diseases and medical conditions, including both curative and palliative therapies. Medical therapies are typically processes of care relying upon pharmacotherapy, behavioral therapy, supportive therapy (with fluid or nutrition for example), or detoxification (e.g. hemodialysis) aimed at improving or preventing a health condition.

label: MedicalTrial
definition: A medical trial is a type of medical study that uses a scientific process to compare the safety and efficacy of medical therapies or medical procedures. In general, medical trials are controlled and subjects are allocated at random to the different treatment and/or control groups.

label: MedicalTrialDesign
definition: Design models for medical trials. Enumerated type.

label: MedicalWebPage
definition: A web page that provides medical information.

label: MedicineSystem
definition: Systems of medical practice.

label: MeetingRoom
definition:
A meeting room, conference room, or conference hall is a room provided for singular events such as business conferences and meetings (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conference_hall).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

label: MemberProgram
definition: A MemberProgram defines a loyalty (or membership) program that provides its members with certain benefits, for example better pricing, free shipping or returns, or the ability to earn loyalty points. Member programs may have multiple tiers, for example silver and gold members, each with different benefits.

label: MemberProgramTier
definition: A MemberProgramTier specifies a tier under a loyalty (member) program, for example "gold".

label: MensClothingStore
definition: A men's clothing store.

label: Menu
definition: A structured representation of food or drink items available from a FoodEstablishment.

label: MenuItem
definition: A food or drink item listed in a menu or menu section.

label: MenuSection
definition: A sub-grouping of food or drink items in a menu. E.g. courses (such as 'Dinner', 'Breakfast', etc.), specific type of dishes (such as 'Meat', 'Vegan', 'Drinks', etc.), or some other classification made by the menu provider.

label: MerchantReturnEnumeration
definition: Enumerates several kinds of product return policies.

label: MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow
definition: Specifies that there is a finite window for product returns.

label: MerchantReturnNotPermitted
definition: Specifies that product returns are not permitted.

label: MerchantReturnPolicy
definition: A MerchantReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an [[Organization]], [[Product]], or [[Offer]].

label: MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride
definition: A seasonal override of a return policy, for example used for holidays.

label: MerchantReturnUnlimitedWindow
definition: Specifies that there is an unlimited window for product returns.

label: MerchantReturnUnspecified
definition: Specifies that a product return policy is not provided.

label: Message
definition: A single message from a sender to one or more organizations or people.

label: MiddleSchool
definition: A middle school (typically for children aged around 11-14, although this varies somewhat).

label: Midwifery
definition: A nurse-like health profession that deals with pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum period (including care of the newborn), besides sexual and reproductive health of women throughout their lives.

label: MinimumAdvertisedPrice
definition: Represents the minimum advertised price ("MAP") (as dictated by the manufacturer) of an offered product.

label: MinorHumanEditsDigitalSource
definition: Content coded as 'minor human edits' using the IPTC digital source type vocabulary.

label: MisconceptionsHealthAspect
definition: Content about common misconceptions and myths that are related to a topic.

label: MixedEventAttendanceMode
definition: MixedEventAttendanceMode - an event that is conducted as a combination of both offline and online modes.

label: MixtapeAlbum
definition: MixtapeAlbum.

label: MobileApplication
definition: A software application designed specifically to work well on a mobile device such as a telephone.

label: MobilePhoneStore
definition: A store that sells mobile phones and related accessories.

label: MobileWebPlatform
definition: Represents the broad notion of 'mobile' browsers as a Web Platform.

label: MolecularEntity
definition: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.

label: Monday
definition: The day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

label: MonetaryAmount
definition: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use [[PriceSpecification]] Types to describe the price of an Offer, Invoice, etc.

label: MonetaryAmountDistribution
definition: A statistical distribution of monetary amounts.

label: MonetaryGrant
definition: A monetary grant.

label: MoneyTransfer
definition: The act of transferring money from one place to another place. This may occur electronically or physically.

label: MortgageLoan
definition: A loan in which property or real estate is used as collateral. (A loan securitized against some real estate.)

label: Mosque
definition: A mosque.

label: Motel
definition:
A motel.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

label: Motorcycle
definition: A motorcycle or motorbike is a single-track, two-wheeled motor vehicle.

label: MotorcycleDealer
definition: A motorcycle dealer.

label: MotorcycleRepair
definition: A motorcycle repair shop.

label: MotorizedBicycle
definition: A motorized bicycle is a bicycle with an attached motor used to power the vehicle, or to assist with pedaling.

label: Mountain
definition: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

label: MoveAction
definition:
The act of an agent relocating to a place.

Related actions:

* [[TransferAction]]: Unlike TransferAction, the subject of the move is a living Person or Organization rather than an inanimate object.

label: Movie
definition: A movie.

label: MovieClip
definition: A short segment/part of a movie.

label: MovieRentalStore
definition: A movie rental store.

label: MovieSeries
definition: A series of movies. Included movies can be indicated with the hasPart property.

label: MovieTheater
definition: A movie theater.

label: MovingCompany
definition: A moving company.

label: MultiCenterTrial
definition: A trial that takes place at multiple centers.

label: MultiFrameComputationalCaptureDigitalSource
definition: Content coded as 'algorithmic media' using the IPTC digital source type vocabulary.

label: MultiPlayer
definition: Play mode: MultiPlayer. Requiring or allowing multiple human players to play simultaneously.

label: MulticellularParasite
definition: Multicellular parasite that causes an infection.

label: Muscle
definition: A muscle is an anatomical structure consisting of a contractile form of tissue that animals use to effect movement.

label: Musculoskeletal
definition: A specific branch of medical science that pertains to diagnosis and treatment of disorders of muscles, ligaments and skeletal system.

label: MusculoskeletalExam
definition: Musculoskeletal system clinical examination.

label: Museum
definition: A museum.

label: MusicAlbum
definition: A collection of music tracks.

label: MusicAlbumProductionType
definition: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

label: MusicAlbumReleaseType
definition: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

label: MusicComposition
definition: A musical composition.

label: MusicEvent
definition: Event type: Music event.

label: MusicGroup
definition: A musical group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a choir. Can also be a solo musician.

label: MusicPlaylist
definition: A collection of music tracks in playlist form.

label: MusicRecording
definition: A music recording (track), usually a single song.

label: MusicRelease
definition: A MusicRelease is a specific release of a music album.

label: MusicReleaseFormatType
definition: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

label: MusicStore
definition: A music store.

label: MusicVenue
definition: A music venue.

label: MusicVideoObject
definition: A music video file.

label: NGO
definition: Organization: Non-governmental Organization.

label: NLNonprofitType
definition: NLNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the Netherlands.

label: NailSalon
definition: A nail salon.

label: NarcoticConsideration
definition: Item is a narcotic as defined by the [1961 UN convention](https://www.incb.org/incb/en/narcotic-drugs/Yellowlist/yellow-list.html), for example marijuana or heroin.

label: Neck
definition: Neck assessment with clinical examination.

label: NegativeFilmDigitalSource
definition: Content coded as 'negative film' using the IPTC digital source type vocabulary.

label: Nerve
definition: A common pathway for the electrochemical nerve impulses that are transmitted along each of the axons.

label: Neuro
definition: Neurological system clinical examination.

label: Neurologic
definition: A specific branch of medical science that studies the nerves and nervous system and its respective disease states.

label: NewCondition
definition: Indicates that the item is new.

label: NewsArticle
definition: A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news. A more detailed overview of [schema.org News markup](/docs/news.html) is also available.

label: NewsMediaOrganization
definition: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

label: Newspaper
definition: A publication containing information about varied topics that are pertinent to general information, a geographic area, or a specific subject matter (i.e. business, culture, education). Often published daily.

label: NightClub
definition: A nightclub or discotheque.

label: NoninvasiveProcedure
definition: A type of medical procedure that involves noninvasive techniques.

label: Nonprofit501c1
definition: Nonprofit501c1: Non-profit type referring to Corporations Organized Under Act of Congress, including Federal Credit Unions and National Farm Loan Associations.

definition: Nonprofit501c11: Non-profit type referring to Teachers' Retirement Fund Associations.

label: Nonprofit501c12
definition: Nonprofit501c12: Non-profit type referring to Benevolent Life Insurance Associations, Mutual Ditch or Irrigation Companies, Mutual or Cooperative Telephone Companies.

label: Nonprofit501c13
definition: Nonprofit501c13: Non-profit type referring to Cemetery Companies.

definition: Nonprofit501c15: Non-profit type referring to Mutual Insurance Companies or Associations.

label: Nonprofit501c16
definition: Nonprofit501c16: Non-profit type referring to Cooperative Organizations to Finance Crop Operations.

label: Nonprofit501c17
definition: Nonprofit501c17: Non-profit type referring to Supplemental Unemployment Benefit Trusts.

definition: Nonprofit501c18: Non-profit type referring to Employee Funded Pension Trust (created before 25 June 1959).

definition: Nonprofit501c19: Non-profit type referring to Post or Organization of Past or Present Members of the Armed Forces.

label: Nonprofit501c2
definition: Nonprofit501c2: Non-profit type referring to Title-holding Corporations for Exempt Organizations.

definition: Nonprofit501c20: Non-profit type referring to Group Legal Services Plan Organizations.

label: Nonprofit501c21
definition: Nonprofit501c21: Non-profit type referring to Black Lung Benefit Trusts.

label: Nonprofit501c22
definition: Nonprofit501c22: Non-profit type referring to Withdrawal Liability Payment Funds.

label: Nonprofit501c23
definition: Nonprofit501c23: Non-profit type referring to Veterans Organizations.

label: Nonprofit501c24
definition: Nonprofit501c24: Non-profit type referring to Section 4049 ERISA Trusts.

label: Nonprofit501c25
definition: Nonprofit501c25: Non-profit type referring to Real Property Title-Holding Corporations or Trusts with Multiple Parents.

label: Nonprofit501c26
definition: Nonprofit501c26: Non-profit type referring to State-Sponsored Organizations Providing Health Coverage for High-Risk Individuals.

label: Nonprofit501c27
definition: Nonprofit501c27: Non-profit type referring to State-Sponsored Workers' Compensation Reinsurance Organizations.

label: Nonprofit501c28
definition: Nonprofit501c28: Non-profit type referring to National Railroad Retirement Investment Trusts.

label: Nonprofit501c3
definition: Nonprofit501c3: Non-profit type referring to Religious, Educational, Charitable, Scientific, Literary, Testing for Public Safety, Fostering National or International Amateur Sports Competition, or Prevention of Cruelty to Children or Animals Organizations.

label: Nonprofit501c4
definition: Nonprofit501c4: Non-profit type referring to Civic Leagues, Social Welfare Organizations, and Local Associations of Employees.

label: Nonprofit501c5
definition: Nonprofit501c5: Non-profit type referring to Labor, Agricultural and Horticultural Organizations.

label: Nonprofit501c6
definition: Nonprofit501c6: Non-profit type referring to Business Leagues, Chambers of Commerce, Real Estate Boards.

definition: Nonprofit501c7: Non-profit type referring to Social and Recreational Clubs.

label: Nonprofit501c8
definition: Nonprofit501c8: Non-profit type referring to Fraternal Beneficiary Societies and Associations.

label: Nonprofit501c9
definition: Nonprofit501c9: Non-profit type referring to Voluntary Employee Beneficiary Associations.

label: Nonprofit501d
definition: Nonprofit501d: Non-profit type referring to Religious and Apostolic Associations.

label: Nonprofit501e
definition: Nonprofit501e: Non-profit type referring to Cooperative Hospital Service Organizations.

definition: Nonprofit501f: Non-profit type referring to Cooperative Service Organizations.

label: Nonprofit501k
definition: Nonprofit501k: Non-profit type referring to Child Care Organizations.

definition: Nonprofit501n: Non-profit type referring to Charitable Risk Pools.

label: Nonprofit501q
definition: Nonprofit501q: Non-profit type referring to Credit Counseling Organizations.

definition: Nonprofit527: Non-profit type referring to political organizations.
