definition: The kind of aircraft (e.g., "Boeing 747").

label: album
definition: A music album.

label: albumProductionType
definition: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

label: albumRelease
definition: A release of this album.

label: albumReleaseType
definition: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

label: albums
definition: A collection of music albums.

label: alcoholWarning
definition: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of alcohol while taking this drug.

label: algorithm
definition: The algorithm or rules to follow to compute the score.

label: alignmentType
definition: A category of alignment between the learning resource and the framework node. Recommended values include: 'requires', 'textComplexity', 'readingLevel', and 'educationalSubject'.

label: alternateName
definition: An alias for the item.

label: alternativeHeadline
definition: A secondary title of the CreativeWork.

label: alternativeOf
definition: Another gene which is a variation of this one.

label: alumni
definition: Alumni of an organization.

label: alumniOf
definition: An organization that the person is an alumni of.

label: amenityFeature
definition: An amenity feature (e.g. a characteristic or service) of the Accommodation. This generic property does not make a statement about whether the feature is included in an offer for the main accommodation or available at extra costs.

label: amount
definition: The amount of money.

label: amountOfThisGood
definition: The quantity of the goods included in the offer.

label: announcementLocation
definition: Indicates a specific [[CivicStructure]] or [[LocalBusiness]] associated with the SpecialAnnouncement. For example, a specific testing facility or business with special opening hours. For a larger geographic region like a quarantine of an entire region, use [[spatialCoverage]].

label: annualPercentageRate
definition: The annual rate that is charged for borrowing (or made by investing), expressed as a single percentage number that represents the actual yearly cost of funds over the term of a loan. This includes any fees or additional costs associated with the transaction.

label: answerCount
definition: The number of answers this question has received.

label: answerExplanation
definition: A step-by-step or full explanation about Answer. Can outline how this Answer was achieved or contain more broad clarification or statement about it.

label: antagonist
definition: The muscle whose action counteracts the specified muscle.

label: appearance
definition: Indicates an occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

label: applicableCountry
definition: A country where a particular merchant return policy applies to, for example the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

label: applicableLocation
definition: The location in which the status applies.

label: applicantLocationRequirements
definition: The location(s) applicants can apply from. This is usually used for telecommuting jobs where the applicant does not need to be in a physical office. Note: This should not be used for citizenship or work visa requirements.

label: application
definition: An application that can complete the request.

label: applicationCategory
definition: Type of software application, e.g. 'Game, Multimedia'.

label: applicationContact
definition: Contact details for further information relevant to this job posting.

label: applicationDeadline
definition: The date on which the program stops collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle. Flexible application deadlines (for example, a program with rolling admissions) can be described in a textual string, rather than as a DateTime.

label: applicationStartDate
definition: The date at which the program begins collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle.

label: applicationSubCategory
definition: Subcategory of the application, e.g. 'Arcade Game'.

label: applicationSuite
definition: The name of the application suite to which the application belongs (e.g. Excel belongs to Office).

label: appliesToDeliveryMethod
definition: The delivery method(s) to which the delivery charge or payment charge specification applies.

label: appliesToPaymentMethod
definition: The payment method(s) to which the payment charge specification applies.

label: archiveHeld
definition: Collection, [fonds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fonds), or item held, kept or maintained by an [[ArchiveOrganization]].

label: archivedAt
definition: Indicates a page or other link involved in archival of a [[CreativeWork]]. In the case of [[MediaReview]], the items in a [[MediaReviewItem]] may often become inaccessible, but be archived by archival, journalistic, activist, or law enforcement organizations. In such cases, the referenced page may not directly publish the content.

label: area
definition: The area within which users can expect to reach the broadcast service.

label: areaServed
definition: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.
domain: schema:ContactPoint; schema:DeliveryChargeSpecification; schema:Demand; schema:FinancialIncentive; schema:Offer; schema:Organization; schema:Service

label: arrivalAirport
definition: The airport where the flight terminates.

label: arrivalBoatTerminal
definition: The terminal or port from which the boat arrives.

label: arrivalBusStop
definition: The stop or station from which the bus arrives.

label: arrivalGate
definition: Identifier of the flight's arrival gate.

label: arrivalPlatform
definition: The platform where the train arrives.

label: arrivalStation
definition: The station where the train trip ends.

label: arrivalTerminal
definition: Identifier of the flight's arrival terminal.

label: arrivalTime
definition: The expected arrival time.

label: artEdition
definition: The number of copies when multiple copies of a piece of artwork are produced - e.g. for a limited edition of 20 prints, 'artEdition' refers to the total number of copies (in this example "20").

label: artMedium
definition: The material used. (E.g. Oil, Watercolour, Acrylic, Linoprint, Marble, Cyanotype, Digital, Lithograph, DryPoint, Intaglio, Pastel, Woodcut, Pencil, Mixed Media, etc.)

label: arterialBranch
definition: The branches that comprise the arterial structure.

label: artform
definition: e.g. Painting, Drawing, Sculpture, Print, Photograph, Assemblage, Collage, etc.

label: articleBody
definition: The actual body of the article.

label: articleSection
definition: Articles may belong to one or more 'sections' in a magazine or newspaper, such as Sports, Lifestyle, etc.

label: artist
definition: The primary artist for a work in a medium other than pencils or digital line art--for example, if the primary artwork is done in watercolors or digital paints.

label: artworkSurface
definition: The supporting materials for the artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

label: asin
definition: An Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) is a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.com and its partners for product identification within the Amazon organization (summary from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Standard_Identification_Number)'s article). Note also that this is a definition for how to include ASINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of ASINs in general - see documentation from Amazon for authoritative details. ASINs are most commonly encoded as text strings, but the [asin] property supports URL/URI as potential values too.

label: aspect
definition: An aspect of medical practice that is considered on the page, such as 'diagnosis', 'treatment', 'causes', 'prognosis', 'etiology', 'epidemiology', etc.

label: assembly
definition: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

label: assemblyVersion
definition: Associated product/technology version. E.g., .NET Framework 4.5.

label: assesses
definition: The item being described is intended to assess the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

label: associatedAnatomy
definition: The anatomy of the underlying organ system or structures associated with this entity.

label: associatedArticle
definition: A NewsArticle associated with the Media Object.

label: associatedClaimReview
definition: An associated [[ClaimReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

label: associatedDisease
definition: Disease associated to this BioChemEntity. Such disease can be a MedicalCondition or a URL. If you want to add an evidence supporting the association, please use PropertyValue.

label: associatedMedia
definition: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for encoding.

label: associatedMediaReview
definition: An associated [[MediaReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

label: associatedPathophysiology
definition: If applicable, a description of the pathophysiology associated with the anatomical system, including potential abnormal changes in the mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions of the system.

label: associatedReview
definition: An associated [[Review]].

label: athlete
definition: A person that acts as performing member of a sports team; a player as opposed to a coach.

label: attendee
definition: A person or organization attending the event.

label: attendees
definition: A person attending the event.

label: audience
definition: An intended audience, i.e. a group for whom something was created.
domain: schema:CreativeWork; schema:Event; schema:LodgingBusiness; schema:PlayAction; schema:Product; schema:Service

label: audienceType
definition: The target group associated with a given audience (e.g. veterans, car owners, musicians, etc.).

label: audio
definition: An embedded audio object.

label: auditDate
definition: Date when a certification was last audited. See also [gs1:certificationAuditDate](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationAuditDate).

label: authenticator
definition: The Organization responsible for authenticating the user's subscription. For example, many media apps require a cable/satellite provider to authenticate your subscription before playing media.

label: author
definition: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

label: authorizedRepresentative
definition: An organization or person officially appointed to act on behalf of the manufacturer in a specific region or context.

label: availability
definition: The availability of this item—for example In stock, Out of stock, Pre-order, etc.

label: availabilityEnds
definition: The end of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

label: availabilityStarts
definition: The beginning of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

label: availableAtOrFrom
definition: The place(s) from which the offer can be obtained (e.g. store locations).

label: availableChannel
definition: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location, etc.).

label: availableDeliveryMethod
definition: The delivery method(s) available for this offer.

label: availableFrom
definition: When the item is available for pickup from the store, locker, etc.

label: availableIn
definition: The location in which the strength is available.

label: availableLanguage
definition: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].

label: availableOnDevice
definition: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

label: availableService
definition: A medical service available from this provider.

label: availableStrength
definition: An available dosage strength for the drug.

label: availableTest
definition: A diagnostic test or procedure offered by this lab.

label: availableThrough
definition: After this date, the item will no longer be available for pickup.

label: award
definition: An award won by or for this item.

label: awards
definition: Awards won by or for this item.

label: awayTeam
definition: The away team in a sports event.

label: backstory
definition: For an [[Article]], typically a [[NewsArticle]], the backstory property provides a textual summary giving a brief explanation of why and how an article was created. In a journalistic setting this could include information about reporting process, methods, interviews, data sources, etc.

label: bankAccountType
definition: The type of a bank account.

label: baseSalary
definition: The base salary of the job or of an employee in an EmployeeRole.

label: bccRecipient
definition: A sub property of recipient. The recipient blind copied on a message.

label: bed
definition: The type of bed or beds included in the accommodation. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you use bed directly with a text. If you want to indicate the quantity of a certain kind of bed, use an instance of BedDetails. For more detailed information, use the amenityFeature property.

label: beforeMedia
definition: A media object representing the circumstances before performing this direction.

label: beneficiaryBank
definition: A bank or bank’s branch, financial institution or international financial institution operating the beneficiary’s bank account or releasing funds for the beneficiary.

label: benefits
definition: Description of benefits associated with the job.

label: benefitsSummaryUrl
definition: The URL that goes directly to the summary of benefits and coverage for the specific standard plan or plan variation.

label: bestRating
definition: The highest value allowed in this rating system.

label: billingAddress
definition: The billing address for the order.

label: billingDuration
definition: Specifies for how long this price (or price component) will be billed. Can be used, for example, to model the contractual duration of a subscription or payment plan. Type can be either a Duration or a Number (in which case the unit of measurement, for example month, is specified by the unitCode property).

label: billingIncrement
definition: This property specifies the minimal quantity and rounding increment that will be the basis for the billing. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

label: billingPeriod
definition: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

label: billingStart
definition: Specifies after how much time this price (or price component) becomes valid and billing starts. Can be used, for example, to model a price increase after the first year of a subscription. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

label: bioChemInteraction
definition: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.

label: bioChemSimilarity
definition: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.

label: biologicalRole
definition: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.

label: biomechnicalClass
definition: The biomechanical properties of the bone.

label: birthDate
definition: Date of birth.

label: birthPlace
definition: The place where the person was born.

label: bitrate
definition: The bitrate of the media object.

label: blogPost
definition: A posting that is part of this blog.

label: blogPosts
definition: Indicates a post that is part of a [[Blog]]. Note that historically, what we term a "Blog" was once known as a "weblog", and that what we term a "BlogPosting" is now often colloquially referred to as a "blog".

label: bloodSupply
definition: The blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the muscle.

label: boardingGroup
definition: The airline-specific indicator of boarding order / preference.

label: boardingPolicy
definition: The type of boarding policy used by the airline (e.g. zone-based or group-based).

label: bodyLocation
definition: Location in the body of the anatomical structure.

label: bodyType
definition: Indicates the design and body style of the vehicle (e.g. station wagon, hatchback, etc.).

label: bookEdition
definition: The edition of the book.

label: bookFormat
definition: The format of the book.

label: bookingAgent
definition: 'bookingAgent' is an out-dated term indicating a 'broker' that serves as a booking agent.

label: bookingTime
definition: The date and time the reservation was booked.

label: borrower
definition: A sub property of participant. The person that borrows the object being lent.

label: box
definition: A box is the area enclosed by the rectangle formed by two points. The first point is the lower corner, the second point is the upper corner. A box is expressed as two points separated by a space character.

label: branch
definition: The branches that delineate from the nerve bundle. Not to be confused with [[branchOf]].

label: branchCode
definition: A short textual code (also called "store code") that uniquely identifies a place of business. The code is typically assigned by the parentOrganization and used in structured URLs.\n\nFor example, in the URL http://www.starbucks.co.uk/store-locator/etc/detail/3047 the code "3047" is a branchCode for a particular branch.

label: branchOf
definition: The larger organization that this local business is a branch of, if any. Not to be confused with (anatomical) [[branch]].

label: brand
definition: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

label: breadcrumb
definition: A set of links that can help a user understand and navigate a website hierarchy.

label: breastfeedingWarning
definition: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use by breastfeeding mothers.

label: broadcastAffiliateOf
definition: The media network(s) whose content is broadcast on this station.

label: broadcastChannelId
definition: The unique address by which the BroadcastService can be identified in a provider lineup. In US, this is typically a number.

label: broadcastDisplayName
definition: The name displayed in the channel guide. For many US affiliates, it is the network name.

label: broadcastFrequency
definition: The frequency used for over-the-air broadcasts. Numeric values or simple ranges, e.g. 87-99. In addition a shortcut idiom is supported for frequencies of AM and FM radio channels, e.g. "87 FM".

label: broadcastFrequencyValue
definition: The frequency in MHz for a particular broadcast.

label: broadcastOfEvent
definition: The event being broadcast such as a sporting event or awards ceremony.

label: broadcastServiceTier
definition: The type of service required to have access to the channel (e.g. Standard or Premium).

label: broadcastSignalModulation
definition: The modulation (e.g. FM, AM, etc) used by a particular broadcast service.

label: broadcastSubChannel
definition: The subchannel used for the broadcast.

label: broadcastTimezone
definition: The timezone in [ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) for which the service bases its broadcasts.

label: broadcaster
definition: The organization owning or operating the broadcast service.

label: broker
definition: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller. In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange. If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

label: browserRequirements
definition: Specifies browser requirements in human-readable text. For example, 'requires HTML5 support'.

label: busName
definition: The name of the bus (e.g. Bolt Express).

label: busNumber
definition: The unique identifier for the bus.

label: businessDays
definition: Days of the week when the merchant typically operates, indicated via opening hours markup.

label: businessFunction
definition: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.

label: buyer
definition: A sub property of participant. The participant/person/organization that bought the object.

label: byArtist
definition: The artist that performed this album or recording.

label: byDay
definition: Defines the day(s) of the week on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. May be specified using either [[DayOfWeek]], or alternatively [[Text]] conforming to iCal's syntax for byDay recurrence rules.

label: byMonth
definition: Defines the month(s) of the year on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-12. January is 1.

label: byMonthDay
definition: Defines the day(s) of the month on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-31.

label: byMonthWeek
definition: Defines the week(s) of the month on which a recurring Event takes place. Specified as an Integer between 1-5. For clarity, byMonthWeek is best used in conjunction with byDay to indicate concepts like the first and third Mondays of a month.

label: callSign
definition: A [callsign](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_sign), as used in broadcasting and radio communications to identify people, radio and TV stations, or vehicles.

label: calories
definition: The number of calories.

label: candidate
definition: A sub property of object. The candidate subject of this action.

label: caption
definition: The caption for this object. For downloadable machine formats (closed caption, subtitles etc.) use MediaObject and indicate the [[encodingFormat]].

label: carbohydrateContent
definition: The number of grams of carbohydrates.

label: cargoVolume
definition:
The available volume for cargo or luggage. For automobiles, this is usually the trunk volume.

Typical unit code(s): LTR for liters, FTQ for cubic foot/feet

Note: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: carrier
definition: 'carrier' is an out-dated term indicating the 'provider' for parcel delivery and flights.

label: carrierRequirements
definition: Specifies specific carrier(s) requirements for the application (e.g. an application may only work on a specific carrier network).

label: cashBack
definition: A cardholder benefit that pays the cardholder a small percentage of their net expenditures.

label: catalog
definition: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

label: catalogNumber
definition: The catalog number for the release.

label: category
definition: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

label: cause
definition: The cause of a medical condition.

label: causeOf
definition: The condition, complication, symptom, sign, etc. caused.

label: ccRecipient
definition: A sub property of recipient. The recipient copied on a message.

label: certificationIdentification
definition: Identifier of a certification instance (as registered with an independent certification body). Typically this identifier can be used to consult and verify the certification instance. See also [gs1:certificationIdentification](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationIdentification).

label: certificationRating
definition: Rating of a certification instance (as defined by an independent certification body). Typically this rating can be used to rate the level to which the requirements of the certification instance are fulfilled. See also [gs1:certificationValue](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationValue).

label: certificationStatus
definition: Indicates the current status of a certification: active or inactive. See also [gs1:certificationStatus](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationStatus).

label: character
definition: Fictional person connected with a creative work.

label: characterAttribute
definition: A piece of data that represents a particular aspect of a fictional character (skill, power, character points, advantage, disadvantage).

label: characterName
definition: The name of a character played in some acting or performing role, i.e. in a PerformanceRole.

label: cheatCode
definition: Cheat codes to the game.

label: checkinTime
definition: The earliest someone may check into a lodging establishment.

label: checkoutPageURLTemplate
definition: A URL template (RFC 6570) for a checkout page for an offer. This approach allows merchants to specify a URL for online checkout of the offered product, by interpolating parameters such as the logged in user ID, product ID, quantity, discount code etc. Parameter naming and standardization are not specified here.

label: checkoutTime
definition: The latest someone may check out of a lodging establishment.

label: chemicalComposition
definition: The chemical composition describes the identity and relative ratio of the chemical elements that make up the substance.

label: chemicalRole
definition: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a chemical context.

label: childMaxAge
definition: Maximal age of the child.

label: childMinAge
definition: Minimal age of the child.

label: childTaxon
definition: Closest child taxa of the taxon in question.

label: children
definition: A child of the person.

label: cholesterolContent
definition: The number of milligrams of cholesterol.

label: circle
definition: A circle is the circular region of a specified radius centered at a specified latitude and longitude. A circle is expressed as a pair followed by a radius in meters.

label: citation
definition: A citation or reference to another creative work, such as another publication, web page, scholarly article, etc.

label: claimInterpreter
definition: For a [[Claim]] interpreted from [[MediaObject]] content, the [[interpretedAsClaim]] property can be used to indicate a claim contained, implied or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]].

label: claimReviewed
definition: A short summary of the specific claims reviewed in a ClaimReview.

label: clincalPharmacology
definition: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

label: clinicalPharmacology
definition: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

label: clipNumber
definition: Position of the clip within an ordered group of clips.

label: closes
definition: The closing hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

label: coach
definition: A person that acts in a coaching role for a sports team.

label: code
definition: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.

label: codeRepository
definition: Link to the repository where the un-compiled, human readable code and related code is located (SVN, GitHub, CodePlex).

label: codeSampleType
definition: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

label: codeValue
definition: A short textual code that uniquely identifies the value.

label: codingSystem
definition: The coding system, e.g. 'ICD-10'.

label: colleague
definition: A colleague of the person.

label: colleagues
definition: A colleague of the person.

label: collection
definition: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

label: collectionSize
definition: The number of items in the [[Collection]].

label: color
definition: The color of the product.

label: colorSwatch
definition: A color swatch image, visualizing the color of a [[Product]]. Should match the textual description specified in the [[color]] property. This can be a URL or a fully described ImageObject.

label: colorist
definition: The individual who adds color to inked drawings.

label: comment
definition: Comments, typically from users.

label: commentCount
definition: The number of comments this CreativeWork (e.g. Article, Question or Answer) has received. This is most applicable to works published in Web sites with commenting system; additional comments may exist elsewhere.

label: commentText
definition: The text of the UserComment.

label: commentTime
definition: The time at which the UserComment was made.

label: companyRegistration
definition: The official registration information of a business including the organization that issued it such as Company House or Chamber of Commerce in form of a Certification.

label: competencyRequired
definition: Knowledge, skill, ability or personal attribute that must be demonstrated by a person or other entity in order to do something such as earn an Educational Occupational Credential or understand a LearningResource.

label: competitor
definition: A competitor in a sports event.

label: composer
definition: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.

label: comprisedOf
definition: Specifying something physically contained by something else. Typically used here for the underlying anatomical structures, such as organs, that comprise the anatomical system.

label: conditionsOfAccess
definition: Conditions that affect the availability of, or method(s) of access to, an item. Typically used for real world items such as an [[ArchiveComponent]] held by an [[ArchiveOrganization]]. This property is not suitable for use as a general Web access control mechanism. It is expressed only in natural language.\n\nFor example "Available by appointment from the Reading Room" or "Accessible only from logged-in accounts ".

label: confirmationNumber
definition: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.

label: connectedTo
definition: Other anatomical structures to which this structure is connected.

label: constraintProperty
definition: Indicates a property used as a constraint. For example, in the definition of a [[StatisticalVariable]]. The value is a property, either from within Schema.org or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

label: consumerNotice
definition: A consumer notice, such as a safety warning or mandatory information, related to the product.

label: contactOption
definition: An option available on this contact point (e.g. a toll-free number or support for hearing-impaired callers).

label: contactPoint
definition: A contact point for a person or organization.

label: contactPoints
definition: A contact point for a person or organization.

label: contactType
definition: A person or organization can have different contact points, for different purposes. For example, a sales contact point, a PR contact point and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of contact point.

label: contactlessPayment
definition: A secure method for consumers to purchase products or services via debit, credit or smartcards by using RFID or NFC technology.

label: containedIn
definition: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

label: containedInPlace
definition: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

label: containsPlace
definition: The basic containment relation between a place and another that it contains.

label: containsSeason
definition: A season that is part of the media series.

label: contentLocation
definition: The location depicted or described in the content. For example, the location in a photograph or painting.

label: contentRating
definition: Official rating of a piece of content—for example, 'MPAA PG-13'.

label: contentReferenceTime
definition: The specific time described by a creative work, for works (e.g. articles, video objects etc.) that emphasise a particular moment within an Event.

label: contentSize
definition: File size in (mega/kilo)bytes.

label: contentType
definition: The supported content type(s) for an EntryPoint response.

label: contentUrl
definition: Actual bytes of the media object, for example the image file or video file.

label: contraindication
definition: A contraindication for this therapy.

label: contributor
definition: A secondary contributor to the CreativeWork or Event.

label: cookTime
definition: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

label: cookingMethod
definition: The method of cooking, such as Frying, Steaming, ...

label: copyrightHolder
definition: The party holding the legal copyright to the CreativeWork.

label: copyrightNotice
definition: Text of a notice appropriate for describing the copyright aspects of this Creative Work, ideally indicating the owner of the copyright for the Work.

label: copyrightYear
definition: The year during which the claimed copyright for the CreativeWork was first asserted.

label: correction
definition: Indicates a correction to a [[CreativeWork]], either via a [[CorrectionComment]], textually or in another document.

label: correctionsPolicy
definition: For an [[Organization]] (e.g. [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement describing (in news media, the newsroom’s) disclosure and correction policy for errors.

label: costCategory
definition: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.

label: costCurrency
definition: The currency (in 3-letter) of the drug cost. See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217.

label: costOrigin
definition: Additional details to capture the origin of the cost data. For example, 'Medicare Part B'.

label: costPerUnit
definition: The cost per unit of the drug.

label: countriesNotSupported
definition: Countries for which the application is not supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

label: countriesSupported
definition: Countries for which the application is supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

label: countryOfAssembly
definition: The place where the product was assembled.

label: countryOfLastProcessing
definition: The place where the item (typically [[Product]]) was last processed and tested before importation.

label: countryOfOrigin
definition: The country of origin of something, including products as well as creative works such as movie and TV content. In the case of TV and movie, this would be the country of the principle offices of the production company or individual responsible for the movie. For other kinds of [[CreativeWork]] it is difficult to provide fully general guidance, and properties such as [[contentLocation]] and [[locationCreated]] may be more applicable. In the case of products, the country of origin of the product. The exact interpretation of this may vary by context and product type, and cannot be fully enumerated here.

label: course
definition: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

label: courseCode
definition: The identifier for the [[Course]] used by the course [[provider]] (e.g. CS101 or 6.001).

label: courseMode
definition: The medium or means of delivery of the course instance or the mode of study, either as a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or as a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous).

label: coursePrerequisites
definition: Requirements for taking the Course. May be completion of another [[Course]] or a textual description like "permission of instructor". Requirements may be a pre-requisite competency, referenced using [[AlignmentObject]].

label: courseSchedule
definition: Represents the length and pace of a course, expressed as a [[Schedule]].

label: courseWorkload
definition: The amount of work expected of students taking the course, often provided as a figure per week or per month, and may be broken down by type. For example, "2 hours of lectures, 1 hour of lab work and 3 hours of independent study per week".

label: coverageEndTime
definition: The time when the live blog will stop covering the Event. Note that coverage may continue after the Event concludes.

label: coverageStartTime
definition: The time when the live blog will begin covering the Event. Note that coverage may begin before the Event's start time. The LiveBlogPosting may also be created before coverage begins.

label: creativeWorkStatus
definition: The status of a creative work in terms of its stage in a lifecycle. Example terms include Incomplete, Draft, Published, Obsolete. Some organizations define a set of terms for the stages of their publication lifecycle.

label: creator
definition: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

label: credentialCategory
definition: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

label: creditText
definition: Text that can be used to credit person(s) and/or organization(s) associated with a published Creative Work.

label: creditedTo
definition: The group the release is credited to if different than the byArtist. For example, Red and Blue is credited to "Stefani Germanotta Band", but by Lady Gaga.

label: cssSelector
definition: A CSS selector, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

label: currenciesAccepted
definition: The currency accepted.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

label: currency
definition: The currency in which the monetary amount is expressed.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

label: currentExchangeRate
definition: The current price of a currency.

label: customer
definition: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.

label: customerRemorseReturnFees
definition: The type of return fees if the product is returned due to customer remorse.

label: customerRemorseReturnLabelSource
definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned due to customer remorse.

label: customerRemorseReturnShippingFeesAmount
definition: The amount of shipping costs if a product is returned due to customer remorse. Applicable when property [[customerRemorseReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

label: cutoffTime
definition: Order cutoff time allows merchants to describe the time after which they will no longer process orders received on that day. For orders processed after cutoff time, one day gets added to the delivery time estimate. This property is expected to be most typically used via the [[ShippingRateSettings]] publication pattern. The time is indicated using the ISO-8601 Time format, e.g. "23:30:00-05:00" would represent 6:30 pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) which is 5 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

label: cvdCollectionDate
definition: collectiondate - Date for which patient counts are reported.

label: cvdFacilityCounty
definition: Name of the County of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityId]] to identify the facility. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

label: cvdFacilityId
definition: Identifier of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityCounty]] to indicate the county. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

label: cvdNumBeds
definition: numbeds - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BEDS: Inpatient beds, including all staffed, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients.

label: cvdNumBedsOcc
definition: numbedsocc - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient beds that are occupied.

label: cvdNumC19Died
definition: numc19died - DEATHS: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who died in the hospital, ED, or any overflow location.

label: cvdNumC19HOPats
definition: numc19hopats - HOSPITAL ONSET: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location with onset of suspected or confirmed COVID-19 14 or more days after hospitalization.

label: cvdNumC19HospPats
definition: numc19hosppats - HOSPITALIZED: Patients currently hospitalized in an inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19.

label: cvdNumC19MechVentPats
definition: numc19mechventpats - HOSPITALIZED and VENTILATED: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19 and are on a mechanical ventilator.

label: cvdNumC19OFMechVentPats
definition: numc19ofmechventpats - ED/OVERFLOW and VENTILATED: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed and on a mechanical ventilator.

label: cvdNumC19OverflowPats
definition: numc19overflowpats - ED/OVERFLOW: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed.

label: cvdNumICUBeds
definition: numicubeds - ICU BEDS: Total number of staffed inpatient intensive care unit (ICU) beds.

label: cvdNumICUBedsOcc
definition: numicubedsocc - ICU BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient ICU beds that are occupied.

label: cvdNumTotBeds
definition: numtotbeds - ALL HOSPITAL BEDS: Total number of all inpatient and outpatient beds, including all staffed, ICU, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients or outpatients.

label: cvdNumVent
definition: numvent - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS: Total number of ventilators available.

label: cvdNumVentUse
definition: numventuse - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS IN USE: Total number of ventilators in use.

label: data
definition: Data associated with the event, like for instance a log message.

label: dataFeedElement
definition: An item within a data feed. Data feeds may have many elements.

label: dataset
definition: A dataset contained in this catalog.

label: datasetTimeInterval
definition: The range of temporal applicability of a dataset, e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 (in ISO 8601 time interval format).

label: dateCreated
definition: The date on which the CreativeWork was created or the item was added to a DataFeed.

label: dateDeleted
definition: The datetime the item was removed from the DataFeed.

label: dateIssued
definition: The date the ticket was issued.

label: dateModified
definition: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.

label: datePosted
definition: Publication date of an online listing.

label: datePublished
definition: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

label: dateRead
definition: The date/time at which the message has been read by the recipient if a single recipient exists.

label: dateReceived
definition: The date/time the message was received if a single recipient exists.

label: dateSent
definition: The date/time at which the message was sent.

label: dateVehicleFirstRegistered
definition: The date of the first registration of the vehicle with the respective public authorities.

label: dateline
definition: A [dateline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dateline) is a brief piece of text included in news articles that describes where and when the story was written or filed though the date is often omitted. Sometimes only a placename is provided. Structured representations of dateline-related information can also be expressed more explicitly using [[locationCreated]] (which represents where a work was created, e.g. where a news report was written). For location depicted or described in the content, use [[contentLocation]]. Dateline summaries are oriented more towards human readers than towards automated processing, and can vary substantially. Some examples: "BEIRUT, Lebanon, June 2.", "Paris, France", "December 19, 2017 11:43AM Reporting from Washington", "Beijing/Moscow", "QUEZON CITY, Philippines".

label: dayOfWeek
definition: The day of the week for which these opening hours are valid.

label: deathDate
definition: Date of death.

label: deathPlace
definition: The place where the person died.

label: defaultValue
definition: The default value of the input. For properties that expect a literal, the default is a literal value, for properties that expect an object, it's an ID reference to one of the current values.

label: deliveryAddress
definition: Destination address.

label: deliveryLeadTime
definition: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.

label: deliveryMethod
definition: A sub property of instrument. The method of delivery.

label: deliveryStatus
definition: New entry added as the package passes through each leg of its journey (from shipment to final delivery).

label: deliveryTime
definition: The total delay between the receipt of the order and the goods reaching the final customer.

label: department
definition: A relationship between an organization and a department of that organization, also described as an organization (allowing different urls, logos, opening hours). For example: a store with a pharmacy, or a bakery with a cafe.

label: departureAirport
definition: The airport where the flight originates.

label: departureBoatTerminal
definition: The terminal or port from which the boat departs.

label: departureBusStop
definition: The stop or station from which the bus departs.

label: departureGate
definition: Identifier of the flight's departure gate.

label: departurePlatform
definition: The platform from which the train departs.

label: departureStation
definition: The station from which the train departs.

label: departureTerminal
definition: Identifier of the flight's departure terminal.

label: departureTime
definition: The expected departure time.

label: dependencies
definition: Prerequisites needed to fulfill steps in article.

label: depth
definition: The depth of the item.

label: description
definition: A description of the item.

label: device
definition: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

label: diagnosis
definition: One or more alternative conditions considered in the differential diagnosis process as output of a diagnosis process.

label: diagram
definition: An image containing a diagram that illustrates the structure and/or its component substructures and/or connections with other structures.

label: diet
definition: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

label: dietFeatures
definition: Nutritional information specific to the dietary plan. May include dietary recommendations on what foods to avoid, what foods to consume, and specific alterations/deviations from the USDA or other regulatory body's approved dietary guidelines.

label: differentialDiagnosis
definition: One of a set of differential diagnoses for the condition. Specifically, a closely-related or competing diagnosis typically considered later in the cognitive process whereby this medical condition is distinguished from others most likely responsible for a similar collection of signs and symptoms to reach the most parsimonious diagnosis or diagnoses in a patient.

label: digitalSourceType
definition: Indicates an IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration code indicating the nature of the digital source(s) for some [[CreativeWork]].

label: directApply
definition: Indicates whether an [[url]] that is associated with a [[JobPosting]] enables direct application for the job, via the posting website. A job posting is considered to have directApply of [[True]] if an application process for the specified job can be directly initiated via the url(s) given (noting that e.g. multiple internet domains might nevertheless be involved at an implementation level). A value of [[False]] is appropriate if there is no clear path to applying directly online for the specified job, navigating directly from the JobPosting url(s) supplied.

label: director
definition: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.
domain: schema:Clip; schema:CreativeWorkSeason; schema:Episode; schema:Event; schema:Movie; schema:MovieSeries; schema:RadioSeries; schema:TVSeries; schema:VideoGame; schema:VideoGameSeries; schema:VideoObject

label: directors
definition: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video games etc. content. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.
domain: schema:Clip; schema:Episode; schema:Movie; schema:MovieSeries; schema:RadioSeries; schema:TVSeries; schema:VideoGame; schema:VideoGameSeries; schema:VideoObject

label: disambiguatingDescription
definition: A sub property of description. A short description of the item used to disambiguate from other, similar items. Information from other properties (in particular, name) may be necessary for the description to be useful for disambiguation.

label: discount
definition: Any discount applied (to an Order).

label: discountCode
definition: Code used to redeem a discount.

label: discountCurrency
definition: The currency of the discount.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

label: discusses
definition: Specifies the CreativeWork associated with the UserComment.

label: discussionUrl
definition: A link to the page containing the comments of the CreativeWork.

label: diseasePreventionInfo
definition: Information about disease prevention.

label: diseaseSpreadStatistics
definition: Statistical information about the spread of a disease, either as [[WebContent]], or described directly as a [[Dataset]], or the specific [[Observation]]s in the dataset. When a [[WebContent]] URL is provided, the page indicated might also contain more such markup.

label: displayLocation
definition: The location at which an item can be viewed or experienced in-person.

label: dissolutionDate
definition: The date that this organization was dissolved.

label: distance
definition: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.

label: distinguishingSign
definition: One of a set of signs and symptoms that can be used to distinguish this diagnosis from others in the differential diagnosis.

label: distribution
definition: A downloadable form of this dataset, at a specific location, in a specific format. This property can be repeated if different variations are available. There is no expectation that different downloadable distributions must contain exactly equivalent information (see also [DCAT](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Distribution) on this point). Different distributions might include or exclude different subsets of the entire dataset, for example.

label: diversityPolicy
definition: Statement on diversity policy by an [[Organization]] e.g. a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]. For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement describing the newsroom’s diversity policy on both staffing and sources, typically providing staffing data.

label: diversityStaffingReport
definition: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a report on staffing diversity issues. In a news context this might be for example ASNE or RTDNA (US) reports, or self-reported.

label: documentation
definition: Further documentation describing the Web API in more detail.

label: doesNotShip
definition: Indicates when shipping to a particular [[shippingDestination]] is not available.

label: domainIncludes
definition: Relates a property to a class that is (one of) the type(s) the property is expected to be used on.

label: domiciledMortgage
definition: Whether borrower is a resident of the jurisdiction where the property is located.

label: doorTime
definition: The time admission will commence.

label: dosageForm
definition: A dosage form in which this drug/supplement is available, e.g. 'tablet', 'suspension', 'injection'.

label: doseSchedule
definition: A dosing schedule for the drug for a given population, either observed, recommended, or maximum dose based on the type used.

label: doseUnit
definition: The unit of the dose, e.g. 'mg'.

label: doseValue
definition: The value of the dose, e.g. 500.

label: downPayment
definition: a type of payment made in cash during the onset of the purchase of an expensive good/service. The payment typically represents only a percentage of the full purchase price.

label: downloadUrl
definition: If the file can be downloaded, URL to download the binary.

label: downvoteCount
definition: The number of downvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

label: drainsTo
definition: The vasculature that the vein drains into.

label: driveWheelConfiguration
definition: The drive wheel configuration, i.e. which roadwheels will receive torque from the vehicle's engine via the drivetrain.

label: dropoffLocation
definition: Where a rental car can be dropped off.

label: dropoffTime
definition: When a rental car can be dropped off.

label: drug
definition: Specifying a drug or medicine used in a medication procedure.

label: drugClass
definition: The class of drug this belongs to (e.g., statins).

label: drugUnit
definition: The unit in which the drug is measured, e.g. '5 mg tablet'.

label: duns
definition: The Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for identifying an organization or business person.

label: duplicateTherapy
definition: A therapy that duplicates or overlaps this one.

label: duration
definition: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
domain: schema:Audiobook; schema:Episode; schema:Event; schema:MediaObject; schema:Movie; schema:MusicRecording; schema:MusicRelease; schema:QuantitativeValueDistribution; schema:Schedule; schema:ServicePeriod

label: durationOfWarranty
definition: The duration of the warranty promise. Common unitCode values are ANN for year, MON for months, or DAY for days.

label: duringMedia
definition: A media object representing the circumstances while performing this direction.

label: earlyPrepaymentPenalty
definition: The amount to be paid as a penalty in the event of early payment of the loan.

label: editEIDR
definition: An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing a specific edit / edition for a work of film or television. For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" whose [[titleEIDR]] is "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J" has several edits, e.g. "10.5240/1F2A-E1C5-680A-14C6-E76B-I" and "10.5240/8A35-3BEE-6497-5D12-9E4F-3". Since schema.org types like [[Movie]] and [[TVEpisode]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

label: editor
definition: Specifies the Person who edited the CreativeWork.

label: eduQuestionType
definition: For questions that are part of learning resources (e.g. Quiz), eduQuestionType indicates the format of question being given. Example: "Multiple choice", "Open ended", "Flashcard".

label: educationRequirements
definition: Educational background needed for the position or Occupation.

label: educationalAlignment
definition: An alignment to an established educational framework. This property should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

label: educationalCredentialAwarded
definition: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other educational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

label: educationalFramework
definition: The framework to which the resource being described is aligned.

label: educationalLevel
definition: The level in terms of progression through an educational or training context. Examples of educational levels include 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced', and formal sets of level indicators.

label: educationalProgramMode
definition: Similar to courseMode, the medium or means of delivery of the program as a whole. The value may either be a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous ).

label: educationalRole
definition: An educationalRole of an EducationalAudience.

label: educationalUse
definition: The purpose of a work in the context of education; for example, 'assignment', 'group work'.

label: elevation
definition: The elevation of a location ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNIT\_OF\_MEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone should be assumed to be a value in meters.

label: eligibilityToWorkRequirement
definition: The legal requirements such as citizenship, visa and other documentation required for an applicant to this job.

label: eligibleCustomerType
definition: The type(s) of customers for which the given offer is valid.

label: eligibleDuration
definition: The duration for which the given offer is valid.

label: eligibleQuantity
definition: The interval and unit of measurement of ordering quantities for which the offer or price specification is valid. This allows e.g. specifying that a certain freight charge is valid only for a certain quantity.

label: eligibleRegion
definition: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is valid.\n\nSee also [[ineligibleRegion]].

label: eligibleTransactionVolume
definition: The transaction volume, in a monetary unit, for which the offer or price specification is valid, e.g. for indicating a minimal purchasing volume, to express free shipping above a certain order volume, or to limit the acceptance of credit cards to purchases to a certain minimal amount.

label: eligibleWithSupplier
definition: The supplier of the incentivized item/service for which the incentive is valid for such as a utility company, merchant, or contractor.

label: email
definition: Email address.

label: embedUrl
definition: A URL pointing to a player for a specific video. In general, this is the information in the ```src``` element of an ```embed``` tag and should not be the same as the content of the ```loc``` tag.

label: embeddedTextCaption
definition: Represents textual captioning from a [[MediaObject]], e.g. text of a 'meme'.

label: emissionsCO2
definition: The CO2 emissions in g/km. When used in combination with a QuantitativeValue, put "g/km" into the unitText property of that value, since there is no UN/CEFACT Common Code for "g/km".

label: employee
definition: Someone working for this organization.

label: employees
definition: People working for this organization.

label: employerOverview
definition: A description of the employer, career opportunities and work environment for this position.

label: employmentType
definition: Type of employment (e.g. full-time, part-time, contract, temporary, seasonal, internship).

label: employmentUnit
definition: Indicates the department, unit and/or facility where the employee reports and/or in which the job is to be performed.

label: encodesBioChemEntity
definition: Another BioChemEntity encoded by this one.

label: encodesCreativeWork
definition: The CreativeWork encoded by this media object.

label: encoding
definition: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for associatedMedia.

label: encodingFormat
definition: Media type typically expressed using a MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml) and [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types)), e.g. application/zip for a SoftwareApplication binary, audio/mpeg for .mp3 etc. In cases where a [[CreativeWork]] has several media type representations, [[encoding]] can be used to indicate each [[MediaObject]] alongside particular [[encodingFormat]] information. Unregistered or niche encoding and file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia/Wikidata entry.

label: encodingType
definition: The supported encoding type(s) for an EntryPoint request.

label: encodings
definition: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork.

label: endDate
definition: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).
domain: schema:CreativeWorkSeason; schema:CreativeWorkSeries; schema:DatedMoneySpecification; schema:EducationalOccupationalProgram; schema:Event; schema:MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride; schema:Role; schema:Schedule

label: endOffset
definition: The end time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

label: endTime
definition: The endTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to end. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from January to *December*. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the end of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

label: endorsee
definition: A sub property of participant. The person/organization being supported.

label: endorsers
definition: People or organizations that endorse the plan.

label: energyEfficiencyScaleMax
definition: Specifies the most energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

label: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
definition: Specifies the least energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

label: engineDisplacement
definition:
The volume swept by all of the pistons inside the cylinders of an internal combustion engine in a single movement. 

Typical unit code(s): CMQ for cubic centimeter, LTR for liters, INQ for cubic inches
* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: enginePower
definition:
The power of the vehicle's engine. Typical unit code(s): KWT for kilowatt, BHP for brake horsepower, N12 for metric horsepower (PS, with 1 PS = 735,49875 W)

* Note 1: There are many different ways of measuring an engine's power. For an overview, see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine\_power\_test\_codes](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine_power_test_codes).
* Note 2: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 3: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: engineType
definition: The type of engine or engines powering the vehicle.

label: entertainmentBusiness
definition: A sub property of location. The entertainment business where the action occurred.

label: epidemiology
definition: The characteristics of associated patients, such as age, gender, race etc.

label: episode
definition: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

label: episodeNumber
definition: Position of the episode within an ordered group of episodes.

label: episodes
definition: An episode of a TV/radio series or season.

label: equal
definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is equal to the object.

label: error
definition: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

label: errorCode
definition: Application or platform dependant error code.

label: estimatedCost
definition: The estimated cost of the supply or supplies consumed when performing instructions.

label: estimatedFlightDuration
definition: The estimated time the flight will take.

label: estimatedSalary
definition: An estimated salary for a job posting or occupation, based on a variety of variables including, but not limited to industry, job title, and location. Estimated salaries are often computed by outside organizations rather than the hiring organization, who may not have committed to the estimated value.

label: estimatesRiskOf
definition: The condition, complication, or symptom whose risk is being estimated.

label: ethicsPolicy
definition: Statement about ethics policy, e.g. of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] regarding journalistic and publishing practices, or of a [[Restaurant]], a page describing food source policies. In the case of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], an ethicsPolicy is typically a statement describing the personal, organizational, and corporate standards of behavior expected by the organization.

label: event
definition: Upcoming or past event associated with this place, organization, or action.
domain: schema:InformAction; schema:InviteAction; schema:JoinAction; schema:LeaveAction; schema:Organization; schema:Place; schema:PlayAction

label: eventAttendanceMode
definition: The eventAttendanceMode of an event indicates whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix.

label: eventSchedule
definition: Associates an [[Event]] with a [[Schedule]]. There are circumstances where it is preferable to share a schedule for a series of repeating events rather than data on the individual events themselves. For example, a website or application might prefer to publish a schedule for a weekly gym class rather than provide data on every event. A schedule could be processed by applications to add forthcoming events to a calendar. An [[Event]] that is associated with a [[Schedule]] using this property should not have [[startDate]] or [[endDate]] properties. These are instead defined within the associated [[Schedule]], this avoids any ambiguity for clients using the data. The property might have repeated values to specify different schedules, e.g. for different months or seasons.

label: eventStatus
definition: An eventStatus of an event represents its status; particularly useful when an event is cancelled or rescheduled.

label: events
definition: Upcoming or past events associated with this place or organization.

label: evidenceLevel
definition: Strength of evidence of the data used to formulate the guideline (enumerated).

label: evidenceOrigin
definition: Source of the data used to formulate the guidance, e.g. RCT, consensus opinion, etc.

label: exampleOfWork
definition: A creative work that this work is an example/instance/realization/derivation of.

label: exceptDate
definition: Defines a [[Date]] or [[DateTime]] during which a scheduled [[Event]] will not take place. The property allows exceptions to a [[Schedule]] to be specified. If an exception is specified as a [[DateTime]] then only the event that would have started at that specific date and time should be excluded from the schedule. If an exception is specified as a [[Date]] then any event that is scheduled for that 24 hour period should be excluded from the schedule. This allows a whole day to be excluded from the schedule without having to itemise every scheduled event.

label: exchangeRateSpread
definition: The difference between the price at which a broker or other intermediary buys and sells foreign currency.

label: executableLibraryName
definition: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

label: exerciseCourse
definition: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

label: exercisePlan
definition: A sub property of instrument. The exercise plan used on this action.

label: exerciseRelatedDiet
definition: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

label: exerciseType
definition: Type(s) of exercise or activity, such as strength training, flexibility training, aerobics, cardiac rehabilitation, etc.

label: exifData
definition: exif data for this object.

label: expectedArrivalFrom
definition: The earliest date the package may arrive.

label: expectedArrivalUntil
definition: The latest date the package may arrive.

label: expectedPrognosis
definition: The likely outcome in either the short term or long term of the medical condition.

label: expectsAcceptanceOf
definition: An Offer which must be accepted before the user can perform the Action. For example, the user may need to buy a movie before being able to watch it.

label: experienceInPlaceOfEducation
definition: Indicates whether a [[JobPosting]] will accept experience (as indicated by [[OccupationalExperienceRequirements]]) in place of its formal educational qualifications (as indicated by [[educationRequirements]]). If true, indicates that satisfying one of these requirements is sufficient.

label: experienceRequirements
definition: Description of skills and experience needed for the position or Occupation.

label: expertConsiderations
definition: Medical expert advice related to the plan.

label: expires
definition: Date the content expires and is no longer useful or available. For example a [[VideoObject]] or [[NewsArticle]] whose availability or relevance is time-limited, a [[ClaimReview]] fact check whose publisher wants to indicate that it may no longer be relevant (or helpful to highlight) after some date, or a [[Certification]] the validity has expired.

label: expressedIn
definition: Tissue, organ, biological sample, etc in which activity of this gene has been observed experimentally. For example brain, digestive system.

label: extendedAddress
definition: An address extension such as an apartment number, C/O or alternative name.

label: familyName
definition: Family name. In the U.S., the last name of a Person.

label: fatContent
definition: The number of grams of fat.

label: faxNumber
definition: The fax number.

label: featureList
definition: Features or modules provided by this application (and possibly required by other applications).

label: feesAndCommissionsSpecification
definition: Description of fees, commissions, and other terms applied either to a class of financial product, or by a financial service organization.

label: fiberContent
definition: The number of grams of fiber.

label: fileFormat
definition: Media type, typically MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml)) of the content, e.g. application/zip of a SoftwareApplication binary. In cases where a CreativeWork has several media type representations, 'encoding' can be used to indicate each MediaObject alongside particular fileFormat information. Unregistered or niche file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia entry.

label: fileSize
definition: Size of the application / package (e.g. 18MB). In the absence of a unit (MB, KB etc.), KB will be assumed.

label: financialAidEligible
definition: A financial aid type or program which students may use to pay for tuition or fees associated with the program.

label: firstAppearance
definition: Indicates the first known occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

label: firstPerformance
definition: The date and place the work was first performed.

label: flightDistance
definition: The distance of the flight.

label: flightNumber
definition: The unique identifier for a flight including the airline IATA code. For example, if describing United flight 110, where the IATA code for United is 'UA', the flightNumber is 'UA110'.

label: floorLevel
definition: The floor level for an [[Accommodation]] in a multi-storey building. Since counting systems [vary internationally](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Storey#Consecutive_number_floor_designations), the local system should be used where possible.

label: floorLimit
definition: A floor limit is the amount of money above which credit card transactions must be authorized.

label: floorSize
definition: The size of the accommodation, e.g. in square meter or squarefoot. Typical unit code(s): MTK for square meter, FTK for square foot, or YDK for square yard.

label: followee
definition: A sub property of object. The person or organization being followed.

label: follows
definition: The most generic uni-directional social relation.

label: followup
definition: Typical or recommended followup care after the procedure is performed.

label: foodEstablishment
definition: A sub property of location. The specific food establishment where the action occurred.

label: foodEvent
definition: A sub property of location. The specific food event where the action occurred.

label: foodWarning
definition: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of specific foods while taking this drug.

label: founder
definition: A person or organization who founded this organization.

label: founders
definition: A person who founded this organization.

label: foundingDate
definition: The date that this organization was founded.

label: foundingLocation
definition: The place where the Organization was founded.

label: free
definition: A flag to signal that the item, event, or place is accessible for free.

label: freeShippingThreshold
definition: A monetary value above (or at) which the shipping rate becomes free. Intended to be used via an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with [[shippingSettingsLink]] matching this [[ShippingRateSettings]].

label: frequency
definition: How often the dose is taken, e.g. 'daily'.

label: fromLocation
definition: A sub property of location. The original location of the object or the agent before the action.

label: fuelCapacity
definition: The capacity of the fuel tank or in the case of electric cars, the battery. If there are multiple components for storage, this should indicate the total of all storage of the same type.\n\nTypical unit code(s): LTR for liters, GLL of US gallons, GLI for UK / imperial gallons, AMH for ampere-hours (for electrical vehicles).

label: fuelConsumption
definition:
The amount of fuel consumed for traveling a particular distance or temporal duration with the given vehicle (e.g. liters per 100 km).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for liters per 100 km. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. L/100 km.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel consumption to another value.

label: fuelEfficiency
definition:
The distance traveled per unit of fuel used; most commonly miles per gallon (mpg) or kilometers per liter (km/L).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for miles per gallon or kilometers per liter. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. mpg or km/L.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel economy to another value.

label: fuelType
definition: The type of fuel suitable for the engine or engines of the vehicle. If the vehicle has only one engine, this property can be attached directly to the vehicle.

label: fulfillmentType
definition: Type of fulfillment applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

label: functionalClass
definition: The degree of mobility the joint allows.

label: fundedItem
definition: Indicates something directly or indirectly funded or sponsored through a [[Grant]]. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].
