label: isUnlabelledFallback
definition: This can be marked 'true' to indicate that some published [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] or [[ShippingRateSettings]] are intended to apply to all [[OfferShippingDetails]] published by the same merchant, when referenced by a [[shippingSettingsLink]] in those settings. It is not meaningful to use a 'true' value for this property alongside a transitTimeLabel (for [[DeliveryTimeSettings]]) or shippingLabel (for [[ShippingRateSettings]]), since this property is for use with unlabelled settings.

label: isVariantOf
definition: Indicates the kind of product that this is a variant of. In the case of [[ProductModel]], this is a pointer (from a ProductModel) to a base product from which this product is a variant. It is safe to infer that the variant inherits all product features from the base model, unless defined locally. This is not transitive. In the case of a [[ProductGroup]], the group description also serves as a template, representing a set of Products that vary on explicitly defined, specific dimensions only (so it defines both a set of variants, as well as which values distinguish amongst those variants). When used with [[ProductGroup]], this property can apply to any [[Product]] included in the group.

label: isbn
definition: The ISBN of the book.

label: isicV4
definition: The International Standard of Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC), Revision 4 code for a particular organization, business person, or place.

label: iso6523Code
definition: An organization identifier as defined in [ISO 6523(-1)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO/IEC_6523). The identifier should be in the `XXXX:YYYYYY:ZZZ` or `XXXX:YYYYYY`format. Where `XXXX` is a 4 digit _ICD_ (International Code Designator), `YYYYYY` is an _OID_ (Organization Identifier) with all formatting characters (dots, dashes, spaces) removed with a maximal length of 35 characters, and `ZZZ` is an optional OPI (Organization Part Identifier) with a maximum length of 35 characters. The various components (ICD, OID, OPI) are joined with a colon character (ASCII `0x3a`). Note that many existing organization identifiers defined as attributes like [leiCode](https://schema.org/leiCode) (`0199`), [duns](https://schema.org/duns) (`0060`) or [GLN](https://schema.org/globalLocationNumber) (`0088`) can be expressed using ISO-6523. If possible, ISO-6523 codes should be preferred to populating [vatID](https://schema.org/vatID) or [taxID](https://schema.org/taxID), as ISO identifiers are less ambiguous.

label: isrcCode
definition: The International Standard Recording Code for the recording.

label: issn
definition: The International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) that identifies this serial publication. You can repeat this property to identify different formats of, or the linking ISSN (ISSN-L) for, this serial publication.

label: issueNumber
definition: Identifies the issue of publication; for example, "iii" or "2".

label: issuedBy
definition: The organization issuing the item, for example a [[Permit]], [[Ticket]], or [[Certification]].

label: issuedThrough
definition: The service through which the permit was granted.

label: iswcCode
definition: The International Standard Musical Work Code for the composition.

label: item
definition: An entity represented by an entry in a list or data feed (e.g. an 'artist' in a list of 'artists').

label: itemCondition
definition: A predefined value from OfferItemCondition specifying the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer. Also used for product return policies to specify the condition of products accepted for returns.

label: itemDefectReturnFees
definition: The type of return fees for returns of defect products.

label: itemDefectReturnLabelSource
definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a defect product.

label: itemDefectReturnShippingFeesAmount
definition: Amount of shipping costs for defect product returns. Applicable when property [[itemDefectReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

label: itemListElement
definition:
For itemListElement values, you can use simple strings (e.g. "Peter", "Paul", "Mary"), existing entities, or use ListItem.

Text values are best if the elements in the list are plain strings. Existing entities are best for a simple, unordered list of existing things in your data. ListItem is used with ordered lists when you want to provide additional context about the element in that list or when the same item might be in different places in different lists.

Note: The order of elements in your mark-up is not sufficient for indicating the order or elements. Use ListItem with a 'position' property in such cases.

label: itemListOrder
definition: Type of ordering (e.g. Ascending, Descending, Unordered).

label: itemLocation
definition: Current location of the item.

label: itemOffered
definition: An item being offered (or demanded). The transactional nature of the offer or demand is documented using [[businessFunction]], e.g. sell, lease etc. While several common expected types are listed explicitly in this definition, others can be used. Using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.
range: schema:AggregateOffer; schema:CreativeWork; schema:Event; schema:MenuItem; schema:Product; schema:Service; schema:Trip

label: itemPopularity
definition: A measure of the relative popularity or sales rank of the offer within a marketplace, catalog, or platform (e.g. a platform-specific bestseller ranking or sales rank). This property is intended for platform-level or catalog-wide comparative rankings rather than self-asserted promotional claims.

label: itemReviewed
definition: The item that is being reviewed/rated.

label: itemShipped
definition: Item(s) being shipped.

label: itinerary
definition: Destination(s) ( [[Place]] ) that make up a trip. For a trip where destination order is important use [[ItemList]] to specify that order (see examples).

label: iupacName
definition: Systematic method of naming chemical compounds as recommended by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC).

label: jobBenefits
definition: Description of benefits associated with the job.

label: jobDuration
definition: The expected duration of an employment offer as advertised by the employer. Relevant for job postings that have a clearly defined period in mind such as seasonal work, substitutes for maternal leave or any other temporary employment.

label: jobImmediateStart
definition: An indicator as to whether a position is available for an immediate start.

label: jobLocation
definition: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

label: jobLocationType
definition: A description of the job location (e.g. TELECOMMUTE for telecommute jobs).

label: jobStartDate
definition: The date on which a successful applicant for this job would be expected to start work. Choose a specific date in the future or use the jobImmediateStart property to indicate the position is to be filled as soon as possible.

label: jobTitle
definition: The job title of the person (for example, Financial Manager).

label: jurisdiction
definition: Indicates a legal jurisdiction, e.g. of some legislation, or where some government service is based.

label: keywords
definition: Keywords or tags used to describe some item. Multiple textual entries in a keywords list are typically delimited by commas, or by repeating the property.

label: knownVehicleDamages
definition: A textual description of known damages, both repaired and unrepaired.

label: knows
definition: The most generic bi-directional social/work relation.

label: knowsAbout
definition: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a topic that is known about - suggesting possible expertise but not implying it. We do not distinguish skill levels here, or relate this to educational content, events, objectives or [[JobPosting]] descriptions.

label: knowsLanguage
definition: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a known language. We do not distinguish skill levels or reading/writing/speaking/signing here. Use language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).

label: labelDetails
definition: Link to the drug's label details.

label: landlord
definition: A sub property of participant. The owner of the real estate property.

label: language
definition: A sub property of instrument. The language used on this action.

label: lastReviewed
definition: Date on which the content on this web page was last reviewed for accuracy and/or completeness.

label: latitude
definition: The latitude of a location. For example ```37.42242``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

label: layoutImage
definition: A schematic image showing the floorplan layout.

label: learningResourceType
definition: The predominant type or kind characterizing the learning resource. For example, 'presentation', 'handout'.

label: leaseLength
definition: Length of the lease for some [[Accommodation]], either particular to some [[Offer]] or in some cases intrinsic to the property.

label: legalAddress
definition: The legal address of an organization which acts as the officially registered address used for legal and tax purposes. The legal address can be different from the place of operations of a business and other addresses can be part of an organization.

label: legalName
definition: The official name of the organization, e.g. the registered company name.

label: legalRepresentative
definition: One or multiple persons who represent this organization legally such as CEO or sole administrator.

label: legalStatus
definition: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

label: legislationAmends
definition: Another legislation that this legislation amends, introducing legal changes.

label: legislationApplies
definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of a legislation) somehow transfers another legislation in a different legislative context. This is an informative link, and it has no legal value. For legally-binding links of transposition, use the legislationTransposes property. For example an informative consolidated law of a European Union's member state "applies" the consolidated version of the European Directive implemented in it.

label: legislationChanges
definition: Another legislation that this legislation changes. This encompasses the notions of amendment, replacement, correction, repeal, or other types of change. This may be a direct change (textual or non-textual amendment) or a consequential or indirect change. The property is to be used to express the existence of a change relationship between two acts rather than the existence of a consolidated version of the text that shows the result of the change. For consolidation relationships, use the legislationConsolidates property.

label: legislationCommences
definition: Another legislation that this one sets into force.

label: legislationConsolidates
definition: Indicates another legislation taken into account in this consolidated legislation (which is usually the product of an editorial process that revises the legislation). This property should be used multiple times to refer to both the original version or the previous consolidated version, and to the legislations making the change.

label: legislationCorrects
definition: Another legislation in which this one introduces textual changes, like correction of spelling mistakes, with no legal impact (for modifications that have legal impact, use legislationAmends).

label: legislationCountersignedBy
definition: The person or organization that countersigned the legislation. Depending on the legal context, a countersignature can indicate that the signed authority undertakes to assume responsibility for texts emanating from a person who is inviolable and irresponsible, (for example a King, Grand Duc or President), or that the authority is in charge of the implementation of the text.

label: legislationDate
definition: The date of adoption or signature of the legislation. This is the date at which the text is officially aknowledged to be a legislation, even though it might not even be published or in force.

label: legislationDateOfApplicability
definition: The date at which the Legislation becomes applicable. This can sometimes be distinct from the date of entry into force : a text may come in force today, and state it will become applicable in 3 months.

label: legislationDateVersion
definition: The point-in-time at which the provided description of the legislation is valid (e.g.: when looking at the law on the 2016-04-07 (= dateVersion), I get the consolidation of 2015-04-12 of the "National Insurance Contributions Act 2015")

label: legislationEnsuresImplementationOf
definition: Indicates that this Legislation ensures the implementation of another Legislation, for example by modifying national legislations so that they do not contradict to an EU regulation or decision. This implies a legal meaning. Transpositions of EU Directive should be captured with legislationTransposes.

label: legislationIdentifier
definition: An identifier for the legislation. This can be either a string-based identifier, like the CELEX at EU level or the NOR in France, or a web-based, URL/URI identifier, like an ELI (European Legislation Identifier) or an URN-Lex.

label: legislationJurisdiction
definition: The jurisdiction from which the legislation originates.

label: legislationLegalForce
definition: Whether the legislation is currently in force, not in force, or partially in force.

label: legislationLegalValue
definition: The legal value of this legislation file. The same legislation can be written in multiple files with different legal values. Typically a digitally signed PDF have a "stronger" legal value than the HTML file of the same act.

label: legislationPassedBy
definition: The person or organization that originally passed or made the law: typically parliament (for primary legislation) or government (for secondary legislation). This indicates the "legal author" of the law, as opposed to its physical author.

label: legislationRepeals
definition: Another legislation that this legislation repeals (cancels, abrogates).

label: legislationResponsible
definition: An individual or organization that has some kind of responsibility for the legislation. Typically the ministry who is/was in charge of elaborating the legislation, or the adressee for potential questions about the legislation once it is published.

label: legislationTransposes
definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of legislation) fulfills the objectives set by another legislation, by passing appropriate implementation measures. Typically, some legislations of European Union's member states or regions transpose European Directives. This indicates a legally binding link between the 2 legislations.

label: legislationType
definition: The type of the legislation. Examples of values are "law", "act", "directive", "decree", "regulation", "statutory instrument", "loi organique", "règlement grand-ducal", etc., depending on the country.

label: leiCode
definition: An organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal entity as defined in ISO 17442.

label: lender
definition: A sub property of participant. The person that lends the object being borrowed.

label: lesser
definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than the object.

label: lesserOrEqual
definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than or equal to the object.

label: letterer
definition: The individual who adds lettering, including speech balloons and sound effects, to artwork.

label: license
definition: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

label: lifeEvent
definition: A life event like baptism, communions, Bar Mitzvahs, Aqiqah, Namakarana, Miyamairi, burial, ....

label: line
definition: A line is a point-to-point path consisting of two or more points. A line is expressed as a series of two or more point objects separated by space.

label: linkRelationship
definition: Indicates the relationship type of a Web link.

label: liveBlogUpdate
definition: An update to the LiveBlog.

label: loanMortgageMandateAmount
definition: Amount of mortgage mandate that can be converted into a proper mortgage at a later stage.

label: loanPaymentAmount
definition: The amount of money to pay in a single payment.

label: loanPaymentFrequency
definition: Frequency of payments due, i.e. number of months between payments. This is defined as a frequency, i.e. the reciprocal of a period of time.

label: loanRepaymentForm
definition: A form of paying back money previously borrowed from a lender. Repayment usually takes the form of periodic payments that normally include part principal plus interest in each payment.

label: loanTerm
definition: The duration of the loan or credit agreement.

label: loanType
definition: The type of a loan or credit.

label: location
definition: The location of, for example, where an event is happening, where an organization is located, or where an action takes place.

label: locationCreated
definition: The location where the CreativeWork was created, which may not be the same as the location depicted in the CreativeWork.

label: lodgingUnitDescription
definition: A full description of the lodging unit.

label: lodgingUnitType
definition: Textual description of the unit type (including suite vs. room, size of bed, etc.).

label: logo
definition: An associated logo.
domain: schema:Brand; schema:Certification; schema:Organization; schema:Place; schema:Product; schema:Service

label: longitude
definition: The longitude of a location. For example ```-122.08585``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

label: loser
definition: A sub property of participant. The loser of the action.

label: lowPrice
definition:
The lowest price of all offers available.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

label: lyricist
definition: The person who wrote the words.

label: lyrics
definition: The words in the song.

label: mainContentOfPage
definition: Indicates if this web page element is the main subject of the page.

label: mainEntity
definition: Indicates the primary entity described in some page or other CreativeWork.

label: mainEntityOfPage
definition: Indicates a page (or other CreativeWork) for which this thing is the main entity being described. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#mainEntityBackground) for details.

label: maintainer
definition: A maintainer of a [[Dataset]], software package ([[SoftwareApplication]]), or other [[Project]]. A maintainer is a [[Person]] or [[Organization]] that manages contributions to, and/or publication of, some (typically complex) artifact. It is common for distributions of software and data to be based on "upstream" sources. When [[maintainer]] is applied to a specific version of something e.g. a particular version or packaging of a [[Dataset]], it is always possible that the upstream source has a different maintainer. The [[isBasedOn]] property can be used to indicate such relationships between datasets to make the different maintenance roles clear. Similarly in the case of software, a package may have dedicated maintainers working on integration into software distributions such as Ubuntu, as well as upstream maintainers of the underlying work.

label: makesOffer
definition: A pointer to products or services offered by the organization or person.

label: manufacturer
definition: The manufacturer of the product.

label: map
definition: A URL to a map of the place.

label: mapType
definition: Indicates the kind of Map, from the MapCategoryType Enumeration.

label: maps
definition: A URL to a map of the place.

label: marginOfError
definition: A [[marginOfError]] for an [[Observation]].

label: masthead
definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a link to the masthead page or a page listing top editorial management.

label: material
definition: A material that something is made from, e.g. leather, wool, cotton, paper.

label: materialExtent
definition: The quantity of the materials being described or an expression of the physical space they occupy.

label: mathExpression
definition: A mathematical expression (e.g. 'x^2-3x=0') that may be solved for a specific variable, simplified, or transformed. This can take many formats, e.g. LaTeX, Ascii-Math, or math as you would write with a keyboard.

label: maxPrice
definition: The highest price if the price is a range.

label: maxValue
definition: The upper value of some characteristic or property.

label: maximumAttendeeCapacity
definition: The total number of individuals that may attend an event or venue.

label: maximumEnrollment
definition: The maximum number of students who may be enrolled in the program.

label: maximumIntake
definition: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

label: maximumPhysicalAttendeeCapacity
definition: The maximum physical attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OfflineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the offline aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

label: maximumVirtualAttendeeCapacity
definition: The maximum virtual attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OnlineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the online aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

label: mealService
definition: Description of the meals that will be provided or available for purchase.

label: measuredProperty
definition: The measuredProperty of an [[Observation]], typically via its [[StatisticalVariable]]. There are various kinds of applicable [[Property]]: a schema.org property, a property from other RDF-compatible systems, e.g. W3C RDF Data Cube, Data Commons, Wikidata, or schema.org extensions such as [GS1's](https://www.gs1.org/voc/?show=properties).

label: measurementDenominator
definition: Identifies the denominator variable when an observation represents a ratio or percentage.

label: measurementMethod
definition: A subproperty of [[measurementTechnique]] that can be used for specifying specific methods, in particular via [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].
domain: schema:DataCatalog; schema:DataDownload; schema:Dataset; schema:Observation; schema:PropertyValue; schema:StatisticalVariable

label: measurementQualifier
definition: Provides additional qualification to an observation. For example, a GDP observation measures the Nominal value.

label: measurementTechnique
definition: A technique, method or technology used in an [[Observation]], [[StatisticalVariable]] or [[Dataset]] (or [[DataDownload]], [[DataCatalog]]), corresponding to the method used for measuring the corresponding variable(s) (for datasets, described using [[variableMeasured]]; for [[Observation]], a [[StatisticalVariable]]). Often but not necessarily each [[variableMeasured]] will have an explicit representation as (or mapping to) an property such as those defined in Schema.org, or other RDF vocabularies and "knowledge graphs". In that case the subproperty of [[variableMeasured]] called [[measuredProperty]] is applicable. The [[measurementTechnique]] property helps when extra clarification is needed about how a [[measuredProperty]] was measured. This is oriented towards scientific and scholarly dataset publication but may have broader applicability; it is not intended as a full representation of measurement, but can often serve as a high level summary for dataset discovery. For example, if [[variableMeasured]] is: molecule concentration, [[measurementTechnique]] could be: "mass spectrometry" or "nmr spectroscopy" or "colorimetry" or "immunofluorescence". If the [[variableMeasured]] is "depression rating", the [[measurementTechnique]] could be "Zung Scale" or "HAM-D" or "Beck Depression Inventory". If there are several [[variableMeasured]] properties recorded for some given data object, use a [[PropertyValue]] for each [[variableMeasured]] and attach the corresponding [[measurementTechnique]]. The value can also be from an enumeration, organized as a [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].
domain: schema:DataCatalog; schema:DataDownload; schema:Dataset; schema:Observation; schema:PropertyValue; schema:StatisticalVariable

label: mechanismOfAction
definition: The specific biochemical interaction through which this drug or supplement produces its pharmacological effect.

label: mediaAuthenticityCategory
definition: Indicates a MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration classification of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared).

label: mediaItemAppearance
definition: In the context of a [[MediaReview]], indicates specific media item(s) that are grouped using a [[MediaReviewItem]].

label: median
definition: The median value.

label: medicalAudience
definition: Medical audience for page.

label: medicalSpecialty
definition: A medical specialty of the provider.

label: medicineSystem
definition: The system of medicine that includes this MedicalEntity, for example 'evidence-based', 'homeopathic', 'chiropractic', etc.

label: meetsEmissionStandard
definition: Indicates that the vehicle meets the respective emission standard.

label: member
definition: A member of an Organization or a ProgramMembership. Organizations can be members of organizations; ProgramMembership is typically for individuals.

label: memberOf
definition: An Organization (or ProgramMembership) to which this Person or Organization belongs.

label: members
definition: A member of this organization.

label: membershipNumber
definition: A unique identifier for the membership.

label: membershipPointsEarned
definition: The number of membership points earned by the member. If necessary, the unitText can be used to express the units the points are issued in. (E.g. stars, miles, etc.)

label: memoryRequirements
definition: Minimum memory requirements.

label: mentions
definition: Indicates that the CreativeWork contains a reference to, but is not necessarily about a concept.

label: menu
definition: Either the actual menu as a structured representation, as text, or a URL of the menu.

label: menuAddOn
definition: Additional menu item(s) such as a side dish of salad or side order of fries that can be added to this menu item. Additionally it can be a menu section containing allowed add-on menu items for this menu item.

label: merchant
definition: 'merchant' is an out-dated term for 'seller'.

label: merchantReturnDays
definition: Specifies either a fixed return date or the number of days (from the delivery date) that a product can be returned. Used when the [[returnPolicyCategory]] property is specified as [[MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow]].

label: merchantReturnLink
definition: Specifies a Web page or service by URL, for product returns.

label: messageAttachment
definition: A CreativeWork attached to the message.

label: mileageFromOdometer
definition: The total distance travelled by the particular vehicle since its initial production, as read from its odometer.\n\nTypical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles.

label: minPrice
definition: The lowest price if the price is a range.

label: minValue
definition: The lower value of some characteristic or property.

label: minimumOrderValue
definition: The minimum order value required for this shipping rate to apply.

label: minimumPaymentDue
definition: The minimum payment required at this time.

label: missionCoveragePrioritiesPolicy
definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement on coverage priorities, including any public agenda or stance on issues.

label: mobileUrl
definition: The [[mobileUrl]] property is provided for specific situations in which data consumers need to determine whether one of several provided URLs is a dedicated 'mobile site'. To discourage over-use, and reflecting intial usecases, the property is expected only on [[Product]] and [[Offer]], rather than [[Thing]]. The general trend in web technology is towards [responsive design](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Responsive_web_design) in which content can be flexibly adapted to a wide range of browsing environments. Pages and sites referenced with the long-established [[url]] property should ideally also be usable on a wide variety of devices, including mobile phones. In most cases, it would be pointless and counter productive to attempt to update all [[url]] markup to use [[mobileUrl]] for more mobile-oriented pages. The property is intended for the case when items (primarily [[Product]] and [[Offer]]) have extra URLs hosted on an additional "mobile site" alongside the main one. It should not be taken as an endorsement of this publication style.

label: model
definition: The model of the product. Use with the URL of a ProductModel or a textual representation of the model identifier. The URL of the ProductModel can be from an external source. It is recommended to additionally provide strong product identifiers via the gtin8/gtin13/gtin14 and mpn properties.

label: modelDate
definition: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

label: modifiedTime
definition: The date and time the reservation was modified.

label: molecularFormula
definition: The empirical formula is the simplest whole number ratio of all the atoms in a molecule.

label: molecularWeight
definition: This is the molecular weight of the entity being described, not of the parent. Units should be included in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '12 amu' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

label: monoisotopicMolecularWeight
definition: The monoisotopic mass is the sum of the masses of the atoms in a molecule using the unbound, ground-state, rest mass of the principal (most abundant) isotope for each element instead of the isotopic average mass. Please include the units in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '770.230488 g/mol' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

label: monthlyMinimumRepaymentAmount
definition: The minimum payment is the lowest amount of money that one is required to pay on a credit card statement each month.

label: monthsOfExperience
definition: Indicates the minimal number of months of experience required for a position.

label: mpn
definition: The Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, or the product to which the offer refers.

label: multipleValues
definition: Whether multiple values are allowed for the property. Default is false.

label: muscleAction
definition: The movement the muscle generates.

label: musicArrangement
definition: An arrangement derived from the composition.

label: musicBy
definition: The composer of the soundtrack.
domain: schema:Clip; schema:Episode; schema:Movie; schema:MovieSeries; schema:RadioSeries; schema:TVSeries; schema:VideoGame; schema:VideoGameSeries; schema:VideoObject

label: musicCompositionForm
definition: The type of composition (e.g. overture, sonata, symphony, etc.).

label: musicGroupMember
definition: A member of a music group—for example, John, Paul, George, or Ringo.

label: musicReleaseFormat
definition: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

label: musicalKey
definition: The key, mode, or scale this composition uses.

label: naics
definition: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for a particular organization or business person.

label: name
definition: The name of the item.

label: namedPosition
definition: A position played, performed or filled by a person or organization, as part of an organization. For example, an athlete in a SportsTeam might play in the position named 'Quarterback'.

label: nationality
definition: Nationality of the person.

label: naturalProgression
definition: The expected progression of the condition if it is not treated and allowed to progress naturally.

label: negativeNotes
definition: Provides negative considerations regarding something, most typically in pro/con lists for reviews (alongside [[positiveNotes]]). For symmetry In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. Since product descriptions tend to emphasise positive claims, it may be relatively unusual to find [[negativeNotes]] used in this way. Nevertheless for the sake of symmetry, [[negativeNotes]] can be used on [[Product]]. The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most negative is at the beginning of the list).

label: nerve
definition: The underlying innervation associated with the muscle.

label: nerveMotor
definition: The neurological pathway extension that involves muscle control.

label: netWorth
definition: The total financial value of the person as calculated by subtracting the total value of liabilities from the total value of assets.

label: newsUpdatesAndGuidelines
definition: Indicates a page with news updates and guidelines. This could often be (but is not required to be) the main page containing [[SpecialAnnouncement]] markup on a site.

label: nextItem
definition: A link to the ListItem that follows the current one.

label: noBylinesPolicy
definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement explaining when authors of articles are not named in bylines.

label: nonEqual
definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is not equal to the object.

label: nonProprietaryName
definition: The generic name of this drug or supplement.

label: nonprofitStatus
definition: nonprofitStatus indicates the legal status of a non-profit organization in its primary place of business.

label: normalRange
definition: Range of acceptable values for a typical patient, when applicable.

label: nsn
definition: Indicates the [NATO stock number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO_Stock_Number) (nsn) of a [[Product]].

label: numAdults
definition: The number of adults staying in the unit.

label: numChildren
definition: The number of children staying in the unit.

label: numConstraints
definition: Indicates the number of constraints property values defined for a particular [[ConstraintNode]] such as [[StatisticalVariable]]. This helps applications understand if they have access to a sufficiently complete description of a [[StatisticalVariable]] or other construct that is defined using properties on template-style nodes.

label: numItems
definition: Limits the number of items being shipped for which these conditions apply.

label: numTracks
definition: The number of tracks in this album or playlist.

label: numberOfAccommodationUnits
definition: Indicates the total (available plus unavailable) number of accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits]].

label: numberOfAirbags
definition: The number or type of airbags in the vehicle.

label: numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits
definition: Indicates the number of available accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAccommodationUnits]].

label: numberOfAxles
definition: The number of axles.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

label: numberOfBathroomsTotal
definition: The total integer number of bathrooms in some [[Accommodation]], following real estate conventions as [documented in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsTotalInteger+Field): "The simple sum of the number of bathrooms. For example for a property with two Full Bathrooms and one Half Bathroom, the Bathrooms Total Integer will be 3.". See also [[numberOfRooms]].

label: numberOfBedrooms
definition: The total integer number of bedrooms in a some [[Accommodation]], [[ApartmentComplex]] or [[FloorPlan]].

label: numberOfBeds
definition: The quantity of the given bed type available in the HotelRoom, Suite, House, or Apartment.

label: numberOfCredits
definition: The number of credits or units awarded by a Course or required to complete an EducationalOccupationalProgram.

label: numberOfDoors
definition: The number of doors.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

label: numberOfEmployees
definition: The number of employees in an organization, e.g. business.

label: numberOfEpisodes
definition: The number of episodes in this season or series.

label: numberOfForwardGears
definition: The total number of forward gears available for the transmission system of the vehicle.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

label: numberOfFullBathrooms
definition: Number of full bathrooms - The total number of full and ¾ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsFull field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsFull+Field).

label: numberOfItems
definition: The number of items in an ItemList. Note that some descriptions might not fully describe all items in a list (e.g., multi-page pagination); in such cases, the numberOfItems would be for the entire list.

label: numberOfLoanPayments
definition: The number of payments contractually required at origination to repay the loan. For monthly paying loans this is the number of months from the contractual first payment date to the maturity date.

label: numberOfPages
definition: The number of pages in the book.

label: numberOfPartialBathrooms
definition: Number of partial bathrooms - The total number of half and ¼ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsPartial field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsPartial+Field).

label: numberOfPlayers
definition: Indicate how many people can play this game (minimum, maximum, or range).

label: numberOfPreviousOwners
definition: The number of owners of the vehicle, including the current one.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

label: numberOfRooms
definition: The number of rooms (excluding bathrooms and closets) of the accommodation or lodging business. Typical unit code(s): ROM for room or C62 for no unit. The type of room can be put in the unitText property of the QuantitativeValue.
domain: schema:Accommodation; schema:Apartment; schema:FloorPlan; schema:House; schema:LodgingBusiness; schema:SingleFamilyResidence; schema:Suite

label: numberOfSeasons
definition: The number of seasons in this series.

label: numberedPosition
definition: A number associated with a role in an organization, for example, the number on an athlete's jersey.

label: nutrition
definition: Nutrition information about the recipe or menu item.

label: object
definition: The object upon which the action is carried out, whose state is kept intact or changed. Also known as the semantic roles patient, affected or undergoer (which change their state) or theme (which doesn't). E.g. John read *a book*.

label: observationAbout
definition: The [[observationAbout]] property identifies an entity, often a [[Place]], associated with an [[Observation]].

label: observationDate
definition: The observationDate of an [[Observation]].

label: observationPeriod
definition: The length of time an Observation took place over. The format follows `P[0-9]*[Y|M|D|h|m|s]`. For example, P1Y is Period 1 Year, P3M is Period 3 Months, P3h is Period 3 hours.

label: occupancy
definition: The allowed total occupancy for the accommodation in persons (including infants etc). For individual accommodations, this is not necessarily the legal maximum but defines the permitted usage as per the contractual agreement (e.g. a double room used by a single person). Typical unit code(s): C62 for person.

label: occupationLocation
definition: The region/country for which this occupational description is appropriate. Note that educational requirements and qualifications can vary between jurisdictions.

label: occupationalCategory
definition: A category describing the job, preferably using a term from a taxonomy such as [BLS O*NET-SOC](http://www.onetcenter.org/taxonomy.html), [ISCO-08](https://www.ilo.org/public/english/bureau/stat/isco/isco08/) or similar, with the property repeated for each applicable value. Ideally the taxonomy should be identified, and both the textual label and formal code for the category should be provided.\n Note: for historical reasons, any textual label and formal code provided as a literal may be assumed to be from O*NET-SOC.

label: occupationalCredentialAwarded
definition: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other occupational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

label: offerCount
definition: The number of offers for the product.

label: offeredBy
definition: A pointer to the organization or person making the offer.

label: offers
definition: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.
domain: schema:AggregateOffer; schema:CreativeWork; schema:EducationalOccupationalProgram; schema:Event; schema:MenuItem; schema:Product; schema:Service; schema:Trip

label: offersPrescriptionByMail
definition: Whether prescriptions can be delivered by mail.

label: openingHours
definition: The general opening hours for a business. Opening hours can be specified as a weekly time range, starting with days, then times per day. Multiple days can be listed with commas ',' separating each day. Day or time ranges are specified using a hyphen '-'. * Days are specified using the following two-letter combinations: ```Mo```, ```Tu```, ```We```, ```Th```, ```Fr```, ```Sa```, ```Su```. * Times are specified using 24:00 format. For example, 3pm is specified as ```15:00```, 10am as ```10:00```. * Here is an example: <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Tu,Th 16:00-20:00">Tuesdays and Thursdays 4-8pm</time>. * If a business is open 7 days a week, then it can be specified as <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Mo-Su">Monday through Sunday, all day</time>.

label: openingHoursSpecification
definition: The opening hours of a certain place.

label: opens
definition: The opening hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

label: operatingSystem
definition: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

label: opponent
definition: A sub property of participant. The opponent on this action.

label: option
definition: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

label: orderDate
definition: Date order was placed.

label: orderDelivery
definition: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.

label: orderItemNumber
definition: The identifier of the order item.

label: orderItemStatus
definition: The current status of the order item.

label: orderNumber
definition: The identifier of the transaction.

label: orderPercentage
definition: Value representing the fraction of the value of the order that is charged as shipping cost. Example: 0.10 would mean shipping rate is 10% of the total order value.

label: orderQuantity
definition: The number of the item ordered. If the property is not set, assume the quantity is one.

label: orderStatus
definition: The current status of the order.

label: orderValue
definition: Minimum and maximum order value for which these shipping conditions are valid.

label: orderedItem
definition: The item ordered.

label: organizer
definition: An organizer of an Event.

label: originAddress
definition: Shipper's address.

label: originalMediaContextDescription
definition: Describes, in a [[MediaReview]] when dealing with [[DecontextualizedContent]], background information that can contribute to better interpretation of the [[MediaObject]].

label: originalMediaLink
definition: Link to the page containing an original version of the content, or directly to an online copy of the original [[MediaObject]] content, e.g. video file.

label: originatesFrom
definition: The vasculature the lymphatic structure originates, or afferents, from.

label: overdosage
definition: Any information related to overdose on a drug, including signs or symptoms, treatments, contact information for emergency response.

label: ownedFrom
definition: The date and time of obtaining the product.

label: ownedThrough
definition: The date and time of giving up ownership on the product.

label: owner
definition: A person or organization who owns this Thing.

label: ownershipFundingInfo
definition: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a description of organizational ownership structure; funding and grants. In a news/media setting, this is with particular reference to editorial independence. Note that the [[funder]] is also available and can be used to make basic funder information machine-readable.

label: owns
definition: Things owned by the organization or person.

label: pageEnd
definition: The page on which the work ends; for example "138" or "xvi".

label: pageStart
definition: The page on which the work starts; for example "135" or "xiii".

label: pagination
definition: Any description of pages that is not separated into pageStart and pageEnd; for example, "1-6, 9, 55" or "10-12, 46-49".

label: parent
definition: A parent of this person.

label: parentItem
definition: The parent of a question, answer or item in general. Typically used for Q/A discussion threads e.g. a chain of comments with the first comment being an [[Article]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. See also [[comment]] which points from something to a comment about it.

label: parentOrganization
definition: The larger organization that this organization is a [[subOrganization]] of, if any.

label: parentService
definition: A broadcast service to which the broadcast service may belong to such as regional variations of a national channel.

label: parentTaxon
definition: Closest parent taxon of the taxon in question.

label: parents
definition: A parents of the person.

label: partOfEpisode
definition: The episode to which this clip belongs.

label: partOfInvoice
definition: The order is being paid as part of the referenced Invoice.

label: partOfOrder
definition: The overall order the items in this delivery were included in.

label: partOfSeason
definition: The season to which this episode belongs.

label: partOfSeries
definition: The series to which this episode or season belongs.

label: partOfSystem
definition: The anatomical or organ system that this structure is part of.

label: partOfTVSeries
definition: The TV series to which this episode or season belongs.

label: partOfTrip
definition: Identifies that this [[Trip]] is a subTrip of another Trip. For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

label: participant
definition: Other co-agents that participated in the action indirectly. E.g. John wrote a book with *Steve*.

label: partySize
definition: Number of people the reservation should accommodate.

label: passengerPriorityStatus
definition: The priority status assigned to a passenger for security or boarding (e.g. FastTrack or Priority).

label: passengerSequenceNumber
definition: The passenger's sequence number as assigned by the airline.

label: pathophysiology
definition: Changes in the normal mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions that are associated with this activity or condition.

label: pattern
definition: A pattern that something has, for example 'polka dot', 'striped', 'Canadian flag'. Values are typically expressed as text, although links to controlled value schemes are also supported.

label: payload
definition:
The permitted weight of passengers and cargo, EXCLUDING the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: Many databases specify the permitted TOTAL weight instead, which is the sum of [[weight]] and [[payload]]
* Note 2: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 3: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 4: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: paymentAccepted
definition: Cash, Credit Card, Cryptocurrency, Local Exchange Tradings System, etc.

label: paymentDue
definition: The date that payment is due.

label: paymentDueDate
definition: The date that payment is due.

label: paymentMethod
definition: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

label: paymentMethodId
definition: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).

label: paymentMethodType
definition: The type of a payment method.

label: paymentStatus
definition: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

label: paymentUrl
definition: The URL for sending a payment.

label: penciler
definition: The individual who draws the primary narrative artwork.

label: percentile10
definition: The 10th percentile value.

label: percentile25
definition: The 25th percentile value.

label: percentile75
definition: The 75th percentile value.

label: percentile90
definition: The 90th percentile value.

label: performTime
definition: The length of time it takes to perform instructions or a direction (not including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

label: performer
definition: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

label: performerIn
definition: Event that this person is a performer or participant in.

label: performers
definition: The main performer or performers of the event—for example, a presenter, musician, or actor.

label: permissionType
definition: The type of permission granted the person, organization, or audience.

label: permissions
definition: Permission(s) required to run the app (for example, a mobile app may require full internet access or may run only on wifi).

label: permitAudience
definition: The target audience for this permit.

label: permittedUsage
definition: Indications regarding the permitted usage of the accommodation.

label: petsAllowed
definition: Indicates whether pets are allowed to enter the accommodation or lodging business. More detailed information can be put in a text value.

label: phoneticText
definition: Representation of a text [[textValue]] using the specified [[speechToTextMarkup]]. For example the city name of Houston in IPA: /ˈhjuːstən/.

label: photo
definition: A photograph of this place.

label: photos
definition: Photographs of this place.

label: physicalRequirement
definition: A description of the types of physical activity associated with the job. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

label: physiologicalBenefits
definition: Specific physiologic benefits associated to the plan.

label: pickupLocation
definition: Where a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

label: pickupTime
definition: When a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

label: playMode
definition: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player. The game can be marked as multi-player, co-op and single-player at the same time.

label: playerType
definition: Player type required—for example, Flash or Silverlight.

label: playersOnline
definition: Number of players on the server.

label: polygon
definition: A polygon is the area enclosed by a point-to-point path for which the starting and ending points are the same. A polygon is expressed as a series of four or more space delimited points where the first and final points are identical.

label: populationType
definition: Indicates the populationType common to all members of a [[StatisticalPopulation]] or all cases within the scope of a [[StatisticalVariable]].

label: position
definition: The position of an item in a series or sequence of items.

label: positiveNotes
definition: Provides positive considerations regarding something, for example product highlights or (alongside [[negativeNotes]]) pro/con lists for reviews. In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most positive is at the beginning of the list).

label: possibleComplication
definition: A possible unexpected and unfavorable evolution of a medical condition. Complications may include worsening of the signs or symptoms of the disease, extension of the condition to other organ systems, etc.

label: possibleTreatment
definition: A possible treatment to address this condition, sign or symptom.

label: postOfficeBoxNumber
definition: The post office box number for PO box addresses.

label: postOp
definition: A description of the postoperative procedures, care, and/or followups for this device.

label: postalCode
definition: The postal code. For example, 94043.

label: postalCodeBegin
definition: First postal code in a range (included).

label: postalCodeEnd
definition: Last postal code in the range (included). Needs to be after [[postalCodeBegin]].

label: postalCodePrefix
definition: A defined range of postal codes indicated by a common textual prefix. Used for non-numeric systems such as UK.

label: postalCodeRange
definition: A defined range of postal codes.

label: potentialAction
definition: Indicates a potential Action, which describes an idealized action in which this thing would play an 'object' role.

label: potentialUse
definition: Intended use of the BioChemEntity by humans.

label: practicesAt
definition: A [[MedicalOrganization]] where the [[IndividualPhysician]] practices.

label: preOp
definition: A description of the workup, testing, and other preparations required before implanting this device.

label: predecessorOf
definition: A pointer from a previous, often discontinued variant of the product to its newer variant.

label: pregnancyCategory
definition: Pregnancy category of this drug.

label: pregnancyWarning
definition: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use during pregnancy.

label: prepTime
definition: The length of time it takes to prepare the items to be used in instructions or a direction, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

label: preparation
definition: Typical preparation that a patient must undergo before having the procedure performed.

label: prescribingInfo
definition: Link to prescribing information for the drug.

label: prescriptionStatus
definition: Indicates the status of drug prescription, e.g. local catalogs classifications or whether the drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter, etc.

label: previousItem
definition: A link to the ListItem that precedes the current one.

label: previousStartDate
definition: Used in conjunction with eventStatus for rescheduled or cancelled events. This property contains the previously scheduled start date. For rescheduled events, the startDate property should be used for the newly scheduled start date. In the (rare) case of an event that has been postponed and rescheduled multiple times, this field may be repeated.

label: price
definition:
The offer price of a product, or of a price component when attached to PriceSpecification and its subtypes.

Usage guidelines:

* Use the [[priceCurrency]] property (with standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR") instead of including [ambiguous symbols](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dollar_sign#Currencies_that_use_the_dollar_or_peso_sign) such as '$' in the value.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
* Note that both [RDFa](http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml-rdfa-primer/#using-the-content-attribute) and Microdata syntax allow the use of a "content=" attribute for publishing simple machine-readable values alongside more human-friendly formatting.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.

label: priceComponent
definition: This property links to all [[UnitPriceSpecification]] nodes that apply in parallel for the [[CompoundPriceSpecification]] node.

label: priceComponentType
definition: Identifies a price component (for example, a line item on an invoice), part of the total price for an offer.

label: priceCurrency
definition: The currency of the price, or a price component when attached to [[PriceSpecification]] and its subtypes.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".
domain: schema:DonateAction; schema:Offer; schema:PriceSpecification; schema:Reservation; schema:Ticket; schema:TradeAction

label: priceRange
definition: The price range of the business, for example ```$$$```.

label: priceSpecification
definition: One or more detailed price specifications, indicating the unit price and delivery or payment charges.

label: priceType
definition: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

label: priceValidUntil
definition: The date after which the price is no longer available.

label: primaryImageOfPage
definition: Indicates the main image on the page.

label: primaryPrevention
definition: A preventative therapy used to prevent an initial occurrence of the medical condition, such as vaccination.

label: printColumn
definition: The number of the column in which the NewsArticle appears in the print edition.

label: printEdition
definition: The edition of the print product in which the NewsArticle appears.

label: printPage
definition: If this NewsArticle appears in print, this field indicates the name of the page on which the article is found. Please note that this field is intended for the exact page name (e.g. A5, B18).

label: printSection
definition: If this NewsArticle appears in print, this field indicates the print section in which the article appeared.

label: procedure
definition: A description of the procedure involved in setting up, using, and/or installing the device.

label: procedureType
definition: The type of procedure, for example Surgical, Noninvasive, or Percutaneous.

label: processingTime
definition: Estimated processing time for the service using this channel.

label: processorRequirements
definition: Processor architecture required to run the application (e.g. IA64).

label: producer
definition: The person or organization who produced the work (e.g. music album, movie, TV/radio series etc.).

label: produces
definition: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.

label: productGroupID
definition: Indicates a textual identifier for a ProductGroup.

label: productID
definition: The product identifier, such as ISBN. For example: ``` meta itemprop="productID" content="isbn:123-456-789" ```.

label: productReturnDays
definition: The productReturnDays property indicates the number of days (from purchase) within which relevant product return policy is applicable.

label: productReturnLink
definition: Indicates a Web page or service by URL, for product return.

label: productSupported
definition: The product or service this support contact point is related to (such as product support for a particular product line). This can be a specific product or product line (e.g. "iPhone") or a general category of products or services (e.g. "smartphones").

label: productionCompany
definition: The production company or studio responsible for the item, e.g. series, video game, episode etc.
domain: schema:CreativeWorkSeason; schema:Episode; schema:MediaObject; schema:Movie; schema:MovieSeries; schema:RadioSeries; schema:TVSeries; schema:VideoGameSeries

label: productionDate
definition: The date of production of the item, e.g. vehicle.

label: proficiencyLevel
definition: Proficiency needed for this content; expected values: 'Beginner', 'Expert'.

label: program
definition: The [MemberProgram](https://schema.org/MemberProgram) associated with a [ProgramMembership](https://schema.org/ProgramMembership).

label: programMembershipUsed
definition: Any membership in a frequent flyer, hotel loyalty program, etc. being applied to the reservation.

label: programName
definition: The program providing the membership. It is preferable to use [:program](https://schema.org/program) instead.

label: programPrerequisites
definition: Prerequisites for enrolling in the program.

label: programType
definition: The type of educational or occupational program. For example, classroom, internship, alternance, etc.

label: programmingLanguage
definition: The computer programming language.

label: programmingModel
definition: Indicates whether API is managed or unmanaged.

label: pronouns
definition: A short string listing or describing pronouns for a person. Typically the person concerned is the best authority as pronouns are a critical part of personal identity and expression. Publishers and consumers of this information are reminded to treat this data responsibly, take country-specific laws related to gender expression into account, and be wary of out-of-date data and drawing unwarranted inferences about the person being described. In English, formulations such as "they/them", "she/her", and "he/him" are commonly used online and can also be used here. We do not intend to enumerate all possible micro-syntaxes in all languages. More structured and well-defined external values for pronouns can be referenced using the [[StructuredValue]] or [[DefinedTerm]] values.

label: propertyID
definition: A commonly used identifier for the characteristic represented by the property, e.g. a manufacturer or a standard code for a property. propertyID can be (1) a prefixed string, mainly meant to be used with standards for product properties; (2) a site-specific, non-prefixed string (e.g. the primary key of the property or the vendor-specific ID of the property), or (3) a URL indicating the type of the property, either pointing to an external vocabulary, or a Web resource that describes the property (e.g. a glossary entry). Standards bodies should promote a standard prefix for the identifiers of properties from their standards.

label: proprietaryName
definition: Proprietary name given to the diet plan, typically by its originator or creator.

label: proteinContent
definition: The number of grams of protein.

label: provider
definition: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.
domain: schema:Action; schema:CreativeWork; schema:EducationalOccupationalProgram; schema:FinancialIncentive; schema:Invoice; schema:OfferShippingDetails; schema:ParcelDelivery; schema:Reservation; schema:Service; schema:Trip

label: providerMobility
definition: Indicates the mobility of a provided service (e.g. 'static', 'dynamic').

label: providesBroadcastService
definition: The BroadcastService offered on this channel.

label: providesService
definition: The service provided by this channel.

label: publicAccess
definition: A flag to signal that the [[Place]] is open to public visitors. If this property is omitted there is no assumed default boolean value.

label: publicTransportClosuresInfo
definition: Information about public transport closures.

label: publication
definition: A publication event associated with the item.

label: publicationType
definition: The type of the medical article, taken from the US NLM MeSH publication type catalog. See also [MeSH documentation](http://www.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/pubtypes.html).

label: publishedBy
definition: An agent associated with the publication event.

label: publishedOn
definition: A broadcast service associated with the publication event.

label: publisher
definition: The publisher of the article in question.

label: publisherImprint
definition: The publishing division which published the comic.

label: publishingPrinciples
definition: The publishingPrinciples property indicates (typically via [[URL]]) a document describing the editorial principles of an [[Organization]] (or individual, e.g. a [[Person]] writing a blog) that relate to their activities as a publisher, e.g. ethics or diversity policies. When applied to a [[CreativeWork]] (e.g. [[NewsArticle]]) the principles are those of the party primarily responsible for the creation of the [[CreativeWork]]. While such policies are most typically expressed in natural language, sometimes related information (e.g. indicating a [[funder]]) can be expressed using schema.org terminology.

label: purchaseDate
definition: The date the item, e.g. vehicle, was purchased by the current owner.

label: purchasePriceLimit
definition: Optional. The maximum price the item can have and still qualify for this offer.

label: purchaseType
definition: Optional. The type of purchase the consumer must make in order to qualify for this incentive.

label: qualifications
definition: Specific qualifications required for this role or Occupation.

label: qualifiedExpense
definition: Optional. The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

label: quarantineGuidelines
definition: Guidelines about quarantine rules, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

label: query
definition: A sub property of instrument. The query used on this action.

label: quest
definition: The task that a player-controlled character, or group of characters may complete in order to gain a reward.

label: question
definition: A sub property of object. A question.

label: rangeIncludes

label: ratingCount

label: ratingExplanation

label: ratingValue
definition:
The rating for the content.

label: readBy

label: readonlyValue
definition: Whether or not a property is mutable. Default is false. Specifying this for a property that also has a value makes it act similar to a "hidden" input in an HTML form.

label: realEstateAgent
definition: A sub property of participant. The real estate agent involved in the action.

label: recipe

definition: The category of the recipe—for example, appetizer, entree, etc.

label: recipeCuisine
definition: The cuisine of the recipe (for example, French or Ethiopian).

label: recipeIngredient
definition: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic. The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.

label: recipeInstructions
definition: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.

label: recipeYield

label: recognizingAuthority

label: recommendationStrength
definition: Strength of the guideline's recommendation (e.g. 'class I').

label: recommendedIntake

label: recordLabel
definition: The label that issued the release.

label: recordedAs

label: recordedAt

label: recordedIn

label: recordingOf

label: recourseLoan
definition: The only way you get the money back in the event of default is the security. Recourse is where you still have the opportunity to go back to the borrower for the rest of the money.

label: recycledContentPercentage
definition: The percentage of recycled material in the product.

label: referee
definition: An official who watches a game or match closely to enforce the rules and arbitrate on matters arising from the play such as referees, umpires or judges. The name of the effective function can vary according to the sport.

label: referenceQuantity
definition: The reference quantity for which a certain price applies, e.g. 1 EUR per 4 kWh of electricity. This property is a replacement for unitOfMeasurement for the advanced cases where the price does not relate to a standard unit.

label: referencesOrder
definition: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.

label: refundType
definition: A refund type, from an enumerated list.

label: regionDrained
definition: The anatomical or organ system drained by this vessel; generally refers to a specific part of an organ.

label: regionsAllowed
definition: The regions where the media is allowed. If not specified, then it's assumed to be allowed everywhere. Specify the countries in [ISO 3166 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166).

label: relatedAnatomy
definition: Anatomical systems or structures that relate to the superficial anatomy.

label: relatedCondition
definition: A medical condition associated with this anatomy.

label: relatedDrug
definition: Any other drug related to this one, for example commonly-prescribed alternatives.

label: relatedLink
definition: A link related to this web page, for example to other related web pages.

label: relatedStructure
definition: Related anatomical structure(s) that are not part of the system but relate or connect to it, such as vascular bundles associated with an organ system.

label: relatedTherapy
definition: A medical therapy related to this anatomy.

label: relatedTo
definition: The most generic familial relation.

label: releaseDate
definition: The release date of a product or product model. This can be used to distinguish the exact variant of a product.

label: releaseNotes
definition: Description of what changed in this version.

label: releaseOf
definition: The album this is a release of.

label: releasedEvent
definition: The place and time the release was issued, expressed as a PublicationEvent.

label: relevantOccupation
definition: The Occupation for the JobPosting.

label: relevantSpecialty
definition: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.

label: remainingAttendeeCapacity
definition: The number of attendee places for an event that remain unallocated.

label: renegotiableLoan
definition: Whether the terms for payment of interest can be renegotiated during the life of the loan.

label: repeatCount
definition: Defines the number of times a recurring [[Event]] will take place.

label: repeatFrequency
definition: Defines the frequency at which [[Event]]s will occur according to a schedule [[Schedule]]. The intervals between events should be defined as a [[Duration]] of time.

label: repetitions
definition: Number of times one should repeat the activity.

label: replacee
definition: A sub property of object. The object that is being replaced.

label: replacer
definition: A sub property of object. The object that replaces.

label: replyToUrl
definition: The URL at which a reply may be posted to the specified UserComment.

label: reportNumber
definition: The number or other unique designator assigned to a Report by the publishing organization.

label: representativeOfPage
definition: Indicates whether this image is representative of the content of the page.

label: requiredCollateral
definition: Assets required to secure loan or credit repayments. It may take form of third party pledge, goods, financial instruments (cash, securities, etc.)

label: requiredGender
definition: Audiences defined by a person's gender.

label: requiredMaxAge
definition: Audiences defined by a person's maximum age.

label: requiredMinAge
definition: Audiences defined by a person's minimum age.

label: requiredQuantity
definition: The required quantity of the item(s).

label: requirements
definition: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).

label: requiresSubscription
definition: Indicates if use of the media require a subscription (either paid or free). Allowed values are ```true``` or ```false``` (note that an earlier version had 'yes', 'no').

label: reservationFor
definition: The thing -- flight, event, restaurant, etc. being reserved.

label: reservationId
definition: A unique identifier for the reservation.

label: reservationStatus
definition: The current status of the reservation.

label: reservedTicket
definition: A ticket associated with the reservation.

label: responsibilities
definition: Responsibilities associated with this role or Occupation.

label: restPeriods
definition: How often one should break from the activity.

label: restockingFee
definition: Use [[MonetaryAmount]] to specify a fixed restocking fee for product returns, or use [[Number]] to specify a percentage of the product price paid by the customer.

label: result
definition: The result produced in the action. E.g. John wrote *a book*.

label: resultComment
definition: A sub property of result. The Comment created or sent as a result of this action.

label: resultReview
definition: A sub property of result. The review that resulted in the performing of the action.

label: returnFees
definition: The type of return fees for purchased products (for any return reason).

label: returnLabelSource
definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned for any reason.

label: returnMethod
definition: The type of return method offered, specified from an enumeration.

label: returnPolicyCategory
definition: Specifies an applicable return policy (from an enumeration).

label: returnPolicyCountry
definition: The country where the product has to be sent to for returns, for example "Ireland" using the [[name]] property of [[Country]]. You can also provide the two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1). Note that this can be different from the country where the product was originally shipped from or sent to.

label: returnPolicySeasonalOverride
definition: Seasonal override of a return policy.

label: returnShippingFeesAmount
definition: Amount of shipping costs for product returns (for any reason). Applicable when property [[returnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

label: roleName

label: roofLoad

The permitted total weight of cargo and installations (e.g. a roof rack) on top of the vehicle.

label: rsvpResponse

label: safetyConsideration

label: salaryCurrency

label: salaryUponCompletion
definition: The expected salary upon completing the training.

label: sameAs
definition: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

label: sampleType
definition: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

label: saturatedFatContent

label: scheduleTimezone

label: scheduledPaymentDate

label: sensoryUnit
definition: The neurological pathway extension that inputs and sends information to the brain or spinal cord.

label: serialNumber

label: slogan

definition: The spatialCoverage of a CreativeWork indicates the place(s) which are the focus of the content. It is a subproperty of contentLocation intended primarily for more technical and detailed materials. label: speakable
definition: Indicates sections of a Web page that are particularly 'speakable' in the sense of being highlighted as being especially appropriate for text-to-speech conversion. Other sections of a page may also be usefully spoken in particular circumstances; the 'speakable' property serves to indicate the parts most likely to be generally useful for speech. The *speakable* property can be repeated an arbitrary number of times, with three kinds of possible 'content-locator' values: 1.) *id-value* URL references - uses *id-value* of an element in the page being annotated. The simplest use of *speakable* has (potentially relative) URL values, referencing identified sections of the document concerned. 2.) CSS Selectors - addresses content in the annotated page, e.g. via class attribute. Use the [[cssSelector]] property. 3.) XPaths - addresses content via XPaths (assuming an XML view of the content). Use the [[xpath]] property. For more sophisticated markup of speakable sections beyond simple ID references, either CSS selectors or XPath expressions to pick out document section(s) as speakable. For this we define a supporting type, [[SpeakableSpecification]] which is defined to be a possible value of the *speakable* property.

The speed range of the vehicle. If the vehicle is powered by an engine, the upper limit of the speed range (indicated by [[maxValue]]) should be the maximum speed achievable under regular conditions.

label: steeringPosition

definition: The stepValue attribute indicates the granularity that is expected (and required) of the value in a PropertyValueSpecification.

definition: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection (originally misnamed 'steps'; 'step' is preferred).

label: storageRequirements
definition: Storage requirements (free space required).
