definition: The age or age range for the intended audience or person, for example 3-12 months for infants, 1-5 years for toddlers.

label: suggestedAnswer
definition: An answer (possibly one of several, possibly incorrect) to a Question, e.g. on a Question/Answer site.

label: suggestedGender
definition: The suggested gender of the intended person or audience, for example "male", "female", or "unisex".

label: suggestedMaxAge
definition: Maximum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

label: suggestedMeasurement
definition: A suggested range of body measurements for the intended audience or person, for example inseam between 32 and 34 inches or height between 170 and 190 cm. Typically found on a size chart for wearable products.

label: suggestedMinAge
definition: Minimum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

label: suitableForDiet
definition: Indicates a dietary restriction or guideline for which this recipe or menu item is suitable, e.g. diabetic, halal etc.

label: superEvent
definition: An event that this event is a part of. For example, a collection of individual music performances might each have a music festival as their superEvent.

label: supersededBy
definition: Relates a term (i.e. a property, class or enumeration) to one that supersedes it.

label: supply
definition: A sub-property of instrument. A supply consumed when performing instructions or a direction.

label: supplyTo
definition: The area to which the artery supplies blood.

label: supportingData
definition: Supporting data for a SoftwareApplication.

label: surface
definition: A material used as a surface in some artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

label: syllabusSections
definition: Indicates (typically several) Syllabus entities that lay out what each section of the overall course will cover.

label: target
definition: Indicates a target EntryPoint, or url, for an Action.

label: targetCollection
definition: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

label: targetDescription
definition: The description of a node in an established educational framework.

label: targetName
definition: The name of a node in an established educational framework.

label: targetPlatform
definition: Type of app development: phone, Metro style, desktop, XBox, etc.

label: targetPopulation
definition: Characteristics of the population for which this is intended, or which typically uses it, e.g. 'adults'.

label: targetProduct
definition: Target Operating System / Product to which the code applies. If applies to several versions, just the product name can be used.

label: targetUrl
definition: The URL of a node in an established educational framework.

label: taxID
definition: The Tax / Fiscal ID of the organization or person, e.g. the TIN in the US or the CIF/NIF in Spain.

label: taxonRank
definition: The taxonomic rank of this taxon given preferably as a URI from a controlled vocabulary – typically the ranks from TDWG TaxonRank ontology or equivalent Wikidata URIs.

label: taxonomicRange
definition: The taxonomic grouping of the organism that expresses, encodes, or in some way related to the BioChemEntity.

label: teaches
definition: The item being described is intended to help a person learn the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

label: telephone
definition: The telephone number.

label: temporal
definition: The "temporal" property can be used in cases where more specific properties (e.g. [[temporalCoverage]], [[dateCreated]], [[dateModified]], [[datePublished]]) are not known to be appropriate.

label: temporalCoverage
definition: The temporalCoverage of a CreativeWork indicates the period that the content applies to, i.e. that it describes, either as a DateTime or as a textual string indicating a time period in [ISO 8601 time interval format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Time_intervals). In the case of a Dataset it will typically indicate the relevant time period in a precise notation (e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 would be written "2011/2012"). Other forms of content, e.g. ScholarlyArticle, Book, TVSeries or TVEpisode, may indicate their temporalCoverage in broader terms - textually or via well-known URL. Written works such as books may sometimes have precise temporal coverage too, e.g. a work set in 1939 - 1945 can be indicated in ISO 8601 interval format format via "1939/1945". Open-ended date ranges can be written with ".." in place of the end date. For example, "2015-11/.." indicates a range beginning in November 2015 and with no specified final date. This is tentative and might be updated in future when ISO 8601 is officially updated.

label: termCode
definition: A code that identifies this [[DefinedTerm]] within a [[DefinedTermSet]].

label: termDuration
definition: The amount of time in a term as defined by the institution. A term is a length of time where students take one or more classes. Semesters and quarters are common units for term.

label: termsOfService
definition: Human-readable terms of service documentation.

label: termsPerYear
definition: The number of times terms of study are offered per year. Semesters and quarters are common units for term. For example, if the student can only take 2 semesters for the program in one year, then termsPerYear should be 2.

label: text
definition: The textual content of this CreativeWork.

label: textValue
definition: Text value being annotated.

label: thumbnail
definition: Thumbnail image for an image or video.

label: thumbnailUrl
definition: A thumbnail image relevant to the Thing.

label: tickerSymbol
definition: The exchange traded instrument associated with a Corporation object. The tickerSymbol is expressed as an exchange and an instrument name separated by a space character. For the exchange component of the tickerSymbol attribute, we recommend using the controlled vocabulary of Market Identifier Codes (MIC) specified in ISO 15022.

label: ticketNumber
definition: The unique identifier for the ticket.

label: ticketToken
definition: Reference to an asset (e.g., Barcode, QR code image or PDF) usable for entrance.

label: ticketedSeat
definition: The seat associated with the ticket.

label: timeOfDay
definition: The time of day the program normally runs. For example, "evenings".

label: timeRequired
definition: Approximate or typical time it usually takes to work with or through the content of this work for the typical or target audience.

label: timeToComplete
definition: The expected length of time to complete the program if attending full-time.

label: timestamp
definition: The instant the event occured.

label: tissueSample
definition: The type of tissue sample required for the test.

label: title
definition: The title of the job.

label: titleEIDR
definition: An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing at the most general/abstract level, a work of film or television. For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" has a titleEIDR of "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J". This title (or work) may have several variants, which EIDR calls "edits". See [[editEIDR]]. Since schema.org types like [[Movie]], [[TVEpisode]], [[TVSeason]], and [[TVSeries]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

label: toLocation
definition: A sub property of location. The final location of the object or the agent after the action.

label: toRecipient
definition: A sub property of recipient. The recipient who was directly sent the message.

label: tocContinuation
definition: A [[HyperTocEntry]] can have a [[tocContinuation]] indicated, which is another [[HyperTocEntry]] that would be the default next item to play or render.

label: tocEntry
definition: Indicates a [[HyperTocEntry]] in a [[HyperToc]].

label: tongueWeight
definition:
The permitted vertical load (TWR) of a trailer attached to the vehicle. Also referred to as Tongue Load Rating (TLR) or Vertical Load Rating (VLR).

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: tool
definition: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.

label: torque
definition:
The torque (turning force) of the vehicle's engine.

Typical unit code(s): NU for newton metre (N m), F17 for pound-force per foot, or F48 for pound-force per inch

* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined (e.g. reference RPM) using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: totalHistoricalEnrollment
definition: The total number of students that have enrolled in the history of the course.

label: totalJobOpenings
definition: The number of positions open for this job posting. Use a positive integer. Do not use if the number of positions is unclear or not known.

label: totalPaymentDue
definition: The total amount due.

label: totalPrice
definition:
The total price for the reservation or ticket, including applicable taxes, shipping, etc.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

label: totalTime
definition: The total time required to perform instructions or a direction (including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

label: tourBookingPage
definition: A page providing information on how to book a tour of some [[Place]], such as an [[Accommodation]] or [[ApartmentComplex]] in a real estate setting, as well as other kinds of tours as appropriate.

label: touristType
definition: Attraction suitable for type(s) of tourist. E.g. children, visitors from a particular country, etc.

label: track
definition: A music recording (track)—usually a single song. If an ItemList is given, the list should contain items of type MusicRecording.

label: trackingNumber
definition: Shipper tracking number.

label: trackingUrl
definition: Tracking url for the parcel delivery.

label: tracks
definition: A music recording (track)—usually a single song.

label: trailer
definition: The trailer of a movie or TV/radio series, season, episode, etc.
domain: schema:CreativeWorkSeason; schema:Episode; schema:Movie; schema:MovieSeries; schema:RadioSeries; schema:TVSeries; schema:VideoGame; schema:VideoGameSeries

label: trailerWeight
definition:
The permitted weight of a trailer attached to the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound
* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: trainName
definition: The name of the train (e.g. The Orient Express).

label: trainNumber
definition: The unique identifier for the train.

label: trainingSalary
definition: The estimated salary earned while in the program.

label: transFatContent
definition: The number of grams of trans fat.

label: transcript
definition: If this MediaObject is an AudioObject or VideoObject, the transcript of that object.

label: transitTime
definition: The typical delay the order has been sent for delivery and the goods reach the final customer. In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], use the [[QuantitativeValue]]. Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY). In the context of [[ShippingConditions]], use the [[ServicePeriod]]. It has a duration (as a [[QuantitativeValue]]) and also business days and a cut-off time.

label: transitTimeLabel
definition: Label to match an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with a [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] (within the context of a [[shippingSettingsLink]] cross-reference).

label: translationOfWork
definition: The work that this work has been translated from. E.g. 物种起源 is a translationOf “On the Origin of Species”.

label: translator
definition: Organization or person who adapts a creative work to different languages, regional differences and technical requirements of a target market, or that translates during some event.

label: transmissionMethod
definition: How the disease spreads, either as a route or vector, for example 'direct contact', 'Aedes aegypti', etc.

label: travelBans
definition: Information about travel bans, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

label: trialDesign
definition: Specifics about the trial design (enumerated).

label: tributary
definition: The anatomical or organ system that the vein flows into; a larger structure that the vein connects to.

label: tripOrigin
definition: The location of origin of the trip, prior to any destination(s).

label: typeOfBed
definition: The type of bed to which the BedDetail refers, i.e. the type of bed available in the quantity indicated by quantity.

label: typeOfGood
definition: The product that this structured value is referring to.

label: typicalAgeRange
definition: The typical expected age range, e.g. '7-9', '11-'.

label: typicalCreditsPerTerm
definition: The number of credits or units a full-time student would be expected to take in 1 term however 'term' is defined by the institution.

label: typicalTest
definition: A medical test typically performed given this condition.

label: underName
definition: The person or organization the reservation or ticket is for.

label: unitCode
definition: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code (3 characters) or a URL. Other codes than the UN/CEFACT Common Code may be used with a prefix followed by a colon.

label: unitText
definition: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement. Useful if you cannot provide a standard unit code for unitCode.

label: unnamedSourcesPolicy
definition: For an [[Organization]] (typically a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement about policy on use of unnamed sources and the decision process required.

label: unsaturatedFatContent
definition: The number of grams of unsaturated fat.

label: uploadDate
definition: Date (including time if available) when this media object was uploaded to this site.

label: upvoteCount
definition: The number of upvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

label: url
definition: URL of the item.

label: urlTemplate
definition: An url template (RFC6570) that will be used to construct the target of the execution of the action.

label: usNPI
definition: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a unique 10-digit identification number issued to health care providers in the United States by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

label: usageInfo
definition: The schema.org [[usageInfo]] property indicates further information about a [[CreativeWork]]. This property is applicable both to works that are freely available and to those that require payment or other transactions. It can reference additional information, e.g. community expectations on preferred linking and citation conventions, as well as purchasing details. For something that can be commercially licensed, usageInfo can provide detailed, resource-specific information about licensing options. This property can be used alongside the license property which indicates license(s) applicable to some piece of content. The usageInfo property can provide information about other licensing options, e.g. acquiring commercial usage rights for an image that is also available under non-commercial creative commons licenses.

label: usedToDiagnose
definition: A condition the test is used to diagnose.

label: userInteractionCount
definition: The number of interactions for the CreativeWork using the WebSite or SoftwareApplication.

label: usesDevice
definition: Device used to perform the test.

label: usesHealthPlanIdStandard
definition: The standard for interpreting the Plan ID. The preferred is "HIOS". See the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services for more details.

label: utterances
definition: Text of an utterances (spoken words, lyrics etc.) that occurs at a certain section of a media object, represented as a [[HyperTocEntry]].

label: validFor
definition: The duration of validity of a permit or similar thing.

label: validForMemberTier
definition: The membership program tier(s) an Offer (or a PriceSpecification, OfferShippingDetails, or MerchantReturnPolicy under an Offer) is valid for.

label: validFrom
definition: The date when the item becomes valid.
domain: schema:Certification; schema:Demand; schema:FinancialIncentive; schema:LocationFeatureSpecification; schema:MonetaryAmount; schema:Offer; schema:OpeningHoursSpecification; schema:Permit; schema:PriceSpecification

label: validIn
definition: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].

label: validThrough
definition: The date after when the item is not valid. For example the end of an offer, salary period, or a period of opening hours.
domain: schema:Demand; schema:FinancialIncentive; schema:JobPosting; schema:LocationFeatureSpecification; schema:MonetaryAmount; schema:Offer; schema:OpeningHoursSpecification; schema:PriceSpecification

label: validUntil
definition: The date when the item is no longer valid.

label: value
definition:
The value of a [[QuantitativeValue]] (including [[Observation]]) or property value node.

* For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.
* For [[PropertyValue]], it can be 'Text', 'Number', 'Boolean', 'StructuredValue' or 'QualitativeValue'.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

label: valueAddedTaxIncluded
definition: Specifies whether the applicable value-added tax (VAT) is included in the price specification or not.

label: valueGroup
definition: A header or section name for grouping related property values.

label: valueMaxLength
definition: Specifies the allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

label: valueMinLength
definition: Specifies the minimum allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

label: valueName
definition: Indicates the name of the PropertyValueSpecification to be used in URL templates and form encoding in a manner analogous to HTML's input@name.

label: valuePattern
definition: Specifies a regular expression for testing literal values according to the HTML spec.

label: valueReference
definition: A secondary value that provides additional information on the original value, e.g. a reference temperature or a type of measurement.
range: schema:DefinedTerm; schema:Enumeration; schema:MeasurementTypeEnumeration; schema:PropertyValue; schema:QualitativeValue; schema:QuantitativeValue; schema:StructuredValue; schema:Text

label: valueRequired
definition: Whether the property must be filled in to complete the action. Default is false.

label: variableMeasured
definition: The variableMeasured property can indicate (repeated as necessary) the variables that are measured in some dataset, either described as text or as pairs of identifier and description using PropertyValue, or more explicitly as a [[StatisticalVariable]].

label: variantCover
definition: A description of the variant cover for the issue, if the issue is a variant printing. For example, "Bryan Hitch Variant Cover" or "2nd Printing Variant".

label: variesBy
definition: Indicates the property or properties by which the variants in a [[ProductGroup]] vary, e.g. their size, color etc. Schema.org properties can be referenced by their short name e.g. "color"; terms defined elsewhere can be referenced with their URIs. Variant properties can be provided using [[PropertyValue]] instead of plain [[Text]], to allow specification of the values available for a variant property.

label: vatID
definition: The value-added Tax ID of the organization or person with national prefix (for example IT123456789). Can also be described as [[iso6523Code]] with proper prefix.

label: vehicleConfiguration
definition: A short text indicating the configuration of the vehicle, e.g. '5dr hatchback ST 2.5 MT 225 hp' or 'limited edition'.

label: vehicleEngine
definition: Information about the engine or engines of the vehicle.

label: vehicleIdentificationNumber
definition: The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is a unique serial number used by the automotive industry to identify individual motor vehicles.

label: vehicleInteriorColor
definition: The color or color combination of the interior of the vehicle.

label: vehicleInteriorType
definition: The type or material of the interior of the vehicle (e.g. synthetic fabric, leather, wood, etc.). While most interior types are characterized by the material used, an interior type can also be based on vehicle usage or target audience.

label: vehicleModelDate
definition: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

label: vehicleSeatingCapacity
definition: The number of passengers that can be seated in the vehicle, both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

label: vehicleSpecialUsage
definition: Indicates whether the vehicle has been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi. The legislation in many countries requires this information to be revealed when offering a car for sale.

label: vehicleTransmission
definition: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or other relevant component(s) ("gearbox" for cars).

label: vendor
definition: 'vendor' is an earlier term for 'seller'.

label: verificationFactCheckingPolicy
definition: Disclosure about verification and fact-checking processes for a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other fact-checking [[Organization]].

label: version
definition: The version of the CreativeWork embodied by a specified resource.

label: video
definition: An embedded video object.

label: videoFormat
definition: The type of screening or video broadcast used (e.g. IMAX, 3D, SD, HD, etc.).

label: videoFrameSize
definition: The frame size of the video.

label: videoQuality
definition: The quality of the video.

label: volumeNumber
definition: Identifies the volume of publication or multi-part work; for example, "iii" or "2".

label: warning
definition: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug (text or URL).

label: warranty
definition: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

label: warrantyPromise
definition: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

label: warrantyScope
definition: The scope of the warranty promise.

label: webCheckinTime
definition: The time when a passenger can check into the flight online.

label: webFeed
definition: The URL for a feed, e.g. associated with a podcast series, blog, or series of date-stamped updates. This is usually RSS or Atom.

label: weight
definition: The weight of the product or person.

label: weightPercentage
definition: Value representing the fraction of the weight that is used to compute the shipping price. Example: 0.10 and a shipping weight of 15kg would add $1.5 to the order price, where the $ is the currency of the order.

label: weightTotal
definition:
The permitted total weight of the loaded vehicle, including passengers and cargo and the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

label: wheelbase
definition: The distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels.\n\nTypical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet.

label: width
definition: The width of the item.

label: winner
definition: A sub property of participant. The winner of the action.

label: wordCount
definition: The number of words in the text of the CreativeWork such as an Article, Book, etc.

label: workExample
definition: Example/instance/realization/derivation of the concept of this creative work. E.g. the paperback edition, first edition, or e-book.

label: workFeatured
definition: A work featured in some event, e.g. exhibited in an ExhibitionEvent. Specific subproperties are available for workPerformed (e.g. a play), or a workPresented (a Movie at a ScreeningEvent).

label: workHours
definition: The typical working hours for this job (e.g. 1st shift, night shift, 8am-5pm).

label: workLocation
definition: A contact location for a person's place of work.

label: workPerformed
definition: A work performed in some event, for example a play performed in a TheaterEvent.

label: workPresented
definition: The movie presented during this event.

label: workTranslation
definition: A work that is a translation of the content of this work. E.g. 西遊記 has an English workTranslation “Journey to the West”, a German workTranslation “Monkeys Pilgerfahrt” and a Vietnamese translation Tây du ký bình khảo.

label: workload
definition: Quantitative measure of the physiologic output of the exercise; also referred to as energy expenditure.

label: worksFor
definition: Organizations that the person works for.

label: worstRating
definition: The lowest value allowed in this rating system.

label: xpath
definition: An XPath, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

label: yearBuilt
definition: The year an [[Accommodation]] was constructed. This corresponds to the [YearBuilt field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/YearBuilt+Field).

label: yearlyRevenue
definition: The size of the business in annual revenue.

label: yearsInOperation
definition: The age of the business.

label: yield
definition: The quantity that results by performing instructions. For example, a paper airplane, 10 personalized candles.

label: Date-Time description
definition: Description of date and time structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system. The temporal reference system is fixed to Gregorian Calendar, and the range of year, month, day properties restricted to corresponding XML Schema types xsd:gYear, xsd:gMonth and xsd:gDay, respectively.

label: Date-time interval
definition: DateTimeInterval is a subclass of ProperInterval, defined using the multi-element DateTimeDescription.

label: Day of week
definition: The day of week

label: Time duration
definition: Duration of a temporal extent expressed as a number scaled by a temporal unit

label: Duration description
definition: Description of temporal extent structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system. The temporal reference system is fixed to Gregorian Calendar, and the range of each of the numeric properties is restricted to xsd:decimal

label: Generalized date-time description
definition: Description of date and time structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system

label: Generalized duration description
definition: Description of temporal extent structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system.

label: Time instant
definition: A temporal entity with zero extent or duration

label: Time interval
definition: A temporal entity with an extent or duration

label: Month of year
definition: The month of the year

label: Proper interval
definition: A temporal entity with non-zero extent or duration, i.e. for which the value of the beginning and end are different

label: Temporal Reference System
definition: A temporal reference system, such as a temporal coordinate system (with an origin, direction, and scale), a calendar-clock combination, or a (possibly hierarchical) ordinal system. This is a stub class, representing the set of all temporal reference systems.

label: Temporal duration
definition: Time extent; duration of a time interval separate from its particular start position

label: Temporal entity
definition: A temporal interval or instant.

label: Temporal position
definition: A position on a time-line

label: Temporal unit
definition: A standard duration, which provides a scale factor for a time extent, or the granularity or precision for a time position.

label: Time position
definition: A temporal position described using either a (nominal) value from an ordinal reference system, or a (numeric) value in a temporal coordinate system.

label: Time Zone
definition: A Time Zone specifies the amount by which the local time is offset from UTC. A time zone is usually denoted geographically (e.g. Australian Eastern Daylight Time), with a constant value in a given region. The region where it applies and the offset from UTC are specified by a locally recognised governing authority.

label: Year
definition: Year duration

label: after
definition: Gives directionality to time. If a temporal entity T1 is after another temporal entity T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2.

label: before
definition: Gives directionality to time. If a temporal entity T1 is before another temporal entity T2, then the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2. Thus, "before" can be considered to be basic to instants and derived for intervals.

label: day
definition: Day position in a calendar-clock system. The range of this property is not specified, so can be replaced by any specific representation of a calendar day from any calendar.

label: day of week
definition: The day of week, whose value is a member of the class time:DayOfWeek

label: day of year
definition: The number of the day within the year

label: days duration
definition: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in days

label: Generalized day
definition: Day of month - formulated as a text string with a pattern constraint to reproduce the same lexical form as gDay, except that values up to 99 are permitted, in order to support calendars with more than 31 days in a month. Note that the value-space is not defined, so a generic OWL2 processor cannot compute ordering relationships of values of this type.

label: Generalized month
definition: Month of year - formulated as a text string with a pattern constraint to reproduce the same lexical form as gMonth, except that values up to 20 are permitted, in order to support calendars with more than 12 months in the year. Note that the value-space is not defined, so a generic OWL2 processor cannot compute ordering relationships of values of this type.

label: Generalized year
definition: Year number - formulated as a text string with a pattern constraint to reproduce the same lexical form as gYear, but not restricted to values from the Gregorian calendar. Note that the value-space is not defined, so a generic OWL2 processor cannot compute ordering relationships of values of this type.

label: has beginning
definition: Beginning of a temporal entity.

label: has Date-Time description
definition: Value of DateTimeInterval expressed as a structured value. The beginning and end of the interval coincide with the limits of the shortest element in the description.

label: has duration
definition: Duration of a temporal entity, event or activity, or thing, expressed as a scaled value

label: has duration description
definition: Duration of a temporal entity, expressed using a structured description

label: has end
definition: End of a temporal entity.

label: Temporal reference system used
definition: The temporal reference system used by a temporal position or extent description.

label: has temporal duration
definition: Duration of a temporal entity.

label: has time
definition: Supports the association of a temporal entity (instant or interval) to any thing

label: has XSD duration
definition: Extent of a temporal entity, expressed using xsd:duration

label: hour
definition: Hour position in a calendar-clock system.

label: hours duration
definition: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in hours

label: in date-time description
definition: Position of an instant, expressed using a structured description

label: Temporal position
definition: Position of a time instant

label: interval after
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalAfter another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2.

label: interval before
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalBefore another proper interval T2, then the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2.

label: interval contains
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalContains another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

label: interval disjoint
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalDisjoint another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2, or the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2, i.e. the intervals do not overlap in any way, but their ordering relationship is not known.

label: interval during
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalDuring another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

label: interval equals
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalEquals another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

label: interval finished by
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalFinishedBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

label: interval finishes
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalFinishes another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

label: interval in
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalIn another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2 or is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2, or is coincident with the end of T2, except that end of T1 may not be coincident with the end of T2 if the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2.

label: interval meets
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalMeets another proper interval T2, then the end of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2.

label: interval met by
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalMetBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

label: interval overlapped by
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalOverlappedBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, the beginning of T1 is before the end of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

label: interval overlaps
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalOverlaps another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, the end of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

label: interval started by
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalStarted another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

label: interval starts
definition: If a proper interval T1 is intervalStarts another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

label: mapping registry
definition: A registry for managing mapping sets. It holds a set of mapping set references, and can import other registries.

label: mapping set reference
definition: A reference to a mapping set. It allows to augment mapping set metadata from the perspective of the registry, for example, providing confidence, or a local filename or a grouping.

label: extension definition
definition: A definition of an extension (non-standard) slot.

label: Propagatable
definition: Metamodel extension class to describe slots whose value can be propagated down from the MappingSet class to the Mapping class.

label: Versionable
definition: Metamodel extension class to manage slots that may not exist in all versions of the model.

label: NoTermFound
definition: sssom:NoTermFound can be used in place of a subject_id or object_id when the corresponding entity could not be found. It SHOULD be used in conjunction with a corresponding subject_source or object_source to signify where the term was not found.

label: curie_map

label: mirror_from

label: registry_confidence
definition: This value is set by the creator/maintainer of the mapping registry and reflects the confidence the mapping registry has in the correctness (i.e., precision) of mappings in the mapping set. When not explicitly specified, confidence estimation algorithms should consider the registry confidence in a mapping set to be 1.0 by default.

label: last_updated
definition: The date this reference was last updated.

label: local_name
definition: The local name assigned to file that corresponds to the downloaded mapping set.

label: mapping_set_references
definition: A list of mapping set references.

label: mapping_registry_id
definition: The unique identifier of a mapping registry.

label: mapping_registry_title
definition: The title of a mapping registry.

label: mapping_registry_description
definition: The description of a mapping registry.

label: imports
definition: A list of registries that should be imported into this one.

label: documentation
definition: A URL to the documentation of this mapping commons.

label: homepage
definition: A URL to a homepage of this mapping commons.

label: mappings
definition: Contains a list of mapping objects.

label: subject_id
definition: The ID of the subject of the mapping.

label: subject_label
definition: The label of subject of the mapping.

label: subject_category
definition: The conceptual category to which the subject belongs to. This can be a string denoting the category or a term from a controlled vocabulary. This slot is deliberately underspecified. Conceptual categories can range from those that are found in general upper ontologies such as BFO (e.g. process, temporal region, etc) to those that serve as upper ontologies in specific domains, such as COB or BioLink (e.g. gene, disease, chemical entity). The purpose of this optional field is documentation for human reviewers - when a category is known and documented clearly, the cost of interpreting and evaluating the mapping decreases.

label: subject_type
definition: The type of entity that is being mapped.

label: predicate_id
definition: The ID of the predicate or relation that relates the subject and object of this match.

label: predicate_modifier
definition: A modifier for negating the predicate. See https://github.com/mapping-commons/sssom/issues/40 for discussion

label: predicate_label
definition: The label of the predicate/relation of the mapping.

label: predicate_type
definition: The type of the predicate used to map the subject and object entities.

label: object_id
definition: The ID of the object of the mapping.

label: object_label
definition: The label of object of the mapping.

label: object_category
definition: The conceptual category to which the object belongs to. This can be a string denoting the category or a term from a controlled vocabulary. This slot is deliberately underspecified. Conceptual categories can range from those that are found in general upper ontologies such as BFO (e.g. process, temporal region, etc) to those that serve as upper ontologies in specific domains, such as COB or BioLink (e.g. gene, disease, chemical entity). The purpose of this optional field is documentation for human reviewers - when a category is known and documented clearly, the cost of interpreting and evaluating the mapping decreases.

label: mapping_justification
definition: A mapping justification is an action (or the written representation of that action) of showing a mapping to be right or reasonable.

label: object_type
definition: The type of entity that is being mapped.

label: mapping_set_id
definition: A globally unique identifier for the mapping set (not each individual mapping). Should ideally be resolvable.

label: mapping_set_version
definition: A version string for the mapping.

label: mapping_set_group
definition: Set by the owners of the mapping registry. A way to group related mapping sets for example for UI purposes.

label: mapping_set_title
definition: The display name of a mapping set.

label: mapping_set_description
definition: A description of the mapping set.

label: mapping_set_confidence
definition: Mapping-set level confidence is assigned by the creator of the mapping set to indicate their overall confidence in the correctness (i.e., precision) of mappings in the mapping set. Mapping set confidence is intended to be used in cases were the creator wants to express an overall confidence into the agent that curated the individual mappings, for example a lexical matching tool, or a group of students. When not explicitly specified, confidence estimation algorithms should consider the mapping set confidence to be 1.0 by default.

label: creator_id
definition: Identifies the persons or groups responsible for the creation of the mapping. The creator is the agent that put the mapping in its published form, which may be different from the author, which is a person that was actively involved in the assertion of the mapping. Recommended to be a list of ORCIDs or otherwise identifying URIs.

label: creator_label
definition: A string representing the creator of this mapping. This should only be used in the absence of a proper semantic identifier (which would be stored in creator_id) for that creator. It is not expected that there should be any link between creator_id and creator_label; in particular, creator_label is not intended to provide a human-friendly version of an identifier in creator_id.

label: author_id
definition: Identifies the persons or groups responsible for asserting the mappings. Recommended to be a list of ORCIDs or otherwise identifying URIs.

label: author_label
definition: A string representing the author of this mapping. This should only be used in the absence of a proper semantic identifier (which would be stored in author_id) for that author. It is not expected that there should be any link between author_id and author_label; in particular, author_label is not intended to provide a human-friendly version of an identifier in author_id.

label: reviewer_id
definition: Identifies the persons or groups that reviewed and confirmed the mapping. Recommended to be a list of ORCIDs or otherwise identifying URIs.

label: reviewer_label
definition: A string representing the reviewer of this mapping. This should only be used in the absence of a proper semantic identifier (which would be stored in reviewer_id) for that reviewer. It is not expected that there should be any link between reviewer_id and reviewer_label; in particular, reviewer_label is not intended to provide a human-friendly version of an identifier in reviewer_id.

label: license
definition: A url to the license of the mapping. In absence of a license we assume no license.

label: subject_source
definition: URI of vocabulary or identifier source for the subject.

label: subject_source_version
definition: Version IRI or version string of the source of the subject term.

label: object_source
definition: URI of vocabulary or identifier source for the object.

label: object_source_version
definition: Version IRI or version string of the source of the object term.

label: mapping_provider
definition: URL pointing to the source that provided the mapping, for example an ontology that already contains the mappings, or a database from which it was derived.

label: mapping_set_source
definition: A mapping set or set of mapping set that was used to derive the mapping set.

label: mapping_source
definition: The mapping set this mapping was originally defined in. mapping_source is used for example when merging multiple mapping sets or deriving one mapping set from another.

label: mapping_cardinality
definition: A value indicating whether the subject (respectively object) of this mapping record is present in other records involving a different object (respectively subject), within the subset of records defined by the cardinality_scope slot (or within the entire mapping set if cardinality_scope is undefined). Note that this is a convenience field, whose values can always be derived from the mapping set.

label: cardinality_scope
definition: A list of mapping slots that define the scope for the value found in the mapping_cardinality slot. Mappings are considered to belong to the same scope if they have the same value for all slots listed in the scope. If no scope is defined, the default scope is empty, meaning that all mappings belong to a single scope that is identical to the entire mapping set. The behaviour if a value in the list does not correspond to a valid slot name is undefined.

label: mapping_tool
definition: A reference to the tool or algorithm that was used to generate the mapping. Should be a URL pointing to more info about it, but can be free text. Consider using the mapping_tool_id slot for a more standardised reference.

label: mapping_tool_id
definition: The ID (entity reference) of the tool or algorithm that was used to generate the mapping.

label: mapping_tool_version
definition: Version string that denotes the version of the mapping tool used.

label: mapping_date
definition: The date the mapping was asserted. This is different from the date the mapping was published or compiled in a SSSOM file.

label: publication_date
definition: The date the mapping was published. This is different from the date the mapping was asserted.

label: review_date
definition: The date the mapping was reviewed. This is different from the date the mapping was asserted and published. If this field is used in a mapping, reviewer_id and/or reviewer_label MUST also be be set.

label: confidence
definition: A value assigned by the creator of the mapping to denote the creator's confidence or estimated probability that the mapping record is correct. A value of 1.0 means the creator has full confidence in the correctness of the mapping record, while a value of 0.0 means the creator is fully unsure whether the mapping record is correct or not. When not explicitly specified, confidence estimation algorithms should consider the mapping confidence to be 1.0 by default.

label: reviewer_agreement
definition: A value assigned by the reviewer of the mapping to denote their confidence that the mapping record is correct. A value of 1.0 means the reviewer fully agrees with the mapping record. A value of -1.0 means the reviewer fully disagrees with the mapping record. A value of 0.0 means the reviewer is not sure whether the mapping record is correct or not. When not explicitly specified, confidence estimation algorithms should consider the reviewer agreement to be 1.0 by default.

label: subject_match_field
definition: A list of properties, annotations or attributes related to the subject that was used to establish the match. This property is recommended for use in conjunction with mapping justifications related to lexical matching, such as `semapv:LexicalMatching`. For additional information see the 'See Also' section.

label: object_match_field
definition: A list of properties, annotations or attributes related to the object that was used to establish the match. This property is recommended for use in conjunction with mapping justifications related to lexical matching, such as `semapv:LexicalMatching`. For additional information see the 'See Also' section.

label: match_string
definition: String that is shared by subj/obj. It is recommended to indicate the fields for the match using the object and subject_match_field slots.

label: subject_preprocessing
definition: Method of preprocessing applied to the fields of the subject. If different preprocessing steps were performed on different fields, it is recommended to store the match in separate rows.

label: object_preprocessing
definition: Method of preprocessing applied to the fields of the object. If different preprocessing steps were performed on different fields, it is recommended to store the match in separate rows.

label: curation_rule
definition: A curation rule is a (potentially) complex condition executed by an agent that led to the establishment of a mapping. Curation rules often involve complex domain-specific considerations, which are hard to capture in an automated fashion. The curation rule is captured as a resource rather than a string, which enables higher levels of transparency and sharing across mapping sets. The URI representation of the curation rule is expected to be a resolvable identifier which provides details about the nature of the curation rule.

label: curation_rule_text
definition: A curation rule is a (potentially) complex condition executed by an agent that led to the establishment of a mapping. Curation rules often involve complex domain-specific considerations, which are hard to capture in an automated fashion. The curation rule should be captured as a resource (entity reference) rather than a string (see curation_rule element), which enables higher levels of transparency and sharing across mapping sets. The textual representation of curation rule is intended to be used in cases where the creation of a resource is not practical from the perspective of the mapping_provider.

label: similarity_score
definition: A score between 0 and 1 to denote the similarity between two entities, where 1 denotes equivalence, and 0 denotes disjointness. The score is meant to be used in conjunction with the similarity_measure field, to document, for example, the lexical or semantic match of a matching algorithm.

label: similarity_measure
definition: The measure used for computing a similarity score. This field is meant to be used in conjunction with the similarity_score field, to document, for example, the lexical or semantic match of a matching algorithm. To make processing this field as unambiguous as possible, we recommend using wikidata CURIEs, but the type of this field is deliberately unspecified.

label: issue_tracker_item
definition: The issue tracker item discussing this mapping.

label: issue_tracker
definition: A URL location of the issue tracker for this entity.

label: see_also
definition: A URL specific for the mapping instance. E.g. for kboom we have a per-mapping image that shows surrounding axioms that drive probability. Could also be a github issue URL that discussed a complicated alignment

label: other
definition: Pipe separated list of key value pairs for properties not part of the SSSOM spec. Can be used to encode additional provenance data. NOTE. This field is not recommended for general use, and should be used sparingly. See https://github.com/mapping-commons/sssom/blob/master/examples/schema/extension-slots.sssom.tsv for an alternative approach based on extension slots.

label: comment
definition: Free text field containing either curator notes or text generated by tool providing additional informative information.

label: extension_definitions
definition: A list that defines the extension slots used in the mapping set.

label: record_id
definition: A unique identifier for a mapping record, that is for an instance of the Mapping class (in the SSSOM/TSV serialisation, this corresponds to an individual row after propagation is applied). This slot is intended to uniquely identify one such record within a mapping set and may for example act as the resource identifier for the record when it is serialised into RDF. This slot MUST NOT be used to “group” several records together to indicate that they pertain to a single mapping (for example, that they represent different versions of the same mapping), by assigning the same ID to several records. When it is used, every record within a set MUST have a unique, non-empty value. The identifier MUST be a URI; beyond that, its format is unconstrained and the identifier MUST be treated as an opaque string.

definition: SSSOM specification version 1.0

definition: SSSOM specification version 1.1

label: rdfs literal (entity_type_enum)
definition: This value indicates that the entity being mapped is not a semantic entity with a distinct identifier, but is instead represented entirely by its literal label. This value MUST NOT be used in the predicate_type slot.

label: composed entity expression (entity_type_enum)
definition: This value indicates that the entity ID does not represent a single entity, but a composite involving several individual entities. This value MUST NOT be used in the predicate_type slot. This specifications does not prescribe how an ID representing a composite entity should be interpreted; this is left at the discretion of applications.

label: Not (predicate_modifier_enum)
definition: Negating the mapping predicate. The meaning of the triple becomes subject_id is not a predicate_id match to object_id.

label: 1:1 (mapping_cardinality_enum)
definition: Indicates the mapping record is about a one-to-one mapping, that is, the subject and the object are only mapped to each other, exclusive of any other subject or object.

label: 1:n (mapping_cardinality_enum)
definition: Indicates the mapping record is about a one-to-many mapping, that is, the same subject is mapped to several different objects.

label: n:1 (mapping_cardinality_enum)
definition: Indicates the mapping record is about a many-to-one mapping, that is, several different subjects are mapped to the same object.

label: n:n (mapping_cardinality_enum)
definition: Indicates the mapping record is about a many-to-many mapping, that is, the subject is mapped to several different objects and the object is mapped to several different subjects.

label: 1:0 (mapping_cardinality_enum)
definition: Indicates that the subject has no match in the object vocabulary. This value MUST only be used when the object_id is sssom:NoTermFound.

label: 0:1 (mapping_cardinality_enum)
definition: Indicates that the object has no match in the subject vocabulary. This value MUST only be used when the subject_id is sssom:NoTermFound.

label: 0:0 (mapping_cardinality_enum)
definition: Indicates that there is no match between the subject vocabulary and the object vocabulary. This value MUST only be used when both the subject_id and the object_id are sssom:NoTermFound.

label: categorization scheme
definition: loosely formed grouping scheme

label: classification scheme
definition: schedule of concepts and pre-coordinated combinations of concepts, arranged by classification

label: dictionary
definition: a reference source containing words usually alphabetically arranged along with information about their forms, pronunciations, functions, etymologies, meanings, and syntactical and idiomatic uses

label: gazetteer
definition: geospatial dictionary of named and typed places

label: glossary
definition: a collection of textual glosses or of specialized terms with their meanings

label: list
definition: a limited set of terms arranged as a simple alphabetical list or in some other logically evident way; containing no relationships of any kind

label: name authority list
definition: controlled vocabulary for use in naming particular entities consistently

label: ontology
definition: A formal model that allows knowledge to be represented for a specific domain. An ontology describes the types of things that exist (classes), the relationships between them (properties) and the logical ways those classes and properties can be used together (axioms).

label: semantic network
definition: set of terms representing concepts, modeled as the nodes in a network of variable relationship types

label: subject heading scheme
definition: structured vocabulary comprising terms available for subject indexing, plus rules for combining them into pre-coordinated strings of terms where necessary

label: synonym ring
definition: set of synonymous or almost synonymous terms, any of which can be used to refer to a particular concept

label: taxonomy
definition: scheme of categories and subcategories that can be used to sort and otherwise organize items of knowledge or information

label: terminology
definition: set of designations belonging to one special language

label: thesaurus
definition: controlled and structured vocabulary in which concepts are represented by terms, organized so that relationships between concepts are made explicit, and preferred terms are accompanied by lead-in entries for synonyms or quasi-synonyms
